entries.title: A Certain Dark Item Release Date & Where to Watch
entries.description: A Certain Dark Item premieres October 9, 2026 and streams on Crunchyroll. See the release date, where to watch, studio and confirmed details.
entries.content: OCTOBER 9, 2026 · RELEASE GUIDE A Certain Dark Item Release Date & Where to Watch A Certain Dark Item begins its Japanese television run on October 9, 2026. Here are the confirmed broadcast details, streaming guidance, story and official trailer. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official A Certain Dark Item key visual. © Kamachi/KADOKAWA/PROJECT-ITEM. Source: official anime website . RELEASE October 9, 2026 STREAMING Crunchyroll STUDIO J.C.STAFF Release at a glance Japanese premiere: October 9, 2026. Japanese TV schedule: AT-X lists Friday at 10:30 p.m. JST; Tokyo MX and BS11 list 24:30, which means 12:30 a.m. on October 10. International streaming: Crunchyroll includes the series in its Fall 2026 lineup and lists a Friday 8:30 a.m. PT subtitled airtime. Check your local catalog for availability. Animation studio: J.C.STAFF. A Certain Dark Item is now airing in Japan. The series began on October 9, 2026. Its late-night schedule can be confusing because Japanese listings sometimes use a 24-hour clock that runs past midnight: 24:30 on October 9 is 12:30 a.m. on October 10. The official schedule lists the Japanese stations and services; Crunchyroll's Fall 2026 lineup is the source for its international subtitled airtime. Where can you watch A Certain Dark Item? Crunchyroll lists the show as part of its Fall 2026 season. The listed Friday 8:30 a.m. Pacific subtitled slot is a useful guide for viewers whose region receives the simulcast, but streaming catalogs and release timing can differ between countries. Search the title in the Crunchyroll app or website while signed in from your location before planning around that time. In Japan, the official anime site lists AT-X, Tokyo MX and BS11 for television. It also lists ABEMA and ABEMA Premium around the premiere, followed by additional subscription services from October 16, including d Anime Store, DMM TV, Hulu, U-NEXT and Prime Video. Those Japanese service listings do not establish availability in other countries. A platform's brand name can appear in more than one market with a different catalogue, so the local service page is the best check. What is the story about? The anime follows ITEM, a covert team operating in Academy City's criminal underworld. Its established members are Shizuri Mugino, Rikou Takitsubo, Frenda Seivelun and Saiai Kinuhata. An official introduction brings in Hanano Choubi, a new girl connected to the group as its fifth member. The premise shifts attention from the schools and public heroics often associated with the wider A Certain setting to the dangerous assignments carried out in its shadows. Related reading: BLEACH × Graniph: 17-Item Collection Launches in Japan on October 20 . The official first-episode synopsis gives readers a concrete starting point: ITEM is sent to investigate a company conducting ability-development research under the cover of medical treatment. That setup explains the team's role without giving away later turns. The story's central question is not simply whether ITEM can complete a job; the series also puts pressure on how a team stays together when its members work in a system that treats people as tools. How does this fit into the A Certain franchise? A Certain Dark Item is based on the ITEM-focused light novels by Kazuma Kamachi, with illustrations by Nilitsu, and belongs to the broader A Certain franchise. Its focus on Mugino and her team offers a different entry point from stories centered on Academy City's students. Viewers who already know the setting may recognize the city's split between its polished public image and its hidden operations. The anime's own official story and character pages introduce the people and conflict it needs; they do not publish a required watch order for the wider franchise. Cast, staff and music J.C.STAFF is producing the television anime. Tatsuyuki Nagai directs, Shogo Yasukawa handles series composition, and Shigeki Kimoto designs the characters. The official staff and cast page lists Ami Koshimizu as Shizuri Mugino, Aya Suzaki as Rikou Takitsubo, Maaya Uchida as Frenda Seivelun, Chinatsu Akasaki as Saiai Kinuhata and Hana Hishikawa as Hanano Choubi. Related reading: DARK MACHINE THE ANIMATION Release Date & Time . East Of Eden performs the opening theme, “Ghost Sequence,” and Kishida Kyoudan & The Akeboshi Rockets performs the ending theme, “Genshi Kuzushi (Meltdowner).” Official teaser and main trailer The official site has released multiple videos. The embedded March teaser introduces the project, while the July main trailer reveals the premiere date and theme songs. For new episode announcements and schedule changes, use the official news page alongside the broadcast schedule. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER A Certain Dark Item official teaser PV What to check before watching If you are outside Japan, use Crunchyroll's listing to confirm the show appears in your regional catalogue; the Japanese television timetable is not a worldwide streaming schedule. If you are following the broadcast in Japan, remember that the 24:30 entries fall just after midnight on the next calendar day. These distinctions answer the two practical questions readers often have after seeing the October 9 premiere date: which local service carries the show, and whether a late-night listing refers to Friday or Saturday in Japan. AniNextUp: Broadcast times and streaming catalogues may change. We use the official anime site for Japanese schedule, story, cast and staff details, and Crunchyroll for the international lineup information. entries.content: FALL 2026 · RELEASE GUIDE Ace of the Diamond act II -Second Season- Cour 2 Ace of the Diamond act II -Second Season- Cour 2 began October 11, 2026. Check Japanese broadcast times, streaming regions and how to continue the episode order. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official series visual. Source: Ace of the Diamond official website . Release at a glance Japan premiere October 11, 2026; Sundays at 5:30 p.m. JST on TV Tokyo’s six-station network and 9:00 p.m. JST on AT-X Animation OLM Team Yoshioka Where to watch Netflix after the Japanese broadcast; other Japanese services follow. Crunchyroll lists the series in supported international regions. Schedule: official broadcast and streaming schedule . Why the second cour matters to the season The October return is the second broadcast block of Ace of the Diamond act II -Second Season- , not a newly numbered third season. The season began in April 2026, and the October schedule resumes the same adaptation. Viewers who stopped after the spring episodes can continue with the next episode in sequence; there is no separate reboot or new cast announcement attached to this cour transition. That distinction is useful when searching streaming services. Catalogs may keep the episodes under the existing season page and continue the episode numbering, instead of creating a new title for “Cour 2.” If a service appears not to list a new season, check the current act II -Second Season- page and its latest episode row before assuming the episodes are missing. When does Cour 2 begin? The second cour began in Japan on October 11, 2026 . TV Tokyo’s six-station network schedules it for Sundays at 5:30 p.m. JST ; AT-X lists a Sunday 9:00 p.m. JST broadcast with repeat showings. These are Japanese broadcast times. They should not be converted into a universal streaming time, because local services and time zones can differ. The official series site says Netflix receives the episodes after the Japanese broadcast, with other listed services following. Its schedule includes ABEMA, DMM TV, d Anime Store, Disney+, FOD, Hulu, J:COM STREAM, Lemino, milplus and music.jp. The platform list is Japan-specific. Crunchyroll separately lists the title for supported international regions, but territory and episode availability should be checked in each viewer’s local catalog. What the story is carrying forward The continuing season follows Eijun Sawamura and Seido High as they pursue a place at Koshien. Sawamura’s move into the ace role gives the team a different pressure point: the position is not only a personal milestone but also a responsibility that affects how the whole pitching staff and defense prepare. The series’ appeal comes from showing that work through practice, selection and games rather than treating one successful performance as a complete arrival. The October schedule therefore makes most sense as a continuation of the existing team arc. Returning viewers can track how Seido responds to its opponents and how Sawamura handles expectations around the ace number. This is a reading of the confirmed premise and character setup, not a claim about a particular game’s result. Related reading: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Cour 2 Release Date & Time . Where should returning viewers resume? Start with the remaining episodes from the April cour and then follow the October episodes in order. That keeps the match context and player relationships intact, especially for viewers who are catching up after a break. A service’s “new season” label is less reliable than its episode list when a season is split into cours, so compare the episode numbers and release dates if the catalog layout is unclear. For the latest episode timing, use the official Japanese schedule and the current listing on the streaming service available in your country. A Japanese Sunday broadcast does not guarantee a same-hour international simulcast, and the official announcement does not provide one single global time. What does the official second-cour PV confirm? The official YouTube page records the main promotional video’s upload at 1:00:20 a.m. PDT (UTC−7) on September 15, 2026 . It promotes the October 11 return and foregrounds the Seido versus Inashiro rivalry, while the official description identifies GLAY’s “NEVER SAY NEVER AGAIN” as the opening theme. That makes the PV useful for confirming the season’s immediate matchup and music. It is still a promotional preview: edited scenes do not establish a game result or reveal a complete episode-by-episode synopsis. Where does the streaming information apply? Japan’s official schedule places Netflix immediately after the television broadcast and lists other Japanese services for later availability. That lineup is specific to Japan. Crunchyroll’s Fall 2026 guide lists the series for North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East and CIS, but it does not promise one simultaneous clock time across those markets. Viewers outside Japan should check the title page in their own catalog for current episode timing, language options and territory access. Official schedule and trailer The official broadcast and streaming schedule lists Japanese television times and local services. Watch the official second-cour main PV on the series channel. For other Fall 2026 releases, browse the AniNextUp calendar and streaming guide . ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER ON YOUTUBE TV Anime “Ace of the Diamond” Series For other Fall 2026 premieres, browse the AniNextUp calendar and our streaming guide . Availability and episode timing can change by country, so the local platform listing remains the final check. Release dates and streaming availability are based on official announcements available on October 23, 2026. Regional catalogs may differ. Updated: October 23, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error Official broadcaster: TV Tokyo October 11, 5:30 p.m. JST schedule . Additional official sources: TV Tokyo: April 5 premiere and production credits ; TV Tokyo: October 11 Cour 2 announcement . International premiere reference: Crunchyroll Fall 2026 lineup: October 11, OLM Team Yoshioka, story and licensed territories . This guide does not assign an international clock time; use your regional episode listing.

entries.content: OCTOBER 18, 2026 · MOVIE RELEASE NEWS Aikatsu Stars! Movie: January 22, 2027 Release Date & Trailer Aikatsu Stars! ~Hoshiboshi no Progress~ will open in Japan on January 22, 2027. BN Pictures has released the main trailer and a new key visual for Yume and her friends’ next story. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official promotional artwork · ©BNP/AIKATSU STARS 10TH PROJECT. Source: BN Pictures’ press release . Release at a glance Japan release January 22, 2027 Format New theatrical anime film Production BN Pictures International streaming No platform or date announced in the cited sources Verified October 25, 2026 · Official movie website When does Aikatsu Stars! ~Hoshiboshi no Progress~ release? Aikatsu Stars! ~Hoshiboshi no Progress~ opens in Japanese theaters on January 22, 2027. BN Pictures announced the date on October 17, 2026, alongside the main trailer and key visual. The official movie site lists a nationwide Japanese theatrical opening. That is a cinema date for Japan; it is not a confirmed global release or a streaming date. What is the new Aikatsu Stars! movie about? The story takes place shortly before graduation. Yume Nijino and her friends receive an invitation from Elza Forte of Neo Venus Ark to perform at Venus Jamboree, a live event bringing together top idols from around the world. The official synopsis also introduces the mysterious passenger ship Petit Venus Ark. As the performance approaches, the characters balance their work as idols with decisions about their dreams, plans and future paths. This premise keeps the series’ familiar focus on performances and friendship while placing the characters at a transition point. The announcement does not reveal the show’s final stage, the full set list or how each character’s future decision turns out. Those details remain story reveals rather than facts that can be confirmed from the synopsis. Related reading: The Apothecary Diaries Movie: Luoqing and Yinshan Character PV . Is this a new movie or the 10th-anniversary rerelease? Hoshiboshi no Progress is a newly produced film for the Aikatsu Stars! 10th-anniversary project. It is separate from the summer 2026 revival screening of the earlier Aikatsu Stars! The Movie , which played for a limited three-week run under the title Anniversary Stars . The two projects mark the same milestone but have different stories and release dates: the revival was a return to cinemas for the earlier film, while the January 2027 title is the new Yume-and-friends story. The Japanese subtitle is 星々のProgress. “Progress of the Stars” is a helpful English rendering, but the official site has not announced a separate international English title. Search results may use translated wording; the Japanese title and January 22 date are the firm identifiers. Related reading: Maebashi Witches Movie: October 23 Release, New Scenes & Trailer . Do you need to watch the television series first? The official announcement does not publish a required viewing order. Its synopsis introduces the invitation and event, while the cast list returns to Yume, Laura, Koharu, Ako, Mahiru and their fellow idols. Viewers familiar with the television series will recognize the characters and their relationships, especially as graduation approaches. Newcomers can follow the announced premise, but the producers have not described the film as a standalone entry or provided a catch-up guide. Watching the earlier series is a reasonable way to understand the group’s history; treat that as viewing advice, not an official prerequisite. Who is in the cast and production staff? The official film site lists Miyu Tomita as Yume Nijino, Ayaka Asai as Laura Sakuraba, Megumi Yamaguchi as Koharu Nanakura, Natsumi Murakami as Ako Saotome, Yume Miyamoto as Mahiru Kasumi, Minami Tsuda as Hime Shiratori, Sumire Morohoshi as Tsubasa Kisaragi, Azusa Tadokoro as Yuzu Nikaido, Ayaka Ohashi as Yozora Kasumi, Reina Ueda as Lily Shirogane, Yoko Hikasa as Elza Forte, Natsumi Fujiwara as Rei Kizaki, Nako Eguchi as Kirara Hanazono and Kaori Maeda as Aria Futaba. Related reading: Medalist Movie Release Date: February 19, 2027, Story and Cast . BN Pictures is responsible for planning, original work and production, with Bandai credited for the original concept. Teruo Sato directs, Yuko Kakihara writes the screenplay and Yukiko Aikei designs the characters. BN Pictures also handles distribution in Japan. These are the currently credited principal roles; the official staff page is the place to check if more production credits are added. Where can you watch the official trailer, and when was it uploaded? The official movie website and BN Pictures’ announcement link the main trailer, video ID 8g68u8qd87c . The announcement is dated October 17, 2026, and PR Times records its own publication time as 17:00 Japan Standard Time. That is the press-release time, not proof of the YouTube video’s original upload timestamp. The accessible official listing does not provide a verifiable upload hour and timezone, so this guide gives the announcement date only. It omits a timestamp-specific VideoObject rather than transferring the press-release time to the video. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Aikatsu Stars! · Main trailer What songs are in the trailer? The main theme is “Five stars,” performed by Sena, Rie, Miki, Nanase and Kana, with lyrics by Miho Karasawa and composition and arrangement by Kenichi Nagahashi of agehasprings Party. The official site also lists the ending theme “Anata e,” performed by Sena, Rie, Miki, Miho, Nanase, Kana, Luka and Risa, with lyrics by Karasawa and composition and arrangement by Tomohiro Akiura. How can you get tickets, and where will the movie screen? The official theater list identifies Japanese cinemas showing the film and is the best place to check participating locations as the opening approaches. The second MoviTicket card went on sale October 23, 2026, for ¥1,600. Its purchase bonus is a five-postcard set, randomly selected from three designs; the bonus is limited and some theaters may not sell it. Check the official ticket page or a listed theater for current stock and purchase conditions before traveling. Will Aikatsu Stars! be available outside Japan or on streaming? The official release information reviewed for this update confirms the January 22 Japanese cinema opening but does not announce an overseas theatrical date, international distributor or streaming service. A Japanese theater listing should not be read as a worldwide rollout. If you are outside Japan, the practical answer is that a legal local viewing option has not been confirmed in these sources. We will update this guide if BN Pictures or the official franchise portal names a distributor or platform. Official sources Official movie site: synopsis, theater list, tickets, staff and cast BN Pictures: release date and main-trailer announcement Official information about the separate Anniversary Stars revival screening For another upcoming theatrical anime, see our guides to The Apothecary Diaries movie , Takopi’s Original Sin movie and Witch on the Holy Night . entries.title: Akane-banashi Season 2 Release Date: January 2027 and Story
entries.description: Akane-banashi Season 2 begins in January 2027 with the Zenza Training Arc. See the official teaser, story setup, production background and viewing status.
entries.content: RELEASE NEWS · OCTOBER 27, 2026 Akane-banashi Season 2 Release Date: January 2027 and Story Akane-banashi Season 2 begins in January 2027 with the Zenza Training Arc. See the official teaser, story setup, production background and viewing status. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official second-season promotional artwork from the Akane-banashi anime website. © Yuki Suenaga, Takamasa Moue / Shueisha, Akane-banashi Production Committee. Release at a glance Japanese premiere January 2027; exact day TBA New storyline Zenza Training Arc Original manga Yuki Suenaga and Takamasa Moue International Season 2 schedule Not established in the sources reviewed Release details checked October 27, 2026. When is Akane-banashi Season 2 coming out? Akane-banashi Season 2 begins in January 2027. The official anime announced the continuation on June 20, 2026. Its second-season introduction, published September 19, identifies the next storyline as the Zenza Training Arc and explains where Akane's professional journey goes next. The confirmed window is a month, with the exact first broadcast day still to be established in the second-season information reviewed here. The official site's January promotion names TV Asahi's IMAnimation network and BS Asahi among the Japanese outlets. An older weekly slot should not be assigned to the continuation without its own dated schedule. This is a returning television anime for the Winter 2027 season. You can compare its window with other returning and new productions in our January 2027 anime guide , which distinguishes exact dates from month-only announcements. What is the story of Akane-banashi? The series follows Akane, a young woman drawn to rakugo through her father's performances. Rakugo is a storytelling art in which a performer creates characters and scenes through speech, gesture and changes in delivery. Its stage is spare, making the audience's attention and the storyteller's control essential to the effect. Related reading: Cosmoship Yamato √2199 Release Date: Story, Cast and What’s Confirmed . Akane's father, Shinta Arakawa, loses his place in the profession after a devastating examination decision. His daughter's ambition grows from her belief in his art. VIZ's introduction presents her pursuit of the highest rank as both a personal challenge and an effort to demonstrate the value of the storytelling that inspired her. That background gives the series an accessible competitive structure even for viewers unfamiliar with rakugo. The performances matter, but so do preparation, judgment and the gap between possessing ability and being recognized for it. The family motivation gives Akane's progress emotional stakes beyond winning an isolated contest. What happens in the Zenza Training Arc? The official second-season introduction moves Akane beyond high school and into formal training within the Shiguma school. She begins her professional life under the name Akane Arakawa and enters Yasakatei, a traditional yose theater, where she must learn among established performers. That setting changes the questions surrounding her ambition. Wanting to perform and being ready for the everyday obligations of a professional theater are different challenges. The new introduction places her inside that working environment, rather than simply extending the classroom phase of her life. Related reading: Dandivine Release Date & Where to Watch: Japan Schedule, Cast and Story . For a spoiler-light viewing plan, those details are sufficient: a new stage of training, a professional name and a theater that puts her close to experienced storytellers. Specific performance outcomes and later manga developments are unnecessary to understand why this continuation is a meaningful next step. Watch the official announcement video The June 20 announcement includes an official video introducing the continuation. It documents the second-season announcement, rather than a complete episode preview or a final broadcast schedule. The promotional artwork above also carries the January 2027 window. The original announcement is preserved in the source list at the end of this article. ▶ PLAY OFFICIAL VIDEO Akane-banashi Season 2 — Official Announcement Video Who makes the anime? The current official project credits list Ayumu Watanabe as director, Yuu Harima as assistant director and Michihiro Tsuchiya for series composition. Kii Tanaka handles character design and chief animation direction, with ZEXCS credited for animation production. Akio Izutsu provides the music, while Kikuhiko Hayashiya is credited for rakugo supervision. Those roles help explain the range of work involved in adapting a performance-centered manga: animation, voice acting, music and specialist supervision all contribute to how a story told on a small stage becomes a television sequence. They are reference credits from the official project page, rather than a claim that every second-season production detail has been separately reannounced. Related reading: Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING: Story, Trailer and Release Status . The established Japanese voice cast includes Anna Nagase as Akane, Takuya Eguchi as Karashi Nerimaya, Rie Takahashi as Hikaru Koragi and Jun Fukuyama as Shinta. These names offer a starting point for recognizing the returning ensemble while leaving room for additional second-season casting updates. Where can you watch the second season? The Japanese television window is confirmed, but a complete international Season 2 service list and local upload timetable are not established by the sources reviewed. The official on-air page still contains the first season's April 2026 schedule and Japanese service listings, so those entries should be checked for their season label before being reused. A separate February announcement introduced an official global YouTube initiative for the first season in North and Latin America. That arrangement describes the first-season release. It does not automatically establish the second season's countries, episode availability or language options. If you are catching up now, check the season and territory shown by your provider. If you are planning January viewing, add the second season to your watchlist and wait for a service-specific timetable before setting an episode reminder. Related reading: Granite Waves Anime: Story, Cast, Episodes & Where to Watch . Where to begin with the manga The original manga pairs Yuki Suenaga's story with Takamasa Moue's art and is published in English by VIZ. Starting from its opening volume introduces Akane's family motivation and the dramatic importance of the professional ranks before the new season's theater training begins. Anime viewers can follow the simpler route of finishing the first season before starting the January continuation. For a different kind of skill-driven story coming soon afterward, our Medalist movie guide follows another young performer working with a mentor toward a demanding competitive goal. Sources and verification Primary announcements and publisher information checked October 27, 2026. entries.title: Anime Mysterious Codes (October 2026): Reports & Redemption Guide
entries.description: Roblox guide to six reported Anime Mysterious codes, reward discrepancies, Level 5 requirements and redemption troubleshooting. Checked October 26; not live-tested.
entries.content: ROBLOX CODES Anime Mysterious Codes (October 2026): Reports & Redemption Guide Six codes are reported in recent October lists, including SRYFORLATEUPDATE and ILOVEUALLGUYS. Compare the reports, follow the lobby redemption route and see which rewards and expiry claims remain unverified. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify updates Official Anime Mysterious game artwork from the developer’s Roblox experience page . GAME Anime Mysterious · Roblox Codes at a glance Game / platform Anime Mysterious · Roblox · by Anime Mysterious Recent additions SRYFORLATEUPDATE, ILOVEUALLGUYS Reported requirements Level 5 and membership in the developer’s Roblox community Verification Sources checked October 26, 2026; no live redemption test Developer’s Roblox experience · third-party code reports are distinguished below. Which Anime Mysterious codes are worth checking first? Six recent codes appear in the October lists checked on October 26, 2026. The two additions missing from our earlier guide are SRYFORLATEUPDATE and ILOVEUALLGUYS . They join four Halloween and Update 0.75 strings. These are reported codes, not codes AniNextUp has successfully redeemed in a live account. No guaranteed expiry time or universally working list has been established. The Roblox experience page identifies the game as Anime Mysterious and displays its Halloween/Update 0.75 branding. Its developer description explains the core loop: summon anime units, build a strategy and defend against enemy waves. This is a Roblox game guide, rather than an announcement for an anime television series. Code Recent reporting Verification status SRYFORLATEUPDATE Beebom and Pro Game Guides Reported; not live-tested here ILOVEUALLGUYS Beebom and Pocket Tactics Reported; not live-tested here HAPPYHALLOWEEN All three lists Reported; not live-tested here IAMATOMIC All three lists Reported; not live-tested here UPDATE075 All three lists Reward quantities conflict HALLOWEENEVENT All three lists Reward quantities conflict What rewards do those codes give? Beebom's October 24 update reports 100 Characteristics and 50 Halloween Capsules for SRYFORLATEUPDATE. For ILOVEUALLGUYS it lists 1,000 Coins, 1,000 Jewels, 25 Traits, 25 Halloween Capsules and 10 Bingo Coins. Those quantities are attributed reports; an in-game reward notification remains necessary to confirm your account's result. There is a specific reason not to promise identical rewards across the older batch. Beebom lists 20 Characteristics for UPDATE075 and HALLOWEENEVENT, while Pocket Tactics' October 22 list gives ten. We cannot settle that difference from the public lists. Do not treat Traits, Characteristics and different capsule names as interchangeable when comparing your inventory. How to redeem a code The redemption route described by Pro Game Guides uses the lobby's code character. Pocket Tactics and Beebom also report a Level 5 requirement and Roblox community membership. These instructions have been cross-checked against those guides, not replayed inside the current game build. Open the linked Roblox experience and check its creator is Anime Mysterious. Join the community linked by the developer and reach Level 5. Find the code NPC in the spawn lobby and use the interaction prompt. Guides spell the character's name Naruto or Naruta. Copy one code without surrounding spaces, paste it into the code box and choose Redeem. Read the response and compare the reward notification with your inventory before entering another code. On a phone, follow the interaction control displayed by Roblox rather than looking for a keyboard-only command. A long press or interaction prompt may differ from a desktop guide's instructions. The relevant action is opening the NPC's code box, not typing a code into public chat. Copy the code, not the update label UPDATE075 contains the digit zero followed by 75. The game's “Update 0.75” branding is a description, not the string to paste into the box. Likewise, the words NEW or active beside a code in a roundup are editorial labels. Enter only the code itself, without quotation marks, markdown backticks or an added space. This separates a formatting mistake from an actual rejection by the game. Why a code might fail Work through the response you actually receive. If it names a level or membership requirement, address that first. For an unrecognized string, check the spelling and remove copied spaces. An already-used response should not be treated as proof that the code has expired for everyone. Record the wording rather than translating every failure into “expired.” If an update has just landed, rejoining and checking again is a reasonable troubleshooting step; it is not a guaranteed fix. Avoid spending currency or changing your team merely to test a code. A failed redemption by itself does not establish a problem with your units, progression choices or account balance. Which older codes have expired? The sources disagree here too. Beebom marks UPDATE05, FATESTAYNIGHT and GILGAMESH expired, while other lists still include them. We have therefore kept them out of the recent-code table rather than presenting a mixed historical list as verified active. The game's current response is more useful than the length of a third-party roundup. Where to check the next update Start from the developer's Roblox page and its community link. Gaming guides also point to Discord, but this review could not inspect the developer's announcement messages there. We cannot promise a release time for the next code, a milestone reward or a Halloween event deadline without an attributable announcement. Do these codes give free Robux? This table concerns rewards inside Anime Mysterious. It is not a Robux promotion or a gift-card redemption list. Roblox's own support guidance warns against free-Robux generators. Its account-security guide also says not to share passwords, cookies or verification codes. You do not need to give a code-list website access to your account. Source check: October 26, 2026. Recent list dates: Beebom October 24, Pro Game Guides October 23 and Pocket Tactics October 22. Live redemption, exact expiry times and disputed reward quantities remain unverified. Updated: October 26, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error Primary references: Roblox experience and developer description ; developer-linked community . Code claims are attributed to the dated third-party reports linked in this guide.

Netflix’s returning romances, PSYREN, Nia Liston and ELECEED provide the key examples. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official Netflix October romance-lineup artwork. The roundup also covers new series and announcements beyond this selection. Source: Netflix . WHERE TO WATCH Multiple platforms Release at a glance Coverage October launches and October announcements for future releases Platforms Netflix and Crunchyroll; Japanese television and streaming schedules are separate New future window ELECEED: April 2027, exact day unannounced Source review October 26, 2026 · title-specific regional availability Netflix lineup · PSYREN Japan schedule · Nia Liston production site What changed in anime this October? October 2026 combines new weekly series, returning seasons and a separate wave of announcements for 2027. This roundup separates those categories so an announcement made this month is not mistaken for something available to watch now. The selection below was checked on October 26 against production websites and distributor notices; it is a starting point for choosing a guide, rather than an exhaustive streaming catalog. For viewers catching up, the important distinction is between a season's opening date and its current episode schedule. A show that premiered in early October may already have several episodes available. A special released later in the month can follow a different pattern. The date alone does not tell you whether you are starting a weekly series, continuing an existing story or watching an additional chapter. Netflix: returning romances and a special Netflix's official October romance lineup lists The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 from October 1 Pacific Time/October 2 Japan Standard Time, Blue Box Season 2 from October 4, and My Happy Marriage Season 2 Special Episodes from October 25. Netflix explicitly describes the first two as weekly releases. Its announcement does not provide a universal local upload hour for all three. The viewing choices serve different interests. The Ramparts of Ice follows a circle of high-school friends whose feelings do not line up neatly. Blue Box brings badminton, basketball and a changing household relationship together. My Happy Marriage continues Miyo and Kiyoka's story through special episodes. Those descriptions identify the kind of story on offer, not a ranking of animation quality or a promise about your regional catalog. Related reading: Manchuria Opium Squad Anime: Release Date, Story and Latest News . Open our Blue Box Season 2 guide for its separate Japanese broadcast information. Netflix's start date and Japan's television schedule answer different questions, even when both fall on October 4. My Happy Marriage: why the format matters The production's special-episode notice specifies three episodes, with the earliest Japanese television broadcast on October 25 at 19:00 JST and streaming from 20:30 JST. These are Japan-side times. They should not be presented as a verified Netflix upload schedule for every country. If you are searching for Season 3, this October listing does not establish one: the announcement identifies a special. Our My Happy Marriage special guide keeps that release distinct from a numbered new season and explains the available viewing information. Related reading: Anime Mysterious Codes (October 2026): Reports & Redemption Guide . PSYREN: a new series with two relevant clocks Crunchyroll's premiere notice gives October 5 at 7:30 a.m. Pacific Time for PSYREN's subtitled debut, available worldwide excluding Japan and China. That premiere-specific time is not confirmation of every later episode or dubbed version. The Japanese production schedule separately lists TOKYO MX and BS11 on Mondays at 23:00 JST from October 5, with domestic streaming from 23:30 JST and service exceptions. A Japanese streaming list containing a familiar brand does not establish the same license outside Japan. Start with our PSYREN guide if you want the manga entry point, cast and regional distinctions without story spoilers. Nia Liston: confirmed Japan dates, regional checks Nia Liston's official site confirms an October 6 Japanese start and two consecutive cours. TOKYO MX lists Tuesdays at 21:25 JST; BS Nippon TV lists 24:30 and MBS 27:30 under the same programming day. Those latter times fall after midnight on the following calendar date. Related reading: BLEACH × Graniph: 17-Item Collection Launches in Japan on October 20 . The production also lists different start dates for domestic streaming services. Do not combine those entries into one worldwide timetable. HIDIVE identifies Nia Liston in its Fall 2026 coverage , but its full news page was not readable in this review; an exact international hour is therefore not asserted here. The Nia Liston release guide provides the broader series context. October announcement, April 2027 release: ELECEED Not every headline published in October describes an October premiere. The official ELECEED notice dated October 21 confirms an April 2027 television broadcast window. It does not establish an exact premiere day or local streaming hour. Readers searching for an episode to watch this week should keep that future window separate from this month's launches. Our ELECEED guide covers the announced adaptation and remaining questions. This roundup records the news without turning a month-only announcement into a countdown. Related reading: Delicious in Dungeon Season 2 Release Date: October 2027 . How to build a watchlist from these updates Choose the story first, then check the release type, service and territory. For returning shows, confirm which earlier season you need. For a new adaptation, begin with its first episode rather than a promotional video's publication date. For specials, verify whether the announcement describes additional episodes or a new season before assuming the same weekly pattern. Use this week's schedule for current viewing and the release calendar for upcoming premieres. A date retained in this monthly archive documents an announced launch; it does not certify today's availability, a complete episode count or every audio language. Where an exact hour is missing, this page leaves it unknown instead of supplying an estimated time. entries.content: DECEMBER 2026 Anime Releasing in December 2026: Confirmed Dates A living guide to anime releases officially scheduled for December 2026. More titles will be added as studios and distributors confirm exact dates. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases December 2026 has one exact-date anime premiere in this guide and another release confirmed for the month. The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure opens in Japanese theaters on December 11. Disney has also announced Twisted-Wonderland The Animation: Episode of Savanaclaw for Disney+ in December, without specifying a day in the announcement reviewed here. These are different kinds of releases: the first is a cinema opening in Japan, while the second is a streaming window announced by Disney Japan. Availability and timing can differ internationally. This guide separates a confirmed day from a confirmed month so that neither is mistaken for a worldwide release date. December 2026 anime dates at a glance Date Anime Release December 11 The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure Japanese theaters December; day TBA Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation: Episode of Savanaclaw Disney+; check regional availability Dates reflect the announcements checked on October 26, 2026. A month-only window is useful for planning, but it should not be treated as a scheduled day. Additional entries belong here once their distributors or production teams provide a December date or window. The Apothecary Diaries film: December 11 in Japan Maomao and Jinshi return in The Late Lady’s Treasure , the franchise's first anime feature. The Japanese opening is set for December 11, 2026. According to Crunchyroll's distribution announcement , the film is based on a story concept from creator Natsu Hyuuga and directed by Norihiro Naganuma at TOHO Animation STUDIO. Related reading: Fall 2026 Anime Release Schedule & Calendar: October–December 2026 . The premise sends Jinshi and Maomao to a southern province to investigate a mystery connected to the final wishes and remains of a deceased consort. That makes this a new film story for the pair, rather than a December date for an ordinary television episode. Our film guide covers the film's characters and trailers in more detail. Will the movie be available outside Japan on December 11? Not necessarily. Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment announced theatrical distribution rights for North America and international territories excluding Asia, with India included. Their October announcement said international dates and ticket information would follow. The Japanese opening therefore does not confirm a same-day showing in the United States, the Dominican Republic or another country. It also does not establish when the movie will be available to stream at home. When planning a visit to the cinema, look for a local distributor's announcement or a listing from your theater. Check the country, the date, and whether the showing is subtitled or dubbed before buying a ticket. A trailer available online does not mean the full film has been released online. Related reading: January 2027 Anime Releases: Dates & Where to Watch . Twisted-Wonderland: Episode of Savanaclaw — December, day TBA Disney Japan announced that the second Twisted-Wonderland animated installment, Episode of Savanaclaw , will stream exclusively on Disney+ from December 2026. The announcement provides a month, not a specific premiere day. We have listed it separately from the December 11 film instead of assigning it an invented date. The release follows the earlier Episode of Heartslabyul and shifts attention to Savanaclaw. For viewers looking for a series rather than a theatrical movie, its streaming format makes it a different kind of December entry. Disney Japan's announcement does not establish an identical day or catalog availability for every market; consult the Disney+ listing in your region for local details and any later schedule. Is The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 a December premiere? No. The third television season began in October 2026, so December viewing of an ongoing episode should not be presented as the launch of the season. Its television schedule is separate from the film's December 11 Japanese opening. The Season 3 guide covers the series, while this page tracks releases with a December date or month window. Related reading: November 2026 Anime Releases: Dates & Where to Watch . That distinction also applies to other fall shows. A series can have new installments during December even if its premiere took place in October. Being available to watch during the month is useful information, but it is not by itself evidence of a new December season launch. For ongoing releases, check the service's episode calendar and the availability in your country. Why does this calendar have only two entries? This page is a checked starting point, not a promise that only two anime projects will arrive in December. A title needs an attributable December day or month before it is added here. Announcements that say only “2026,” “fall,” or “coming soon” do not identify December on their own; a theatrical date in another month should not be shifted into this list to fill it. We distinguish the two kinds of confirmation in the table: December 11 is an exact Japanese cinema date, while Episode of Savanaclaw has a December streaming window with its day still to be confirmed in the source checked. Future local releases may be announced on different schedules. Readers can follow the full fall calendar for nearby premieres and the where-to-watch guide for platform information. Related reading: Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 Confirmed for 2027: New Trailer and Streaming Details . How will the list be updated? As studios, broadcasters and distributors publish more specific schedules, this guide can add the date, format and territory supported by each announcement. A change from a month-only window to an exact day should be accompanied by the source and the region it applies to. If a release is delayed, the prior date should not remain presented as current. Sources checked October 26, 2026: Crunchyroll's film distribution announcement and Disney Japan's Savanaclaw announcement. Release dates and regional availability can change. Updated: October 26, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error Official movie reference: The Apothecary Diaries December 11 theatrical announcement .

entries.content: FALL 2026 · RELEASE GUIDE Aoashi Season 2: Release Date and Where to Watch Aoashi Season 2 began October 4, 2026. Check Japan’s schedule, Crunchyroll regions and the local release time in Santo Domingo. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Release at a glance Japan premiere October 4, 2026, on NHK E-Tele at 5:00 p.m. JST every Sunday Animation TMS Entertainment Where to watch Crunchyroll in listed international regions; Japanese services have separate schedules. Episode plan 24 episodes across two cours, according to the official series site. Schedule: official Aoashi Season 2 schedule . What changes for Ashito in Season 2? Season 2 begins after Aoi Ashito earns promotion to Tokyo City Esperion’s A team. That promotion changes the central challenge: he is now training alongside players with more experience and competing for a place in a stronger squad. The official first-cour visual brings together members of the youth A team, while the production describes Ashito as entering a new phase of competition. It sets up a clear question for viewers—how will he adjust his field awareness and decision-making when the standard around him rises? This is a continuation of Ashito’s development, not a reset. His instincts remain important, but football at this level asks him to connect what he sees with the movement and responsibilities of his teammates. The season’s premise points toward that learning curve without confirming match outcomes or a specific endpoint for his progress. When did Aoashi Season 2 premiere? The season premiered in Japan on October 4, 2026 . NHK E-Tele broadcasts it on Sundays at 5:00 p.m. JST . The official site lists Japanese subscription streaming on Hulu, Netflix, U-NEXT and Anime Times from 11:00 p.m. JST on Sundays. A wider group of services begins staggered Thursday releases from October 8 at 7:30 p.m. JST. These are domestic Japanese schedules, not universal times. Where can international viewers watch? Crunchyroll lists Season 2 for a set of international territories, including North America, Central and South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS, India and Southeast Asia. Its Sunday simulcast listing is 2:00 a.m. Pacific Time in supported regions. Availability can vary by territory and subscription, so confirm that the show and the newest episode appear in the catalog for your account. Japanese services such as Hulu Japan or U-NEXT should not be assumed to have the same access rules as services with similar names abroad. The different Japanese release windows also explain why episode listings can look inconsistent. Some services carry the Sunday subscription stream, while other platforms begin on Thursday or offer transactional rentals. If an episode is not visible on a service, check its own schedule and region settings before treating the delay as a series-wide postponement. What should new viewers know first? The first season establishes Ashito’s move from a small local setting into Esperion’s youth system and introduces the coaches and teammates who shape his development. Season 2’s A-team promotion makes more sense after those earlier relationships and decisions. Watching Season 1 first is the clearest route for anyone who wants the competitive stakes and team dynamics to land as intended. Returning viewers can use the promotion as the simple recap point: Ashito has reached a higher level, but that achievement is the start of another adjustment rather than proof that he has mastered the role. The series remains a sports drama about learning to read the game and work within a team, so the new squad creates both opportunity and pressure. How many episodes are planned, and what does “cour” mean? The official Aoashi site describes the first cour as the first 12 episodes out of 24 planned for Season 2. A cour is a broadcast block, so that announcement helps explain why the season has separate first- and second-cour schedules. It does not mean a streaming service must create a separate season page for each block. If you are catching up, compare the episode list and dates rather than relying only on a “new season” label. The official schedule and your service’s episode page are the best places to confirm the next release. What time is the simulcast in the Dominican Republic? Crunchyroll lists the international simulcast for Sunday at 2:00 a.m. Pacific Time. For Santo Domingo, that corresponds to 5:00 a.m. while Pacific Time is on daylight time. The United States ends daylight saving time on November 1, 2026; after the Pacific clock moves back to standard time, the same 2:00 a.m. Pacific listing corresponds to 6:00 a.m. in Santo Domingo. These are time-zone conversions, not a separate Dominican release announcement. Check the episode page in your local Crunchyroll catalog in case the service changes its schedule. Official schedule and related Fall releases The official Aoashi Season 2 schedule lists Japanese broadcast and streaming times. The official ShoPro YouTube page records the main PV upload at 4:00:12 p.m. PDT (UTC−7) on September 1, 2026 . Its first-cour visual announcement confirms the October 4 NHK E-Tele start and describes the A-team setting. The official channel’s first-cour main PV offers a quick look at the new season. Crunchyroll’s Fall 2026 lineup is the source for international streaming details. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER ON YOUTUBE ShoPro Anime Channel Aoashi shares its October 4 premiere date with other series, including Blue Box Season 2 . For more confirmed dates, see the AniNextUp Fall 2026 calendar . The anime’s weekly rhythm and service availability can vary by location; consult the official or local platform listing when planning a watch schedule. Dates and times above distinguish the Japanese broadcast and platform schedule from Crunchyroll’s regional simulcast listing. entries.content: DECEMBER 11 · ANIME MOVIE The Apothecary Diaries Movie: Luoqing and Yinshan Character PV A new official character video introduces Luoqing and Yinshan, two figures at the center of the movie’s mystery, ahead of the December 11, 2026 Japanese theatrical opening. Luoqing was a consort who died five years earlier; Yinshan served as her head attendant and now cares for Muqing in the Bi household. The accompanying announcements cast Miyuki Sawashiro as Luoqing and Ai Mikami as Yinshan. These reveals add characters and voice actors, but do not change the Japanese release date or establish a date outside Japan. The official video is a character promotional clip, not a new full-length film trailer. It follows earlier October videos introducing Maomao and Jinshi, then the Bi household and the Kaja-dan river pirates. Those announcements add context to the ensemble and the mystery, while the production’s confirmed theatrical date remains December 11. YouTube records the Luoqing and Yinshan PV as uploaded at 4:00:35 p.m. PDT (UTC−7) on October 13, 2026 ; that timestamp is October 14 in Japan. It is the video upload time, not the date the film opens. Related reading: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Schedule & Where to Watch . Official October 14 character PV announcement · Luoqing cast announcement · Yinshan cast announcement . ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL CHARACTER PV ON YOUTUBE TOHO animation When does The Apothecary Diaries movie release? The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure opens in Japanese theaters on December 11, 2026. The official announcement calls it a new theatrical film with an original story concept by series author Natsu Hyuuga. It is not a recap of the television episodes and is not Season 3. The film follows Maomao and Jinshi as they travel to a southern water city to return the remains of a consort who died five years earlier. A mystery involving her past, a hidden treasure and river pirates draws them into the story. The Japanese date is confirmed, but it should not be treated as a worldwide release. Crunchyroll announced international theatrical distribution; that confirms an overseas distributor, not one common date for every country. Local cinema dates and any later streaming launch require separate announcements. Who is making the film? Norio Naganuma directs, Yuko Kakihara writes the screenplay and TOHO animation STUDIO produces the animation. Aoi Yuki returns as Maomao and Takeo Otsuka as Jinshi. The recently announced supporting roles broaden the group connected to the southern province and the film’s investigation. The character videos give viewers a first look at that setting, but do not disclose the full solution to the mystery. Do you need to watch the TV anime first? No official prerequisite viewing order has been announced. The movie is presented as a new story centered on Maomao and Jinshi, so a newcomer can follow the central investigation from its own setup. Watching the television seasons first is still a useful choice if you want the character relationships, palace politics and Maomao’s investigative habits to feel familiar before the film begins. That is a viewing recommendation, not a stated admission requirement or a claim that the movie continues a specific season finale. Are advance tickets available in Japan? The production's official ticket page announced online sales of a teaser-visual advance ticket card beginning August 17, 2026 at 2:00 p.m. Japan time. It lists a general price of ¥1,500 including tax, with shipping charged separately for online orders. That announcement concerns a Japanese ticket product, not international theater dates. Availability and other ticket versions can change, so check the official ticket and local cinema listings before purchasing. Overseas release dates and a later streaming launch still require separate distributor announcements. What details are still unconfirmed? As of October 23, the official release information confirms the Japanese opening date, core staff, returning leads and the new character cast. A runtime, age rating, international cinema dates by country, subtitle options and a home-streaming date should not be assumed from the Japanese listing. Those details can arrive later from local distributors or theaters. If you are planning a cinema visit outside Japan, check your country’s exhibitor or distributor listing instead of converting December 11 into a worldwide date. How the movie fits beside Season 3 Season 3 and the movie are separate projects with separate release schedules. Season 3 began in October 2026, while the film is scheduled for Japanese theaters in December. The movie has its own original mystery, so its release should be tracked separately from the television cour and its weekly episodes. A theatrical date also says nothing by itself about home video or streaming. Where to find confirmed viewing information Check the official movie staff and cast page for production details and TOHO’s theatrical release lineup for the Japanese opening. Crunchyroll’s international distribution announcement is relevant for overseas cinema availability. Neither source confirms a universal streaming date. For the TV installment, see our Season 3 schedule guide . To compare other December premieres, browse the December 2026 anime calendar . Release information in this guide reflects official announcements available on October 23, 2026. The December 11 date applies to Japanese theaters. International theatrical dates and streaming availability remain region-specific and should be reported only when separately confirmed. entries.content: SEASON 3 · OCTOBER 2, 2026 The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Schedule & Where to Watch The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 is in its first cour: overall episode 52 aired October 23, and the official calendar lists episode 53 for October 30 at 11:40 p.m. JST. Here’s how the split-cour plan, April 2027 return and streaming schedule fit together. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official Season 3 key visual. Source: the anime’s Season 3 portal . © Natsu Hyūga, Imagica Infos / The Apothecary Diaries Production Committee. Release at a glance Season 3 premiere October 2, 2026 in Japan Next listed episode Overall episode 53 · October 30 at 11:40 p.m. JST Studio and broadcaster OLM · Nippon TV Friday Anime Night, nationwide 30-network broadcast Second cour April 2027 · exact date not announced Where to watch Japanese platforms after broadcast; Crunchyroll in supported international territories Schedule checked October 24, 2026 · Official broadcast and streaming schedule When is the next episode of The Apothecary Diaries Season 3? The official October calendar lists overall episode 53 for Friday, October 30, 2026, at 11:40 p.m. Japan Standard Time . Episode 52 aired on October 23. The series numbering continues from the first two seasons, so episode 53 is the fifth episode of Season 3, not the 53rd episode of this season. The October 30 slot is later than the regular Friday 11:00 p.m. Japanese broadcast listed for Season 3. That distinction matters if you are matching an episode page to a local clock: the Japanese television time and a streaming service’s regional release time may differ. Japan Standard Time is UTC+9; October 30 at 11:40 p.m. JST is 10:40 a.m. in the Dominican Republic and US Eastern Daylight Time. This is the Japanese broadcast conversion, not a promise of the exact time your app will publish the episode. What is the Season 3 release schedule? Season 3 is planned as a split cour . The first cour began on October 2, 2026, while the second cour is scheduled to begin in April 2027 . The official site has not announced the second cour’s exact date, number of episodes or weekly time slot yet. Related reading: The Apothecary Diaries Movie: Luoqing and Yinshan Character PV . A split cour is a planned break within the same season. The April return does not mean that a separately numbered Season 4 has been ordered, and it does not tell viewers the exact week the second block will start. The calendar marks the Season 3 premiere on October 2, then lists overall episode 50 on October 9, #51 on October 16, #52 on October 23 and #53 on October 30; the final listing carries the 11:40 p.m. time change. Check the official schedule again before relying on later dates, since the portal says broadcast times can change. Where can you watch the new episodes? In Japan, the official Season 3 page says episodes stream progressively after the television broadcast. Its streaming section lists Japanese services including ABEMA Premium, Amazon Prime Video, Disney+, Hulu, Netflix, U-NEXT and others; the list is for Japan and should not be read as a global licensing announcement. Related reading: Black Clover Season 2 Schedule & Where to Watch . For international viewers, Crunchyroll’s official Season 3 guide lists the series in supported territories and announced the first episode for October 2 at 8:00 a.m. Pacific Time. The service’s individual episode listing showed episode 52 on October 23. Catalog rights, language options and release clocks can differ by country, so search the app while signed into your own region. Do not assume that the 11:40 p.m. JST broadcast slot is the local Crunchyroll release time. What is the story about this season? The new season carries Maomao and Jinshi’s story beyond the rear palace, widening the setting to the common world and a neighboring country. Official material teases signs of a disaster, a mysterious shrine maiden and new responsibilities placed on Jinshi. Those are the season’s announced story hooks; the production has not published a complete episode-by-episode adaptation outline. Related reading: Dandivine Release Date & Where to Watch: Japan Schedule, Cast and Story . For new viewers, the court mysteries build on relationships and discoveries from the earlier seasons. Watching Seasons 1 and 2 first makes the political stakes and Maomao’s changing relationship with Jinshi easier to follow. Season 3 is a continuation, not a reset or a standalone entry. What do the trailer and theme songs confirm? The official main trailer is on the verified TOHO animation channel. It introduces the season’s atmosphere and features the opening theme by Yorushika, titled 雲を抜け風下へ私だけ . The video’s original upload timestamp is August 15, 2026, at 04:23:17 PDT (11:23:17 UTC) ; AniNextUp records the exact timestamp and offset in the VideoObject metadata. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Opens on YouTube A later second promotional video announced Eve’s ending theme, AIYOU . These are separate music credits: Yorushika performs the opening, while Eve performs the ending. The official music page and October announcement are linked in the sources below. Who returns in the main cast? Aoi Yūki returns as Maomao and Takeo Ōtsuka as Jinshi, the two central performances listed on the official Season 3 cast page. OLM handles the animation. These credits come from the Season 3 production page; the separate movie has its own announcements, so its cast updates should not be mistaken for a TV-season change. How does the December movie connect to Season 3? The franchise’s first theatrical film, The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure , is scheduled for December 11, 2026 in Japan. It is a separate film project with an original story concept by Natsu Hyūga, not the second cour of Season 3. See our movie guide for its trailer, characters and theatrical release details. Frequently asked questions When does episode 53 air? The official calendar lists October 30, 2026, at 11:40 p.m. JST. Check your streaming service for its own regional time. When does Season 3 return after the first cour? The second cour is scheduled for April 2027. An exact day has not been announced. How many episodes are in Season 3? The official split-cour announcement does not give a total episode count. Episode 53 is the overall series number, not the season’s episode count. Is Season 3 available on Crunchyroll? Yes, in territories where Crunchyroll carries it. Availability and language options vary by country. entries.title: Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 4 Anime Officially Announced
entries.description: Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 4, the Royal Academy arc, is officially getting a TV anime from WIT Studio. Release date and streaming are still TBA.
entries.content: SEQUEL ANNOUNCED · OCTOBER 7, 2026 Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 4 Anime Officially Announced Ascendance of a Bookworm is continuing into the story's Part 4, the Royal Academy arc. The new TV anime is officially confirmed, and WIT Studio will continue handling animation production. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases RELEASE TV ANIME · DATE TBA Is Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 4 getting an anime? Yes. The official anime site confirmed that the story will continue with a TV anime adaptation of the Royal Academy's Self-Proclaimed Library Committee arc, the next major part of Rozemyne's story after Adopted Daughter of an Archduke . When is Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 4 coming out? No release date or broadcast window has been announced yet. The announcement confirms the TV anime itself and its returning animation studio, but fans should treat any specific premiere date circulating online as unconfirmed until the production publishes one. Which studio is making Part 4? WIT Studio will continue as the animation production studio. That gives the new arc production continuity with the 2026 Adopted Daughter of an Archduke anime, rather than returning to the studio configuration used for the earlier seasons. What will the Royal Academy arc cover? The official synopsis begins after Rozemyne awakens from roughly two years of sleep. She is soon sent to the Royal Academy, where nobles study magic, magic tools and the skills expected of future rulers. For Rozemyne, however, the discovery of a large academy library immediately becomes a major attraction. The setting matters because it expands the series beyond Ehrenfest's familiar circles: new teachers, students from other duchies and the academy's political structure give Rozemyne a much larger world to navigate while she continues pursuing books. Why the Royal Academy changes the setting Rozemyne's move to the Royal Academy places her among nobles from other duchies and introduces an institution devoted to magical education. The academy library is an immediate attraction for her, but the larger setting also means unfamiliar social rules and political relationships. The announcement identifies the arc; it does not yet supply an episode count. Related reading: One-Punch Man Season 3 Part 2: January 2027 Release, New Trailer and JAM Project Opening . What newcomers should know about the arc title The Royal Academy's Self-Proclaimed Library Committee is the name of the announced story arc, not a confirmation of a particular international season number. Rozemyne's earlier experiences in Ehrenfest and her adoption into noble society provide the context for the academy's new social environment. Viewers starting here may therefore miss why her love of books can clash with expectations placed on a noble student. The official announcement identifies the next arc but does not specify its episode count or how international platforms will label it. Is this Season 5? English-language naming for Ascendance of a Bookworm can be confusing because the novels' “Parts” and the anime's seasons are not the same numbering system. The official announcement identifies the adaptation by its Part 4 / Royal Academy arc story title rather than announcing an English “Season 5” label. AniNextUp will use the official naming until international distributors establish their own season numbering. Will Part 4 stream on Crunchyroll? International streaming for the new Part 4 anime has not been announced. Previous anime installments are available through Crunchyroll in supported territories, but that does not by itself confirm the platform for this sequel. We will update this page when an official distributor announces streaming rights. Why this sequel announcement matters The franchise has surpassed 14 million copies in circulation, including digital editions , and the new announcement arrived directly after the latest anime moved Rozemyne toward the Royal Academy. Confirming WIT Studio at the same time makes this more than a vague sequel tease: the next story arc and animation production are both established. What remains unconfirmed? The production has not announced a premiere date, episode count, international streaming platform or a dedicated Part 4 trailer. Additional cast and detailed staff information for the new arc also remain subject to future announcements. Where can readers explore the original story? The anime adapts Miya Kazuki's Ascendance of a Bookworm novels, illustrated by You Shiina. English-language publisher J-Novel Club lists the books by story part and volume. Its Part 4 description places Rozemyne at the Royal Academy as an archduke candidate learning about magic and governance. Related reading: Armored Trooper VOTOMS: The Gray Witch Part 1 . The novel's part and volume labels are useful for finding the source material, but they do not establish the number of episodes in the new television adaptation. WIT Studio's announcement confirms the project and returning studio; a detailed broadcast schedule and international distribution remain separate announcements. Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 4 FAQ Has Part 4 been officially confirmed? Yes. The official anime production announced a new TV anime adapting the Royal Academy arc. Is WIT Studio returning? Yes. WIT Studio is officially confirmed to continue animation production. Does Part 4 have a release date? No. A release date and broadcast window are still TBA. Is there an official Part 4 trailer? Not yet. The announcement currently confirms the adaptation and studio rather than a new promotional video. AniNextUp status: TV anime adaptation and WIT Studio are confirmed. Release date, episode count and international streaming remain TBA. Updated: October 26, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error Release announcement: sequel confirmed at WIT Studio; release date still unannounced . Primary production announcement: WIT Studio continuation confirmation .

entries.content: NOVEMBER 3 · NETFLIX Bass X Machina: Official Full Trailer, Netflix Release Date & Cast Bass X Machina premieres globally on Netflix on November 3, 2026. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official full trailer thumbnail · Netflix. Release at a glance Release November 3, 2026 Where to watch Netflix worldwide, as announced by Netflix Applies to Global Netflix release Still pending Exact release hour Release details checked October 12, 2026 · Official source RELEASE November 3, 2026 STREAMING Netflix · Worldwide announced STUDIO Studio Mir How the frontier setting sharpens the central dilemma Bass X Machina combines a lawless Western landscape with machines and supernatural dangers, but its family-protection premise gives those elements a personal cost. The father's decisions may protect the people closest to him while also threatening their trust in him. That tension is a useful way to approach the story without predicting events not described in the official synopsis. When does Bass X Machina release? Bass X Machina premieres on Netflix on November 3, 2026. Netflix's official Annecy announcement lists November 3, 2026 as the release date. Netflix Japan's worldwide launch announcement separately announces the same date for a worldwide exclusive launch, so viewers elsewhere should check their local catalog. Where to watch Bass X Machina is a Netflix series. Availability is tied to Netflix's regional catalogs, so AniNextUp will keep the release guide updated if the service publishes territory-specific differences. Related reading: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers: Premiere, Cast, Streaming and Official Trailer . What is Bass X Machina about? The story takes place in a lawless steampunk West populated by violent outlaws, machines and supernatural threats. A father is forced into the roles of judge, jury and executioner while trying to protect his family, even as every violent decision risks pushing those same people away. Who is making the series? LeSean Thomas created the series and Studio Mir handles animation. Brian Tyree Henry stars and is also an executive producer alongside Thomas, Jennifer Wiley-Moxley and Chad Handley. The cast also includes Tati Gabrielle and Cree Summer. Related reading: In a World Full of Zombies Anime: January 2027 Premiere, New Trailer, Cast and Music . Watch the new official Netflix trailer Netflix has released a longer trailer ahead of the November 3 premiere. Its official title page now lists both the new full trailer and the earlier teaser separately. The release date remains unchanged. Official full trailer Watch the full trailer on Netflix . Earlier official teaser ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Netflix See all confirmed November 2026 releases → What the announced story and credits actually confirm Netflix describes Bass X Machina as a series set in a lawless steampunk West, where outlaws, machines and supernatural threats surround a father trying to protect his family. The premise gives the action a conflict beyond survival: his role as judge, jury and executioner may create distance between him and the people he wants to save. That is the central tension the official synopsis offers; it does not reveal how the family responds or how the story resolves it. LeSean Thomas created the series and Studio Mir is the animation studio. Brian Tyree Henry is both a star and an executive producer; Tati Gabrielle and Cree Summer are also in the announced cast. The executive producers listed by Netflix include Thomas, Henry, Jennifer Wiley-Moxley and Chad Handley. These credits help readers distinguish the creative roles: Thomas is the series creator, Studio Mir produces the animation, and Henry’s involvement extends beyond voice performance. Who else appears in Netflix's cast list? Alongside Brian Tyree Henry, Tati Gabrielle and Cree Summer, the Netflix title page lists Currie Graham, Chaske Spencer, Starletta DuPois, Nick Thurston, André Sogliuzzo, Anoli Scott and Lynette Willis. A list of performers is not necessarily a complete character guide: Netflix's public listing does not assign a role to every name. Is the series a Japanese television anime? Netflix describes Bass X Machina as an internationally produced animated series influenced by anime, created by LeSean Thomas and animated by Studio Mir. Its announcement places the project among Netflix's broader animation slate; it does not describe a Japanese television broadcast. The confirmed viewing plan is a Netflix launch, rather than a broadcast-station schedule. The platform classifies the series under adult animation, science fiction, action and fantasy, reflecting its combination of Western imagery and machines. Classification and age ratings can differ by region, so viewers should check the local Netflix page for the rating and available audio before watching. The title page distinguishes the earlier teaser from the longer Season 1 trailer. Both are promotional material for the same series, and neither confirms a separate premiere or a full episode count. Trailer, teaser and release date are separate updates Netflix has published an earlier teaser and a later full trailer. The two links on this page point to separate official uploads, so the teaser should not be mistaken for the newest footage. Neither video changes the release date: Netflix lists November 3, 2026 for the series, and its Anime NYC announcement describes the launch as a worldwide exclusive. A local catalog remains the final check for viewing in a specific country. At the time of this update, Netflix has not posted an exact release hour or a detailed episode rollout in the cited announcements. AniNextUp therefore lists the confirmed day and leaves the hour open. The phrase “worldwide” describes Netflix’s announced launch plan; it does not tell viewers what time the title becomes playable in every time zone or whether every language track is ready at the same moment. Primary distributor listing: Netflix Media Center, official synopsis . Additional official source: Netflix Japan Anime NYC 2026 announcement (worldwide November 3 launch) . Release and production credits: Netflix Annecy announcement: November 3, Studio Mir, creator and executive producers . Cast reference: Netflix title page: Brian Tyree Henry, Tati Gabrielle and Cree Summer . Full trailer and teaser listing: Netflix official title page .
