entries.content: JANUARY 2027 · NEW ANIME · OCTOBER 24, 2026 The True Saint Was Banished Anime: January 2027 & Trailer Because I, the True Saint, Was Banished, That Country Is Done For! begins Japanese television broadcasts in January 2027. The official announcement includes a teaser introducing Eliane and Nigel, with Masumi Tazawa and Taku Yashiro leading the cast. An exact premiere day and international streaming release have not been established by the cited announcements. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases ©Shikiso Utsuzawa, Kodansha / True Saint Production Committee. Official promotional image from the production website . Release at a glance Release window January 2027 · exact day TBA Studio Tsumugi Akita Anime Lab Lead Japanese cast Masumi Tazawa as Eliane; Taku Yashiro as Nigel Where to watch Japanese TV announced; overseas streaming TBA Official sources checked October 24, 2026 · Official website When does The True Saint Was Banished anime come out? The production confirmed a January 2027 television window in its October 3 official update . The notice also introduced the teaser and named the music composer. Bandai Namco Filmworks' V-STORAGE report reproduces the release information and production credits. A month-level announcement does not identify January 1 or any other first-episode day. Japanese broadcast times and any overseas release schedule still need their own confirmed listings. Related reading: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All Anime: January 8, 2027 Premiere and Trailer . Official teaser trailer The teaser uses Eliane's narration to introduce her circumstances and her meeting with Nigel. It also previews music credited to Harakanako. The video below is the exact teaser linked by the production's official news page. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TEASER Because I, the True Saint, Was Banished Video availability may vary by region. What is the story about? Eliane supports her kingdom as a saint, but Prince Claude breaks off their engagement and expels her. She decides to leave that relationship behind. After helping Nigel, a prince from a neighboring country, she is invited to stay at his castle and starts putting her abilities to use in a different setting. The official introduction frames the story around Eliane's fresh start. Her healing power matters, but the premise also centers on rebuilding her life after rejection. Confirmed Japanese cast and animation studio Masumi Tazawa voices Eliane, while Taku Yashiro plays Nigel. The production's character profiles describe Eliane as a capable, determined saint and Nigel as a considerate prince. Tsumugi Akita Anime Lab is producing the animation. Tsukasa Sakurai directs, Naoki Tozuka handles series composition and Naru Nishikori designs the characters. The music credit is Harakanako. These credits are listed on the official staff and cast section ; they do not specify an episode total. Which original work is being adapted? The source novels are written by Shikiso Utsuzawa with original character designs by Pukyunosuke. Mokuba Matsu draws the manga adaptation. The official books section distinguishes the novel and comic editions. Readers may also encounter the Japanese title Shin no Seijo de Aru Watashi wa Tsuihou Saremashita. Dakara Kono Kuni wa Mou Owari desu . Where will it stream? The cited production materials confirm Japanese television in January. They do not establish a worldwide Netflix, Crunchyroll or HIDIVE release. An international platform, territorial restrictions, subtitle languages and an English dub timetable need separate distributor confirmation. What information is still to come? The premiere day, full broadcast schedule and episode count are not established by these sources. Once additional details are announced, they should be incorporated into this guide, keeping the same article URL. For more confirmed announcements, browse our latest anime news and January 2027 anime guide . A Japanese broadcast announcement does not establish international streaming availability. How to read the teaser and source-material credits The official teaser introduces Eliane through her narration and shows her meeting Nigel, while the production notice confirms the composer and January 2027 window. Those promotional details help identify the project, but they do not reveal an episode total or how much of the source story the television season will adapt. The official books section lists the original novels and the manga separately; that distinction matters because a manga credit does not replace the novelist or establish that the anime follows a particular comic volume. Until the production names a story endpoint, readers should avoid using the number of published books to predict a finale or cour split. What to watch for in future release notices The next useful updates would be an exact Japanese premiere day, station and airtime, then any separate announcement from an international distributor. A date for the Japanese broadcast would not automatically set the time a subtitled stream appears in another territory. The official site and Bandai Namco Filmworks notice are the references used here; a regional service listing should be added only when that distributor confirms it. Why does Eliane leave her former kingdom? The official introduction adds context beyond the short “banished saint” premise. Eliane had served Belkaim as its true saint, but Prince Claude suddenly ends their engagement and expels her. The same introduction says she is tired of his mistreatment and infidelity, so leaving is also her decision to begin a different life. She later helps Nigel, the neighboring kingdom’s prince, after he is injured in a monster fight. His invitation to stay at his castle gives her a place to use her abilities without returning to the relationship she left. That setup makes the title’s promise of a happy restart more than a simple story of a royal punishment. Do you need to read the novels before watching? No prerequisite reading is named in the anime announcements. The official books section identifies Utsuzawa’s novels, Pukyunosuke’s original character designs and Matsu Mokuba’s manga adaptation as separate parts of the franchise. That is useful context if you want to compare versions, but it does not confirm that the anime will adapt a specific volume or follow every manga scene. New viewers can begin with the television series when it airs; readers interested in the source can choose the novels or manga according to the format they prefer. A later episode or adaptation announcement would be needed to map the anime to a precise book or chapter. Published: October 24, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error

entries.content: OFFICIAL ANIME NEWS · OCTOBER 15, 2026 Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 Confirmed for 2027: New Trailer and Streaming Details Fate Graphite's dark-fantasy journey continues in 2027. The anime's official website has posted a Season 2 teaser, while Crunchyroll has identified the regions where it plans to stream the sequel. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official Season 2 teaser video thumbnail, © Ichika Isshiki / Micro Magazine / Berserk of Gluttony production committee. Official announcement . Release at a glance Premiere 2027; exact date not announced Streaming Crunchyroll in announced territories New teaser Published October 9, 2026 on the official Japanese website Still pending Premiere day, broadcast time and regional simulcast schedule Details checked October 15, 2026 · Crunchyroll's NYCC announcement · Official anime website When is Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 coming out? Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 is scheduled for 2027. The official anime website announced the 2027 broadcast window on August 23, 2026, and Crunchyroll repeated that window at New York Comic Con on October 8. Neither announcement specifies a month or day. A particular premiere date circulating online should not be treated as confirmed until the production announces it. Where to watch Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 Crunchyroll has announced Season 2 streaming for North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East and the CIS. That regional list comes from Crunchyroll's October 8 announcement; it does not establish the precise launch hour or guarantee that every individual country has identical availability. Check your local Crunchyroll catalog when the premiere approaches. The distinction matters: a Japanese television broadcast window and an international streaming schedule are not automatically the same. At the time of this update, Crunchyroll has not supplied a universal episode release time. Related reading: Anime Releasing in December 2026: Confirmed Dates . What should viewers remember before Season 2? The continuation follows Fate and Greed after their earlier journey, so their partnership is useful context when approaching the new teaser. The footage promotes the next stage of their story, but it does not establish a precise 2027 premiere month or how many episodes the sequel will contain. Viewers catching up should treat Season 2 as a continuation rather than assuming the teaser explains the earlier character relationship. Watch the new official Season 2 teaser The official teaser released October 9, 2026 shows Fate and Greed preparing for the story's next stage. Watch the promotional video below, linked from the anime production's own announcement. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Season 2 teaser PV · Official production Read the original October 9 announcement . What is the sequel about? The series follows Fate Graphite, whose seemingly worthless Gluttony skill turns out to let him absorb the abilities and attributes of enemies he defeats. The new-season synopsis circulated by Crunchyroll places Fate back in the royal capital after dangerous battles alongside Greed, his sentient black sword. It also emphasizes the tension between his extraordinary powers and his desire for an ordinary life. This is a premise-level description, not an episode-by-episode account. The October announcements do not establish how many episodes Season 2 will have or precisely which light-novel volumes it will adapt. What has actually been confirmed? Production of Season 2 was announced on April 27, 2026, with a commemorative visual. The 2027 broadcast window followed in August, and the official website added a teaser in October. Crunchyroll's New York Comic Con presentation separately confirmed its planned streaming territories. These are different milestones; the October teaser should not be mistaken for an announcement of an exact release date. Who is making and voicing Season 2? The October production announcement credits Tetsuya Yanagisawa as chief director, Kenichi Ishikura as director, Mariko Kunisawa for series composition and Takafumi Furusawa for character design. ACGT is the animation studio. The Japanese cast listed for the new season includes Ryota Osaka as Fate, Tomokazu Seki as Greed, Hisako Tojo as Roxy, Misato Matsuoka as Myne, Hitomi Sekine as Eris and Takehito Koyasu as Aaron. These are production-announced Japanese voice credits, not confirmation of a new English dub cast. What is the anime based on? Seven Seas Entertainment publishes the English-language light novels, credited to Isshiki Ichika and illustrator fame. The publisher also releases a manga adaptation. Fate's Gluttony skill and its consequences provide the foundation of the dark fantasy story, while his relationship with the talking sword Greed carries into the anime's sequel. Readers interested in the original can use the publisher's listings to distinguish the novel and manga editions. The official Season 2 announcement has not specified which volumes or chapters the adaptation will cover, so a book's publication date should not be treated as an anime episode schedule. Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 FAQ Is Season 2 officially confirmed? Yes. The production announced a second season in April 2026 and later confirmed a 2027 broadcast window. Is there an exact release date? No. As of October 15, 2026, the official announcements identify 2027 but not a specific month or day. Will Season 2 be on Crunchyroll? Yes, Crunchyroll has announced the sequel for multiple regions. Exact local availability and timing may vary. Is the new trailer official? Yes. entries.content: SEASON 2 · OCTOBER 3, 2026 Black Clover Season 2 Schedule & Where to Watch Episode 4 (overall #174) arrived October 24. See Black Clover Season 2’s Saturday broadcast and streaming schedule, dub timing, episode order and official trailer. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official Season 2 campaign visual. Source: Black Clover anime portal . © Yūki Tabata / Shueisha, TV Tokyo, Black Clover Production Committee. Release at a glance Japanese premiere October 3, 2026 · Saturdays at 11:00 p.m. JST Current listed episode Episode 4 · #174 overall · October 24, 2026 Studio and director Studio Pierrot · Ayataka Tanemura Subtitled stream Crunchyroll · Saturdays at 8:00 a.m. Pacific in supported regions English dub Started October 17, 2026 · weekly on Crunchyroll Checked October 24, 2026 · Official broadcast and streaming schedule When did Black Clover Season 2 premiere? Black Clover Season 2 premiered in Japan on Saturday, October 3, 2026, at 11:00 p.m. JST on TV Tokyo and affiliated stations. The official broadcast page also lists BS TV Tokyo on October 7 at midnight. These are Japanese television times; a service in another country can publish an episode on a different local date or hour. Crunchyroll’s Fall 2026 schedule lists subtitled episodes on Saturdays at 8:00 a.m. Pacific Time in the territories where it carries the series. The first episode became available there on October 3. On October 24, the anime’s official story page listed episode 4, numbered episode 174 in the overall series. That is the current episode as of this guide’s check date, not a forecast for later weeks. Check your own Crunchyroll catalog for regional rights, subtitle options and any schedule notice before watching. Why is the new season on episode 174? The original television anime ran for 170 episodes. The current season continues that count: its first four listed installments are episodes 171, 172, 173 and 174. Some platforms or fan databases may label them Season 2 episodes 1–4, while the Japanese production site uses the continuing story numbers. Both labels can refer to the same episode, so look for the title and release date as well as the number when searching. The season is a continuation, not a reboot or a recap. Crunchyroll’s synopsis places Asta and the Magic Knights in a raid on the Spade Kingdom as they try to save their captains from the Dark Triad. New viewers will get more from that conflict if they first see the earlier anime, which introduces the squads, rivalries and magic system that drive the stakes. Related reading: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Schedule & Where to Watch . Where can you stream it? Crunchyroll is the international option listed for supported territories across North and South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, the CIS, the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia. This regional list does not mean the show is available in every country; licensing can differ, so check the service while signed into your location. The Japanese portal lists a separate domestic rollout. Anime Times, Lemino, U-NEXT and Anime Hodai began advance streaming on October 4 at noon JST. Other Japanese services began rolling out episodes from October 8 at noon, with additional free and rental listings. These details describe Japan’s platforms; they do not establish access outside Japan. The TV Tokyo broadcast, Japanese streaming windows and Crunchyroll’s international schedule are separate release clocks. Is the English dub available? Yes. Crunchyroll announced the Season 2 English dub with its first episode on October 17, followed by weekly dubbed episodes. The dub is a separate track and schedule from the Saturday subtitled simulcast; do not assume both versions appear at the same time. The initial English dub cast includes Dallas Reid as Asta, Micah Solusod as Yuno and Bryce Papenbrook as Liebe. Check the show’s episode selector to see which language tracks are available in your region. Related reading: Dandivine Release Date & Where to Watch: Japan Schedule, Cast and Story . What are the story and production details? Season 2 moves into the conflict with the Spade Kingdom and the Dark Triad, while Asta’s anti-magic and the Magic Knights’ teamwork remain central to the story. The official synopsis is a useful spoiler-light guide: the mission is to rescue captured captains. The episode list currently shows four entries, but the production site has not announced a total episode count in the material checked for this update. Treat claims about a 26-episode or split-cour run as unconfirmed unless the anime’s official channels publish them. Studio Pierrot continues the animation. Ayataka Tanemura directs, Keiichiro Ochi handles series composition, Itsuko Takeda designs the characters and Minako Seki composes the music. The official music page credits WANIMA with the opening theme “消えない理由” and ONE OR EIGHT with the ending theme “Yellow Brick Road.” These details help distinguish confirmed production information from speculation about how much manga material the season will adapt. Where can I watch the official trailer? Crunchyroll’s verified channel released “Black Clover Second Season | Official Trailer 3” on July 4, 2026. The original upload time shown on YouTube is 8:03:40 p.m. PDT (July 5 at 3:03:40 a.m. UTC). The trailer gives a look at the return without confirming the season’s total episode count. Use the linked official video rather than reuploads, which may have different dates or regional edits. Related reading: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Episode Schedule & Where to Watch . Black Clover Season 2 FAQ Is episode 174 the fourth episode of this season? Yes. The official site lists episodes 171 through 174 for the first four installments of the second season. Does the season have a confirmed episode count? The official materials checked here do not state a total. A reported or predicted count is not confirmation. When do new subtitled episodes arrive on Crunchyroll? Crunchyroll’s Fall 2026 lineup lists Saturday at 8:00 a.m. Pacific Time in supported regions. Local availability and schedule changes can vary. Related reading: Fall 2026 Anime Release Schedule & Calendar: October–December 2026 . Should I watch the first season first? Yes. Season 2 continues the existing story and relies on the Magic Knights, their squads and the conflict built earlier. Start with the original run if you want the character relationships and stakes in context. For more seasonal listings, see AniNextUp’s Fall 2026 calendar and our guide to A Returner’s Magic Should Be Special Season 2 . Release schedules can change; use the official broadcast and streaming pages linked below for the latest regional details. entries.title: BLEACH × Graniph: 17-Item Collection Launches in Japan on October 20
entries.description: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War and Graniph launched 17 Shikai-themed items in Japan on October 20, 2026. Check designs, current stock, sizing and the ended preorder window.
entries.content: OFFICIAL MERCHANDISE NEWS · OCTOBER 14, 2026 BLEACH × Graniph: 17-Item Collection Launches in Japan on October 20 BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War and Graniph launched 17 Shikai-themed items in Japan on October 20, 2026. Check designs, current stock, sizing and the ended preorder window. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official collaboration artwork from Graniph’s BLEACH collection , displayed in AniNextUp’s 16:9 cover frame. Artwork and product imagery remain the property of their respective rights holders. Release at a glance Collection BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War × Graniph Collection size 17 items Online preorder October 14 at 12:00 a.m. through October 19 at 11:59 p.m. Japan Standard Time Japanese store release October 20, 2026 Purchase limit Two per customer for selected product categories, October 14–20 Official retailer Graniph online store and Japanese shops Details checked against official sources on October 25, 2026. The reservation window and temporary purchase limits have ended; live stock and shipping terms may change. What did BLEACH and Graniph announce? BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War and Japanese apparel label Graniph launched a 17-item collaboration on October 20, 2026. The collection is built around the Shikai, or released form, of characters’ Zanpakuto, with additional designs pairing the anime with Graniph’s original character Beautiful Shadow. It is a licensed fashion and goods collection, not a new season, episode announcement, or anime release date. The official announcement names Graniph’s online store and its domestic shops as the sales channels. The date is therefore a Japanese market launch. The announcement does not promise a separate release in North America, Europe, or other territories, and it does not confirm that every size or design remains in stock after launch. What does the Shikai theme mean for the designs? In BLEACH , a Zanpakuto is a Soul Reaper’s weapon, and Shikai is the first released state associated with its wielder. Graniph uses that idea as a visual design brief: the collection page presents the series’ sword imagery and character motifs as wearable graphics. The theme links the merchandise to the anime without requiring a buyer to treat each item as a plot summary or a new story reveal. Related reading: A Certain Dark Item Release Date & Where to Watch . Examples in Graniph’s official photo gallery include a Gotei 13 Shikai T-shirt, a long-sleeve design named for Zabimaru, a Kyoka Suigetsu stadium jacket, a Senbonzakura hoodie, and a Hyorinmaru mini shoulder bag. Other photos show Urahara Shop and “Death God Agent Shadow” designs. Graniph also lists selected items featuring Beautiful Shadow, so not every piece is a sword graphic. What kinds of products are included? The official gallery shows the 17-piece lineup across several everyday categories rather than a single T-shirt run. Its pictured products include short- and long-sleeve tops, sweatshirts and hoodies, a stadium jacket, a knit cardigan, a mini shoulder bag, a wallet, and a charm. The collection page is the authoritative place to check which other styles are available; the gallery is useful for seeing how the designs look when worn or displayed. Some graphics rely on a character or weapon name, while others combine series iconography with a Graniph character. For example, the Gotei 13 Shikai T-shirt’s official description says it arranges the captains’ Zanpakuto into the word BLEACH and prints silhouettes of Ichigo and his companions on the back. That product-level detail is more useful than assuming every garment uses the same front print. Related reading: BLEACH: THE LAST PV, Episode 50 Date & Where to Watch . How much does it cost, and how should you check sizing? Prices and stock are listed by individual product, so a single collection-wide price can become misleading as listings change. When checked on October 25, Graniph’s Gotei 13 Shikai T-shirt page showed a price of ¥3,900 and sizes from SS through XXL, but marked that specific item sold out. This is a dated example, not a promise that other products have the same price or stock status. Use each product page for the current size chart, material, care details, and inventory. For that T-shirt, Graniph describes a standard-weight cotton jersey, slight stretch, and a 100% cotton composition; its size table gives garment measurements rather than a body-size guarantee. Compare those measurements with a shirt you already own, and check the listing again before traveling to a shop because store inventory can differ from the online page. Are preorders or purchase bonuses still available? The advance online reservation window ran from October 14 at 12:00 a.m. through October 19 at 11:59 p.m. Japan Standard Time. Graniph advertised double membership points for reservations during that window. Both the reservation period and that points offer have ended; they should not be presented as current promotions. Related reading: d Anime Store Announces 81 Anime Titles for Fall 2026 in Japan . The wider collection launched online and in Graniph’s Japanese shops on October 20. A temporary purchase limit also applied from October 14 through October 20 to caps, shoulder bags, mini shoulder bags, wallets, and charms, with a maximum of two per person in those categories. That dated limit has expired. Check the live listing or ask the shop about today’s availability and any new store-specific restrictions. Can fans outside Japan order the collection? The announcement confirms sales through Graniph’s online shop and domestic Japanese stores, but it does not provide a territory-by-territory shipping list or guarantee international delivery. Overseas buyers should set their location in Graniph’s official store and proceed only if checkout accepts their address. Before paying, confirm the displayed currency, delivery charge, import taxes, return terms, and whether the selected item can ship to the destination. A Japanese launch announcement by itself does not establish overseas availability. Fans who cannot order directly can monitor the official product pages for restocks or ask a local retailer whether it has a legitimate regional arrangement. Treat resale listings as separate offers: the official collaboration page does not set their prices or guarantee their authenticity. Related reading: Dandivine Release Date & Where to Watch: Japan Schedule, Cast and Story . Is this connected to a new BLEACH anime trailer? No separate anime premiere is part of the Graniph announcement. The official collaboration links to the collection catalog, a special-photo gallery, and Graniph’s social accounts. It does not describe a new episode, cour, streaming platform, or anime trailer. The Shikai references explain the clothing designs; they are not evidence of new footage. The anime itself is a separate story: the official Graniph description notes that the final Thousand-Year Blood War cour began airing in Japan on July 25, 2026. Fans searching for episode schedules or the series’ official PV should use the anime’s own news and broadcast pages, rather than treating this merchandise launch as a release update. AniNextUp’s related BLEACH episode guide covers that separate announcement. Official sources BLEACH official announcement: 17-item Graniph collaboration Graniph collection catalog, release date, and purchase-limit notice Graniph special-photo gallery and product examples Graniph Gotei 13 Shikai T-shirt product page, price, sizes, and stock snapshot Graniph press release with preorder dates and terms Updated: October 25, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error

entries.title: BLEACH: THE LAST PV, Episode 50 Date & Where to Watch
entries.description: Find BLEACH THE LAST PV's exact upload time, Japan TV dates for episodes 49 and 50, subtitle and dub schedules, and where to check availability.
entries.content: OFFICIAL TRAILER NEWS · OCTOBER 16, 2026 BLEACH: THE LAST PV, Episode 50 Date & Where to Watch BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War released its official “THE LAST PV” on October 16. Japan’s broadcast schedule lists episode 50 for October 26 at 24:00 JST (midnight at the start of October 27); VIZ lists the U.S. subtitled stream at 8:30 a.m. PDT. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official main visual for the final cour, published by Aniplex on June 21, 2026 . The October 16 PV is embedded below. © Tite Kubo / Shueisha / TV Tokyo / dentsu / Pierrot. RELEASE AT A GLANCE Episodes 49 and 50 · final two episodes of the television adaptation Japan TV: Oct 19 and Oct 26 at 24:00 JST · Episode 50 subtitles: Oct 26 at 8:30 a.m. PDT on Hulu on Disney+ in the U.S.; Disney+ availability varies internationally. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER BLEACH official website What is BLEACH: THE LAST PV? BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War released “THE LAST PV” on October 16, 2026. It is a promotional video for the closing stretch of the television adaptation, not an announcement of another season. The official anime site presents it alongside the final two episode dates: episode 49 and episode 50. The subtitle “The Calamity” is used for the final part in VIZ’s viewing guide, while the Japanese broadcast page identifies the numbered episodes and their Japanese TV times. The original video is on the official BLEACH anime channel and is linked from the anime website’s October 16 notice . YouTube’s published metadata records its upload at 4:00:38 a.m. PDT (UTC−07:00) on October 16 , or 11:00:38 UTC. This is the video’s timestamp, not an estimate from the article’s date. The PV runs 1 minute 42 seconds on the official video page. It promotes the final conflict without changing the confirmed broadcast schedule. When do episodes 49 and 50 air in Japan? The official Japan broadcast schedule lists episode 49 for Monday, October 19, 2026 at 24:00 JST on the TV Tokyo network. Japanese schedules sometimes use 24:00 to mean midnight at the end of the named date: viewers should read this slot as the start of Tuesday, October 20. Episode 50 is listed for Monday, October 26 at 24:00 JST, which is midnight at the start of Tuesday, October 27. BS TV Tokyo’s corresponding slots are October 20 and 27 at 24:30 JST. That distinction matters when searching for “BLEACH episode 50 release date.” The date printed beside the Japanese weekday is October 26, but the clock crosses into October 27. If a local guide converts the slot to a different calendar date, it may be expressing the same broadcast time rather than reporting a postponement. The official page also notes that other Japanese stations publish their own schedules, so the TV Tokyo listing should not be assumed to cover every channel. Related reading: BLEACH × Graniph: 17-Item Collection Launches in Japan on October 20 . Where can viewers stream the final two subtitled episodes? For the United States, VIZ says episodes 49 and 50 stream on Hulu on Disney+ at 8:30 a.m. PDT on October 19 and October 26, respectively. VIZ’s guide lists Disney+ internationally for subtitles in English, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, German and French. Platform catalogs can differ by territory, so “Disney+ internationally” does not guarantee that every language or episode appears at the same local time in every country. As of October 25, episode 49’s scheduled subtitled release date has passed. Episode 50 is due the next day on the schedule published by VIZ. Check the service available in your country and its episode listing if the title does not appear at the U.S. time; AniNextUp cannot infer regional access from a Japan broadcast listing. When do the English and other dubs arrive? The dub schedule is separate from the subtitled release. VIZ lists the English and Spanish Hulu dubs of episode 49 for Monday, November 23, at 8:30 a.m. PDT and episode 50 for Monday, November 30, at the same time. For Disney+, VIZ lists English, Spanish, Portuguese and German dubs on those November dates, with French dubs scheduled for December 14 and 21. VIZ describes the Disney+ availability as applying in select international markets; check the local catalog rather than assuming all language tracks are offered in each country. Related reading: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Episode Schedule & Where to Watch . These later dub dates do not mean the Japanese broadcast has moved. They are localization release windows for the same episodes. The page currently gives dates for the final two dubbed installments but does not supply a single universal launch time for every Disney+ territory, so the exact local clock time remains dependent on the service’s regional listing. What does the PV confirm about the story? The title and official caption frame the footage as Ichigo Kurosaki’s final battle, involving the Human World, Soul Society and Hueco Mundo. The premise is consistent with the final part’s endgame conflict, but a trailer is not a scene-by-scene episode synopsis. It does not verify every fan interpretation of a shot, nor does it establish changes to the manga’s ending. Viewers avoiding spoilers can watch the short PV for its promotional footage, while readers looking for a complete plot summary should wait for the episodes or consult an official synopsis. Is episode 50 the series finale? The production’s October 16 post calls the broadcast schedule the final two episodes, and VIZ labels episodes 49 and 50 the final two subtitled episodes of The Final Part . Taken together, the official notices identify episode 50 as the closing installment of this television adaptation. They do not announce an additional episode after it. Separate commemorative events or merchandise announcements are not evidence of more story episodes. Related reading: Nia Liston Anime Release Date, 25-Episode Count & Where to Watch . What is still unknown? The official sources confirm the PV, its date and exact upload time, Japan’s final two broadcast slots, VIZ’s subtitled schedule and several dub dates. They do not provide a universal streaming launch time for all countries, confirm that every territory carries every language, or announce a new BLEACH production after episode 50. Any claim of a follow-up anime or film needs a separate official announcement. For the most reliable updates, use the official BLEACH anime news page for Japanese announcements, the official broadcast schedule for Japan, and VIZ’s Part 4 streaming guide for regional subtitle and dub information. AniNextUp will update this page if those sources publish a revised schedule or new project details. AniNextUp status: Episode 49’s listed subtitle date was October 19. Episode 50 is scheduled for October 26 at 8:30 a.m. PDT on Hulu on Disney+ in the U.S., with Japan’s TV Tokyo slot at 24:00 JST. Dub releases follow in November and December; country availability and local listing times vary. Updated: October 25, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error Primary sources: official October 16 PV notice ; official BLEACH anime channel video and upload metadata ; official Japanese broadcast schedule ; VIZ streaming and dub schedule ; Aniplex final-cour visual credit .

entries.title: Bless Anime Reveals Koki Uchiyama as Akiharu Nakano Ahead of January 2027 Premiere
entries.description: The Bless anime has cast Koki Uchiyama as Akiharu Nakano and released a new character preview. Here's what is confirmed about its January 2027 debut.
entries.content: OFFICIAL CAST NEWS · JANUARY 2027 Bless Anime Reveals Koki Uchiyama as Akiharu Nakano Ahead of January 2027 Premiere The upcoming fashion-and-makeup drama Bless has introduced another character ahead of its Japanese television premiere in January 2027. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Published: October 15, 2026 · Our editorial policy Official teaser visual · © Yukino Sonoyama, Kodansha / Bless Production Committee. Source: official anime website . Release at a glance Premiere January 2027 in Japan; exact day not announced Broadcast Fuji TV's noitaminA programming block Studio A-1 Pictures New cast Koki Uchiyama as Akiharu Nakano Streaming Crunchyroll — worldwide excluding Japan and China; January 2027 What is new in the Bless anime announcement? On October 15, 2026, the production introduced Akiharu Nakano (Nakano Akiharu), a first-year high-school student who studies makeup with the Mirror group. Koki Uchiyama voices the character. A new character promotional video featuring his voice was released alongside the casting news. This is a character-focused preview, not a new full-series trailer. According to the character profile distributed with the announcement, Nakano is quiet, highly skilled and fast at makeup application. He greatly admires Hikaru Oya, another figure associated with the academy. The update is part of the production's series of weekly character introductions. Is the Akiharu Nakano video a new series trailer? No. The October 15 announcement from Aniplex identifies this as a character PV that reveals Koki Uchiyama's performance as Akiharu Nakano. It does not replace a full-series trailer or establish a specific first-episode date. The separately confirmed television window remains January 2027 in Japan. When does Bless premiere? Bless is scheduled to begin airing in January 2027 on Fuji TV’s noitaminA block in Japan. An exact day is not specified in the official production listings checked for this October 26 update. International streaming is now confirmed: Crunchyroll announced on October 22 that it will stream the series worldwide excluding Japan and China. This supersedes the earlier version of this article, which said no platform had been announced. Related reading: Le Collège Noir Season 2 Trailer Revealed Ahead of October 31 Premiere . What is Bless about? Based on Yukino Sonoyama's manga, the story follows Aia Udagawa, a former model who has lost confidence in his dream of becoming a makeup artist, and Jun Sumisaki, a student who wants to model but struggles to take the first step. A school festival competition becomes a turning point for both, as they begin pursuing their ambitions through makeup and fashion. The series is being animated by A-1 Pictures . Shotaro Kitamura directs, with series composition and scripts credited to Fukuro Kamiza , character designs by Honoka Yokoyama and music by Ryo Yoshimata . Watch Akiharu Nakano's official character PV ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL CHARACTER PV Akiharu Nakano · Koki Uchiyama Where can fans watch the official character video? The latest character promotional video is reported in the October 15 casting announcement. Readers can follow the video and casting update through the official Bless anime website and the October 15 announcement coverage . The official character PV is embedded above. What happens next? The next scheduling detail to watch for is a specific January premiere day. The month, Japanese programming block and Crunchyroll license are confirmed; a complete episode timetable, dubbing schedule and total episode count are not established by the announcements cited here. Official sources Bless TV anime official website · A-1 Pictures official production listing · October 15 cast announcement and character preview report . Explore more verified announcements in AniNextUp Anime News and upcoming premieres in the anime release calendar . What Uchiyama says about playing Nakano In his comment published by Aniplex on October 15 , Uchiyama says the makeup and modeling world was unfamiliar territory for him when he encountered the manga. He describes enjoying that fresh perspective and being pleased to join an anime dealing with an unusual subject. He also identifies Nakano as a high-school student learning makeup at Mirror who deeply respects Hikaru Oya. His acting approach centers on expressing what the reserved character carries inside. That is a useful distinction for readers meeting Nakano through a short preview: saying little does not mean having little motivation. The announcement offers a starting point for understanding the performance, without revealing how Nakano's relationships or ambitions will develop across the adaptation. Why Mirror matters to the story Kodansha's official description of the second manga volume introduces Mirror as a school for aspiring makeup artists. For Aia, entering that environment means encountering other people with the same professional goal, including potential rivals. Jun's modeling ambitions continue alongside his training, with the publisher describing her attempts to enter casting calls and build on their work together. This background explains why a supporting student's introduction matters beyond adding another name to the cast. Mirror broadens the story's focus from an individual dream to the pressures of learning a craft around talented peers. These are elements of the source manga's published premise, rather than confirmation that the anime will adapt a particular volume in full or follow an announced chapter-by-chapter schedule. Hikaru Oya has also received a cast announcement There has been another relevant update since Nakano's introduction. Aniplex announced on October 22 that Tarusuke Shingaki voices Hikaru Oya, accompanied by Oya's own character PV. Keeping the announcements separate avoids confusing the two roles: Uchiyama plays Nakano, while Shingaki plays the figure Nakano admires. In his accompanying comment, Shingaki describes Oya watching Aia with feelings that include admiration and frustration. That provides another official perspective on the cast's relationships while leaving their development for the series itself. Neither casting update establishes a new premiere day. Reading Bless before the anime Kodansha USA publishes the manga in English in print and digital formats. Its series introduction emphasizes Aia and Jun challenging other people's expectations of their appearance and abilities. Readers interested in the underlying story can begin with the first volume; the character PV is promotional material for the adaptation, rather than a substitute for that opening narrative. Sources checked October 26, 2026. Updated to include Crunchyroll's October 22 streaming announcement and the official Hikaru Oya casting news. entries.title: Blue Box Season 2: Release Date & Where to Watch
entries.description: Blue Box Season 2 began October 4, 2026 on Netflix. Check the weekly schedule, Japan broadcast time, Yumeka, cast, studio and official trailer.
entries.content: OCTOBER 4 · 2026 Blue Box Season 2: Release Date & Where to Watch Blue Box Season 2 began its weekly Netflix rollout on October 4, 2026. Here are the verified Japanese broadcast time, story context, Yumeka’s role, returning cast and official trailer. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official Season 2 trailer thumbnail. Source: Netflix Anime . © Kouji Miura/Shueisha, Blue Box Production Committee. WHERE TO WATCH Netflix Release at a glance Release October 4, 2026 Where to watch Netflix; weekly episodes Japan TV Sundays, 4:30 p.m. JST; TBS network Director / studio Daisuke Sakou / Electric Circus Release details checked October 24, 2026 · Netflix’s October anime lineup When did Blue Box Season 2 start? Blue Box Season 2 premiered on October 4, 2026, with new episodes weekly on Netflix. Netflix's September 15 lineup announcement names the premiere and release pattern. The Japanese anime website independently confirms an October 4 television start on the TBS network. For viewers catching up now, that means the season is in a weekly rollout rather than a complete-season drop. The premiere date marks the beginning of the schedule; it does not mean every episode became available that day. Check the episode list in your own Netflix catalog before planning a full-season marathon. What time does Blue Box air in Japan? The official Japanese schedule lists Sundays at 4:30 p.m. Japan Standard Time on the TBS network's 28 stations. JST is UTC+09:00, so that broadcast slot corresponds to 7:30 a.m. UTC. This is a Japanese television time, not a verified Netflix release time for other countries. Netflix's announcement does not provide a territory-by-territory clock time. Converting the TBS broadcast into your local timezone therefore does not establish when a new Netflix episode will unlock. The regional Netflix episode listing remains the appropriate place to check streaming availability. Where can you watch the new season? Netflix confirms the weekly Season 2 release. Its official trailer also directs viewers to the service. The Japanese website separately lists domestic streaming services and warns that starting dates can vary by platform. Those Japanese distribution listings should not be treated as international licensing announcements. If Season 2 is absent from your catalog, check the season selector on the existing Blue Box title page and confirm your regional listing. This guide does not promise identical availability, subtitle choices or dubbing options in every country. Those details can change independently of the Japanese broadcast schedule. What is the story, without major spoilers? Blue Box follows Taiki Inomata, a badminton player at Eimei High, and Chinatsu Kano, the older student whose dedication to basketball catches his attention. Their relationship changes when Chinatsu starts living with Taiki's family. School, training and the awkwardness of sharing everyday space give the romance its setting. The useful distinction for newcomers is that the sports are part of the characters' lives, not simply a backdrop for dating. Taiki's ambition and Chinatsu's commitment create reasons for early mornings, missed opportunities and difficult conversations. Watching how those commitments affect their choices is a stronger starting point than expecting the season to focus only on confessions. Who is Yumeka, and why does she matter? Netflix highlights Yumeka as the new character complicating Taiki and Chinatsu's story. The official character profile identifies Yumeka Kido as Chinatsu's former mini-basketball teammate . She is a gifted player whom Chinatsu admired; the two grew apart after Yumeka moved because of family circumstances. That history gives her arrival a connection to Chinatsu's sporting identity, beyond introducing another face into the school cast. It is worth remembering that connection while watching, but the promotional premise does not settle how the characters' disagreements will end. This guide avoids importing later manga outcomes into the anime's release information. Should you finish Season 1 first? Yes. Season 2 continues an established relationship and school-sports story. Start with Season 1 to understand the household arrangement and the friendships around Taiki, Chinatsu and Hina. A trailer can remind a returning viewer of the atmosphere, but it cannot replace the gradual changes that make the sequel's interactions meaningful. The original manga is by Kouji Miura. VIZ publishes the English edition and offers an official series page for readers who want to explore the source material. We are not assigning a manga chapter as the anime's continuation point: the sources reviewed here do not establish an exact Season 2 adaptation endpoint. Who makes Season 2? Netflix names Daisuke Sakou as director and Electric Circus as the animation studio , matching the Season 2 credits on the Japanese website. Shoya Chiba returns as Taiki and Reina Ueda as Chinatsu. The official Japanese cast listing also credits Yoshino Aoyama as Yumeka. The official music announcement names aiko's “Anata no Hana no Iro” as the opening and Elsewhere Kikou's “blue in” as the ending. These credits help distinguish the sequel's production information from Season 1 material that may still appear in older search results. Watch the official Netflix Anime trailer Netflix Anime published the official trailer on August 31, 2026 at 5:00:01 p.m. UTC−07:00 , equivalent to September 1 at 00:00:01 UTC. This exact timestamp comes from the original YouTube upload metadata. The trailer runs two minutes and fifteen seconds. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Netflix Anime Episode count and finale: what is still unknown? The Netflix lineup announcement confirms weekly episodes but does not give a complete Season 2 episode count or a finale date. We will not calculate an ending date from an assumed number of episodes. Broadcast changes and regional streaming updates must be checked against official notices as the season progresses. For a practical catch-up plan, watch the episodes already listed in your region, then use Netflix's next-episode information for the following release. Do not confuse an incomplete weekly catalog with a missing second part, and do not assume a break has been announced merely because the full season is not yet visible. For other viewing plans, our Aoashi Season 2 guide covers another sports sequel, while the My Happy Marriage special-episode guide explains a different Netflix release format. entries.content: COUR 2 · WEEKLY GUIDE Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Cour 2 Release Date & Time Japan’s second cour began October 13, 2026. Here are the verified broadcast times, domestic streaming schedule and story context. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official Cour 2 artwork. Source: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle anime site . Release at a glance Release October 13, 2026; second cour Where to watch Japan: see the official schedule below Applies to Cour 2 premiere; episode 13.5 recap is separate Still pending International streaming times are not listed on the official schedule Release details checked October 24, 2026 · Official source RELEASE October 13, 2026 STREAMING Japan · official listings STUDIO feel. Quick answer: Cour 2 is already underway Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Cour 2 began in Japan on October 13, 2026. The official schedule lists weekly Tuesday broadcasts, with different local stations starting at different times. It is the continuation of the same split-cour adaptation, rather than an announcement of a separately titled second season. The official site also scheduled episode 13.5, a recap of the first part, for the week before the new story resumed. What time does Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Cour 2 air? The Japanese network schedule lists AT-X at 11:00 p.m. every Tuesday, with repeat broadcasts Thursday at 11:00 a.m. and Monday at 5:00 p.m. TOKYO MX, BS11, Sun TV and KBS Kyoto list a Tuesday 24:30 start; Fukui Broadcasting follows at 24:59, and TV Aichi at 26:05. These late-night labels refer to the following calendar day: 24:30 Tuesday means 12:30 a.m. Wednesday in Japan. Use the station’s stated broadcast day when comparing schedules, and check the official page for changes before planning around a live airing. What is episode 13.5, and where should returning viewers start? Episode 13.5 is an official recap of the first cour, not the next numbered chapter of new story. The anime’s ON AIR page says it aired in the week before the Cour 2 premiere. Viewers who watched the earlier episodes can continue with the October 13 broadcast; anyone who wants a refresher can look for the recap separately, because streaming services may file specials differently from regular episodes. The official news archive later listed advance cuts and summaries for episodes 14, 15 and 16, giving readers a way to follow the weekly rollout without relying on unofficial episode numbering. For other current school series, our Blue Box Season 2 release guide tracks a different blend of teen relationships and competitive sport. Related reading: Ace of the Diamond act II -Second Season- Cour 2 . Where can you stream Cour 2? The official Japanese streaming schedule lists ABEMA Premium and d Anime Store at Tuesday 24:30. ABEMA’s free, ad-supported listing begins Friday at 24:30 for a one-week window. A broader group—including Prime Video, DMM TV, FOD, Hulu, Lemino, U-NEXT, Anime Times, Anime Hodai, Kantele Doga, Bandai Channel, Video Market and NicoNico Channel—is listed for Friday 24:30. Other services have Saturday, Sunday or later-week slots. Readers comparing seasonal schedules can use the Fall 2026 anime calendar . These are Japan-specific service times; a platform’s availability and release hour can differ by country, so check the current catalog in your region rather than treating the Japanese schedule as a worldwide streaming time. What story does Cour 2 cover? The second PV confirms two useful story signposts. It returns to the Asuka storyline introduced in the first cour and previews the “Haru” arc, centered on Haru Aomi, a girl in the school’s basketball club. The anime’s official introduction frames this part of the story around the end of spring, new encounters and setbacks, and young people pursuing dreams they cannot let go. That gives returning viewers context without claiming an episode-by-episode adaptation order that the production has not announced. The official news feed’s October 23 update was for episode 16’s preview images and synopsis, the latest weekly episode item listed when this guide was checked. Related reading: DARK MACHINE THE ANIMATION Release Date & Time . What is the series about, and why is Fukui part of it? The story follows Saku Chitose, a second-year student at Fujishi High School who is academically capable, athletic and socially confident. His popularity makes him admired by some classmates and a target of gossip from others. In the first story arc, a teacher asks Saku to help a classmate who has become withdrawn; that assignment complicates the polished image people have of him and gives the series room to explore how teenagers see one another. The official anime describes Fukui as the setting. That detail is more than a location label: the production’s official pages and local collaboration materials connect the school-life story to real places and community activity in the prefecture. Who voices the main cast, and who makes the anime? Shogo Sakata voices Saku Chitose. The central cast also includes Manaka Iwami as Yuko Hiiragi, Hina Yomiya as Yua Uchida, Rumi Okubo as Haru Aomi, Ikumi Hasegawa as Yuzuki Nanase and Chika Anzai as Asuka Nishino. Yuji Tokuno directs the series at feel., with series composition by Naruhisa Arakawa, character designs by Sumie Kinoshita and music by Yoshiaki Fujisawa. Cour 2’s opening theme is “Saku” by Cider Girl, and its ending theme is “Dokonimo Ikenai Mama” by aruma. The official staff-and-cast page is the best reference for romanization and credit updates. Related reading: PSYREN Anime Release Date, Time & Where to Watch . Is Cour 2 the same as Season 2, and how many episodes are there? The official Japanese campaign calls this “Cour 2,” meaning the second broadcast block of the split-cour TV adaptation. It is reasonable to search for it as “Part 2” or “season 2,” but the official release notice does not announce a new Season 2. The current schedule and news page identify weekly episodes through episode 16, but the material reviewed for this update does not state the final episode count. A split-cour label alone is not enough to calculate that number, so this guide leaves the total unconfirmed. What is confirmed, and what remains unknown? Confirmed details include the October 13 Japanese return, the weekly station and domestic streaming schedule, the recap’s placement, Cour 2’s principal story threads, the credited cast and staff, and the two theme songs. The official site links the anime to Hiromu’s light-novel series, illustrated by raemz and published under Shogakukan’s Gagaga Bunko imprint; its Books page lists the novels for readers who want to start from the source. The official broadcast page does not provide a single international release time, and the episode-count endpoint is not stated in the checked material. Keep those questions open until the rights holder or a regional distributor publishes an explicit answer. entries.title: Cosmoship Yamato √2199 Release Date: Story, Cast and What’s Confirmed
entries.description: Cosmoship Yamato √2199 release date, story, cast and continuity: confirmed film details, official staff, teaser art and unanswered questions.
entries.content: NEW ANIME FILM · OCTOBER 6, 2026 Cosmoship Yamato √2199 Release Date: Story, Cast and What’s Confirmed Cosmoship Yamato √2199 (Root 2199) is officially in production as a feature-length theatrical anime, bringing Hideaki Anno and Yutaka Izubuchi together as directors and marking the first animation co-production between Production I.G and Khara. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official teaser visual. Source: Production I.G . © Yoshinobu Nishizaki / Shin Office Academy. RELEASE AT A GLANCE Theatrical anime film · release date TBA Animation: Production I.G × Studio Khara · Japanese release, cast and distributor: TBA What is confirmed about Cosmoship Yamato √2199? Cosmoship Yamato √2199 , also styled Space Battleship Yamato √2199 and read “Root 2199,” is a new feature-length theatrical anime in production. It was announced on October 6, 2026, the 52nd anniversary of the original television series’ first broadcast. Production I.G and Studio Khara are co-producing the animation for the first time. Hideaki Anno and Yutaka Izubuchi are both credited as directors and design-works contributors. The confirmed facts stop there for several common reader questions: no Japanese release date, release window, cast, runtime or overseas plan has been announced. When will the Yamato √2199 movie be released? There is no confirmed premiere date or year. The official project site says further information will follow, and the October 2026 studio announcements do not set a theatrical schedule. Khara had said in October 2024 that it was aiming to begin production on a new theatrical project in 2025. That was a target, not a release date, and the later announcement does not confirm when production actually began or how long it will take. Treat specific 2027 or 2028 dates without a newer official notice as speculation. Production I.G’s announcement page shows a posting time of 08:00 on October 6, 2026. That is the time for the written announcement, not a trailer upload. The studios and project site have revealed a teaser visual, but no verified official video trailer for this particular film appears in their current news listings. Older Yamato trailers belong to different productions and cannot establish a √2199 video timestamp. Related reading: Anime Releasing in December 2026: Confirmed Dates . Who is directing it, and which studios are involved? The official staff list credits Anno with planning, executive production, direction and design work. Izubuchi is credited with direction and design work, while Mitsuhisa Ishikawa is credited with planning. Yoshinobu Nishizaki is named for the original work, and Shin Office Academy is listed as the production entity. Production I.G and Studio Khara are the animation-production partners. These role labels matter because headlines often reduce the reveal to “Anno directs”; he is not the only director, and neither studio is described as the sole animation producer. The I.G–Khara collaboration is their first animation co-production, according to the studios. It is a production distinction, not a promise about visual style, schedule or story. No composer, additional animation staff, characters, voice cast or distributor is named in the official materials reviewed for this update. Related reading: Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 Confirmed for 2027: New Trailer and Streaming Details . Is this a sequel to Space Battleship Yamato 2199 or REBEL3199? No direct sequel connection has been announced. Khara addressed the relationship before the new film’s title reveal: in an October 2024 statement, it described this project as following a different route from the remake line that began with Space Battleship Yamato 2199 and continues with Yamato yo Towa ni: REBEL3199 . That is firmer guidance than guessing from the shared “2199” in the names. It distinguishes the creative tracks, but does not explain √2199’s plot, timeline, characters or whether viewers need to know earlier stories. Anno’s statement on Khara’s site gives context for that distinction. He recalled that the original franchise already existed in multiple forms: the television series, theatrical versions, novels and manga did not all present one identical continuity. He also described the remake manga and screen version as parallel, and framed multiple Yamato worlds as part of the property’s history. This is the director’s perspective on the franchise, not a synopsis or confirmation that √2199 will use a particular alternate-history device. What does the teaser visual show? The first official image depicts Yamato preparing to launch from a devastated landscape toward space. Production I.G describes that scene in its announcement, so it is a confirmed visual detail rather than an inferred plot summary. It signals a spacefaring setting and an Earthbound launch image, but does not identify characters, explain what caused the ruined landscape or reveal whether the film retells familiar events. Because this is a still image, it should not be labelled a trailer. Related reading: New Anime on Netflix in October 2026: What to Watch . Why was the announcement tied to October 6? The date connects the project to the original Space Battleship Yamato broadcast, which began on October 6, 1974. Production I.G notes that the first TV series ran for 26 episodes and that the reveal arrived on the franchise’s 52nd anniversary. The 50th-anniversary program in 2024 included screenings, exhibitions and publications with Anno’s involvement. This timing explains the announcement’s anniversary significance; it does not imply that the new film will premiere on an anniversary. For readers sorting the timelines, keep the project names separate. The 1974 television original, the 2012 Yamato 2199 remake line and the new √2199 film belong to the same property, but Khara explicitly distinguishes the new project from the ongoing remake route. Until a film synopsis or viewing guidance appears, there is no officially recommended watch order or prerequisite list for √2199. Related reading: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin? Release Guide . Where can fans find the next official update? The project site and its official news page are the primary places to watch for a release notice, story details or future video. The October 6 news index also announced a special interview with Anno and Izubuchi in the November 2026 issue of Newtype , on sale October 9. KADOKAWA confirms the issue and interview announcement, but the public notice does not reproduce the full interview; this article does not attribute unquoted film details to it. For now, the reliable release-date answer is “not announced.” A future official date, cast reveal or distributor notice would change that status. No overseas theatrical booking or streaming service has been named, so viewers outside Japan should wait for a regional announcement rather than assume a domestic theatrical plan includes an international release. AniNextUp status: Production, format, lead staff, the first I.G–Khara animation co-production and teaser visual are confirmed. Release timing, plot, cast, runtime and distribution remain unannounced. Khara describes the film as a different route from the 2199–REBEL3199 remake line. Updated: October 25, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error Primary sources: Production I.G’s announcement and staff list ; Khara’s production announcement ; Anno’s statement on Yamato’s parallel continuities ; official Yamato √2199 news ; KADOKAWA’s Newtype interview notice .

entries.content: OCTOBER 20, 2026 · NETFLIX PREMIERE Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Is Out on Netflix: Episodes & Trailer Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 premiered on Netflix on October 20, 2026, with all ten episodes now available, according to CD PROJEKT RED. Here is where to watch, the official trailer and how its standalone story connects to Night City. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Promotional artwork published by Netflix Tudum · Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. Release at a glance Release date October 20, 2026 Where to watch Netflix; check your local title listing Episodes 10; standalone story with a new crew Release format All 10 episodes now available Checked October 20, 2026 · Netflix title page · Netflix announcement When does Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 come out? The Netflix release date is October 20, 2026. Both Netflix Tudum and CD PROJEKT RED’s official anime website publish that date. Where can I watch it? The new anime is a Netflix exclusive. Open the official Netflix title page to check the available episodes. Local availability, audio and subtitle options should be checked in your country’s catalog. Are all ten episodes available now? Yes. All ten episodes are now available on Netflix , according to CD PROJEKT RED’s October 20 premiere announcement . This replaces the earlier uncertainty about the rollout. Check your local Netflix listing for language options and availability. Related reading: My Happy Marriage Special Episodes: Release Date & Netflix Guide . Watch the official premiere-date teaser This is the trailer linked from CD PROJEKT RED’s official Edgerunners 2 website. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Cyberpunk 2077 · CD PROJEKT RED How many episodes, and is this David’s story? Netflix confirms a standalone, ten-episode story with a different crew. Night City connects the two installments, but the new story follows a separate group rather than promising a continuation of David’s journey. What is the new story about? The official synopsis follows Weak, a former edgerunner legend trying to rebuild his life without chrome, and D, a nomad pursuing revenge and dangerous corporate secrets. Their paths form part of a wider story about family, obsession and legacy. Who is making the anime? CD PROJEKT RED and TRIGGER are producing the installment. The official site credits director Kai Ikarashi, lead character designer Kanno Ichigo, and story creatives Bartosz Sztybor and Masahiko Otsuka. The official character page lists Kentaro Tone as Weak and Koki Uchiyama as D, the two characters at the center of the published synopsis. The full character and voice cast list is on CD PROJEKT RED’s official site . Official sources and what to watch next Sources: Netflix’s release announcement and the official anime site and trailer . Browse this week’s anime premieres or more anime on Netflix for other confirmed releases. Where to watch and what the page can verify The official Cyberpunk site now labels the anime as available exclusively on Netflix, and Netflix’s title page is the place to check whether it plays in a viewer’s region. The published release date was October 20, 2026. Netflix and CD PROJEKT RED describe ten episodes, but local language tracks and catalog availability should still be checked in the account’s country. The official trailer is useful for seeing the new cast and tone, while the official description supplies the standalone format and episode count. Neither source requires a recap of the earlier series to explain the new premise, and neither justifies inventing a viewing order or claiming that plot details from season one are necessary. This guide keeps the spoiler-free facts together so fans can decide whether to start the new story now or revisit the original first. Meet the new Night City crew The official character profiles offer a spoiler-light introduction to the people around Weak and D. Weak was once a celebrated edgerunner known as King; now his former reputation contrasts with a life without cybernetic enhancements. D, meanwhile, is a Snake Nation netrunner whose search for the person responsible for killing his clan gives his pursuit of revenge a personal starting point. Another figure in the ensemble is Roman Carax, a young film enthusiast looking for genuine stories in a city dominated by braindance. Talia comes from a corporate background and has also lived under the influence of the Maelstrom gang. These descriptions come from the production's character introductions; they establish who the characters are at the outset without revealing how their stories end. The Japanese voice credits on the official page include Kentaro Tone as Weak, Koki Uchiyama as D, Momoka Terasawa as Roman and Akari Kito as Talia. Avida, voiced by Akemi Okamura, is also among the announced characters. Those are the Japanese cast credits; viewers should check Netflix's language menu for the credits and audio available in their own region. How does it connect to Cyberpunk 2077? Both installments take place in the world of Cyberpunk 2077 , and the shared setting gives them a common visual and social backdrop. The official description identifies this installment as a new standalone story with a new cast. That means a newcomer can approach the second installment on its own terms, while someone familiar with Night City may recognize aspects of the setting. The anime is a series in the game's universe, not an expansion that must be installed or a game purchase required to watch it. Netflix is the viewing platform. For players interested in related game updates or other franchise news, the official Cyberpunk site is the appropriate place to check separate announcements; those announcements should not be confused with the anime's episode list. What can viewers expect from the creative team? CD PROJEKT RED and animation studio TRIGGER collaborate again, with Kai Ikarashi directing this installment. The official credits also name Kanno Ichigo as lead character designer and Bartosz Sztybor and Masahiko Otsuka among the story creatives. Returning collaborators and a new director help distinguish the production's continuity from its new story and characters. The series is aimed at mature viewers. Its Netflix listing describes it as gritty and violent; ratings, subtitles and available audio can differ by country. Check the title's local rating and content information before watching, particularly when choosing a program for a household with younger viewers. More premieres this week Compare the anime releases today with this week’s confirmed premieres . Planning your next watch after Night City? Browse our November 2026 anime release guide .
