entries.title: d Anime Store Announces 81 Anime Titles for Fall 2026 in Japan
entries.description: Japan's d Anime Store announced 81 anime titles in its fall 2026 lineup as of October 13. Here's what the count means for streaming availability.
entries.content: OFFICIAL STREAMING NEWS · OCTOBER 14, 2026 d Anime Store Announces 81 Anime Titles for Fall 2026 in Japan Japanese anime streaming service d Anime Store says its fall 2026 lineup has reached 81 titles. The figure is a snapshot of the service's Japan-focused catalog, not a worldwide streaming announcement. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official d Anime Store fall 2026 streaming lineup banner, published with the October 13 announcement. Announcement at a glance Platform d Anime Store (Japan) Reported lineup 81 fall 2026 anime titles Announcement October 13, 2026 International availability Not established by this announcement What did d Anime Store announce? On October 13, 2026, Japan's d Anime Store announced that its autumn anime streaming selection totaled 81 titles . The number describes its fall-season offering at the time of the announcement. It should not be interpreted as 81 brand-new productions, 81 global premieres, or 81 exclusives. Does this mean 81 exclusive anime? No. A lineup count is different from an exclusive-title count. The service's fall selection can include simulcast series, catalog availability, and titles with different release arrangements. Viewers should consult each title's listing for exact start times, subscription conditions and any early or exclusive distribution notes. Can viewers outside Japan watch these anime? This is a Japan-specific streaming announcement . It does not confirm that the same 81 titles are available internationally, nor does it establish distribution rights on Crunchyroll, Netflix, Disney+ or other services. Regional availability varies by title and must be checked separately against each platform's official listings. How to check the full fall 2026 lineup The most reliable way to identify individual shows and their streaming conditions is to consult the official d Anime Store seasonal lineup and title pages. Because schedules and licensing conditions may change, AniNextUp is not reproducing an unverified title-by-title list here. See d Anime Store's official fall 2026 announcement → Related reading: Fall 2026 Anime Release Schedule & Calendar: October–December 2026 . Why individual streaming labels matter The official autumn lineup distinguishes ordinary streaming listings from entries marked as exclusive, early access or rental. Those labels can affect when a subscriber can watch a particular episode and whether an additional charge applies. The headline total of 81 titles does not mean every listed show has identical rights or availability conditions. What this means for anime fans The announcement offers a useful snapshot of the breadth of the fall season on one Japanese service. For viewers deciding where to watch, the more important questions remain which specific series are available in their country, when each episode appears and whether a title is included in their subscription. Browse AniNextUp's streaming guide → · See the fall 2026 anime calendar → Examples from the October 13 announcement The company's original press release groups individual titles under different distribution labels. It lists The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 and FX Fighter Kurumi-chan among titles marked for early terrestrial-TV and earliest subscription streaming. It also lists Reincarnated as a Sword II in a rental category. Related reading: BLEACH × Graniph: 17-Item Collection Launches in Japan on October 20 . These examples illustrate why the count alone cannot tell a viewer whether a particular show is part of a standard subscription. The labels describe the service's announced Japanese arrangements as of October 13, 2026; they are not evidence of licensing outside Japan, and individual listings may have changed since then. What do the Japanese timing labels mean? A title marked before terrestrial broadcast is scheduled on the service ahead of its Japanese TV airing. A simultaneous label means it is scheduled at the same time as terrestrial broadcast, while an earliest subscription label compares its timing with other subscription services. A listing may combine more than one of those descriptions. Dates and hours are attached to individual shows, not to the entire seasonal catalog. Japanese schedules can also use a clock beyond 24:00 for late-night programming; for example, 26:00 refers to 2:00 a.m. on the following calendar day in Japan. Check the current title page and the stated time zone before converting an episode time. Official sources Docomo Anime Store press release (October 13, 2026) · Official d Anime Store seasonal notice Related reading: Dandivine Release Date & Where to Watch: Japan Schedule, Cast and Story . How the lineup has changed since the announcement The official notice has continued to add titles after the original count. Its current update names Tanuki and Fox, Horror Collector, Dragon Ball Super: Beerus, Punirunes Punii 4 and Reincarnated as a Sword II. That is a useful reminder that a seasonal lineup is a changing catalog snapshot, not a permanent total. The service’s notice page is the source to consult for the latest additions; check each title’s page for its own release timing. How to check access and release conditions d Anime Store is a Japan-focused service. This announcement therefore cannot be used as proof that the same catalog is available on international services or that a viewer outside Japan can subscribe and play every listed show. Search by the Japanese or official localized title in the relevant service’s own catalog, and confirm whether the listing is included in a flat-rate plan, rental-only or marked for early/exclusive distribution. Those labels answer different questions. “Exclusive” is a rights description for a specific distribution window or service set; “early” indicates timing relative to other platforms; “rental” can involve a separate payment. A large headline count hides these differences. AniNextUp’s guide is meant to help readers understand the announcement and find the official listing, not promise access that the source does not establish. Prepared: October 23, 2026 · Updated: October 26, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error

entries.title: Dandivine Release Date & Where to Watch: Japan Schedule, Cast and Story
entries.description: Dandivine premiered in Japan on October 7, 2026. See the official weekly TV schedule, where to stream in Japan, story, cast and what remains unconfirmed.
entries.content: RELEASE GUIDE · UPDATED OCTOBER 25, 2026 Dandivine Release Date & Where to Watch: Japan Schedule, Cast and Story Dandivine premiered in Japan on October 7, 2026. The official site lists weekly Japanese broadcasts, d Anime Store as the simultaneous and fastest domestic stream, and additional services rolling out afterward. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official Dandivine key visual. Source: Good Smile Company . JAPAN PREMIERE October 7, 2026 JAPAN STREAMING d Anime Store first ANIMATION LIDENFILMS / KAYAC Release at a glance Japan premiere October 7, 2026; now airing Weekly Japan schedule TOKYO MX / BS11 / Gunma / Tochigi: Wed 24:30 JST; see station exceptions below Fastest Japanese stream d Anime Store, simultaneous with terrestrial broadcast International streaming Crunchyroll Fall 2026 lineup; check regional availability Official schedule: Dandivine production site · Good Smile Company When did Dandivine premiere? Dandivine began airing in Japan on October 7, 2026. It is an original television mecha anime from Good Smile Company and LIDENFILMS, with animation production by LIDENFILMS and KAYAC Animation. Because that Japanese premiere date has passed, this is now a viewing guide for a series already in its weekly broadcast run, rather than a future release announcement. The official schedule lists several Japanese broadcasters and domestic streaming services, while international availability depends on the platform and territory. What time does Dandivine air in Japan? The official anime schedule lists TOKYO MX, BS11, Gunma TV and Tochigi TV on Wednesdays at 24:30 JST from October 7. Japanese listings use the broadcast day's date even when a late-night slot crosses midnight: 24:30 Wednesday is 12:30 a.m. on Thursday, October 8 by ordinary calendar notation. Chukyo TV's Wednesday 26:32 slot is 2:32 a.m. Thursday, and MBS's Saturday 26:08 slot is 2:08 a.m. Sunday. AT-X is listed for Fridays at 20:30 JST. These are Japanese station times, not a promise of a matching release time elsewhere. There have also been schedule exceptions. Good Smile Company's October 6 announcement gave MBS's first episode a 26:08 slot, and the production's separate notice moved that first broadcast back by 50 minutes, to 26:58. The official site now lists the regular Saturday slot as 26:08 and, on October 22, posted a separate time-change notice for Episode 3 on MBS. Check the current station notice before planning around an MBS broadcast; do not apply a one-episode change to the whole season. Related reading: BLEACH × Graniph: 17-Item Collection Launches in Japan on October 20 . Where can viewers watch Dandivine? For Japan, the official site names d Anime Store as the simultaneous and fastest service. Its schedule also lists later distribution through services including Netflix, ABEMA, U-NEXT, Prime Video, Lemino, DMM TV, Hulu and others. “Later distribution” does not mean every service launches at the same hour, and the official page warns that streaming times can change. Check the title page in the service you use for the latest local listing. Crunchyroll included Dandivine in its Fall 2026 seasonal lineup for viewers in its licensed territories. Availability and episode timing can vary by country, so a Japanese TV schedule should not be converted directly into a North American or European simulcast time. The Japanese production site is the clearest source for domestic station and streaming details; the relevant streaming service is the source to check for regional access, subtitles and any dub options. What is the story about? The official premise begins twenty years after the combining robot Dandivine defeated the mysterious enemy Aposdoll. Peace followed, but the toy manufacturer Kasuga, which became famous by turning Dandivine into a hit toy line, has declined after relying too heavily on that one success. Its president, Genjuro Shijima, longs for Dandivine's return strongly enough to welcome the disruption of peace. Aposdoll then appears in Tokyo again, sending a population that has known two decades without an attack into panic. Related reading: d Anime Store Announces 81 Anime Titles for Fall 2026 in Japan . High-school student Gekiha Shijima enters the robot after his uncle Yusaku Kuroiwa, a former main pilot, brings him into the conflict. That setup gives the show two connected questions beyond “who wins the next fight?”: what Aposdoll wants now, and whether Kasuga can regain its former dominance in the toy industry. The combination-robot premise places the machine itself at the center of both the action and the story's commercial history. The official introduction establishes those questions, but does not disclose their answers, so they should not be treated as spoilers or confirmed outcomes. Who makes the series, and who is in the cast? Good Smile Company and LIDENFILMS are credited as the original creators; LIDENFILMS and KAYAC Animation handle animation production. Yi Cao directs, Toshiki Inoue oversees series composition and scripts, and mechanical design is credited to An (GOD BRAVE STUDIO). The principal cast includes Takuma Terashima as Gekiha, Haruka Shiraishi as Akane Kuzumi, Saya Aizawa as Kirei Shijima, Katsuyuki Konishi as Yusaku, and Atsushi Ono as Genjuro. The full official cast list also names Nao Toyama, Aya Yamane, Misaki Kuno, Asuna Tomari, Ryotaro Okiayu and Ruriko Aoki. The theme-song credits offer another point of reference for the promotional video: Takanori Nishikawa performs the opening song “Zankyo ≠ Blaster,” while DayRe: performs the ending “Mikansei Ordinary.” Sony Music's September 12 announcement links the official main PV and identifies Nishikawa's song as the opening theme. That gives viewers a reliable way to distinguish the main promotional video from fan edits or clips that reuse its footage. Related reading: #I'm Looking For a Zombie: Release Date, Schedule & Story . What does the official trailer confirm? The official main PV is linked from Sony Music's announcement and is embedded below. The announcement is dated September 12, 2026, but the source page does not show the video's exact upload clock time or timezone. AniNextUp does not substitute the announcement's publication date for a video upload timestamp. The trailer presents the series and its music; it does not establish a final episode count, an international release time for every territory, or the outcome of the central mystery. Is Dandivine a sequel, and how many episodes are planned? The official description presents Dandivine as an original project with a twenty-year in-story history, not as a continuation that requires watching an older television season. The premise supplies the relevant background: the earlier victory over Aposdoll and Dandivine's former pilot are part of this show's setup. As of October 25, 2026, the official pages checked for this update do not state a total episode count. Viewers should rely on new production announcements for that detail rather than assuming a standard cour length. We have not added an unverified VideoObject timestamp. entries.content: OCTOBER 13 · PREMIERE DARK MACHINE THE ANIMATION Release Date & Time DARK MACHINE THE ANIMATION began its Japanese broadcast in October 2026 and streams internationally on Crunchyroll. Consult Crunchyroll’s current weekly calendar for your regional release time. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Release at a glance Release October 13, 2026 on Crunchyroll Where to watch Crunchyroll in listed territories, including Central and South America Applies to International simulcast date; Japanese television has its own schedule Still pending Use the current official weekly calendar for regional episode times Release details checked October 12, 2026 · Official source RELEASE October 13, 2026 FUJI TV 25:45 JST (1:45 a.m. Oct. 14) STREAMING Crunchyroll · Regional schedule STUDIO Production +h. How the game premise creates the central conflict Kairi's search for Senki gives the journey through Golden Valley a goal beyond winning matches. His encounter with Rudra draws him into DARK MACHINE's competitive environment, where understanding the game and the people involved may matter as much as the competition itself. That is a reading of the published premise, not a prediction of match outcomes or later plot twists. Why two different premiere dates can appear Fuji TV writes the first broadcast as Tuesday, October 13 at 25:45 JST, using the late-night television convention. On a standard calendar that is Wednesday, October 14 at 1:45 a.m. JST. Crunchyroll separately lists October 13 for its simulcast with regional times in its current weekly schedule. International viewers should use their regional platform schedule rather than converting the Fuji TV slot into an assumed worldwide release time. When does DARK MACHINE THE ANIMATION premiere? DARK MACHINE THE ANIMATION began its Fuji TV broadcast on the October 13, 2026 late-night schedule. Fuji TV lists the first broadcast for Tuesday at 25:45 JST , which is 1:45 a.m. JST on October 14 in standard clock notation. Kansai TV started on October 15 at 26:45 JST, while BS Fuji began October 20 at 24:30 JST. Broadcast times may change. What time does DARK MACHINE release on Crunchyroll? The October 11 weekly schedule lists Episode 1 for October 13 with regional times. Use the column for your country rather than treating the Japanese TV slot as the streaming hour. Related reading: A Certain Dark Item Release Date & Where to Watch . Crunchyroll lists October 13 for the subtitled simulcast, with regional airtimes listed in its current weekly calendar. Use the current regional timetable; the Japanese television hour does not establish one global streaming time. What viewers should know about Golden Valley Golden Valley is the setting where Kairi's search for Senki brings him into contact with Rudra and the DARK MACHINE competition. The announced setup gives the protagonist two overlapping motivations: finding a person and learning to navigate a competitive game environment. That distinction may help newcomers follow the story without assuming that winning matches is his only objective. The official premise does not disclose how his search ends. Where to watch Crunchyroll has confirmed the anime for North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS and India. In Japan, unlimited streaming began progressively on October 14 at 12:00 JST on d Anime Store, Hulu, Lemino, DMM TV, FOD, Bandai Channel, U-NEXT, Anime Hodai, Amazon Prime Video, Anime Times, TELASA, J:COM STREAM, milplus and ABEMA Premium. Free latest-episode distribution was also scheduled through ABEMA, TVer and Niconico. Related reading: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Cour 2 Release Date & Time . What is it about? Kairi arrives in Golden Valley searching for the legendary Senki and is pulled into the competitive world of DARK MACHINE after meeting Rudra. See the Fall 2026 anime calendar → What is the difference between the broadcast dates? Japanese television schedules often label programming after midnight as part of the previous broadcast day. Fuji TV's “October 13, 25:45” therefore means 1:45 a.m. on October 14 in Japan, while Kansai TV's October 15 at 26:45 means 2:45 a.m. on October 16. BS Fuji's October 20 at 24:30 corresponds to 12:30 a.m. on October 21. The official project schedule lists these station starts separately and notes that times can change. Those conversions describe the Japanese broadcasts, not a promise that a streaming episode appears at the same moment everywhere. A service can show a date in a viewer's local time zone, which may be the previous calendar day. Use the current listing for the platform and country where you watch when planning each episode. Related reading: PSYREN Anime Release Date, Time & Where to Watch . Who are Kairi, Rudra and Senki? Fuji TV's series introduction says Kairi travels to Golden Valley after his grandfather's final request: find Senki. There he encounters Rudra, who is being pursued by a faction connected to Ajima. That meeting leads Kairi into the competition and brings his own abilities into view. Senki is a title associated with the strongest DARK MACHINE player; Ajima is identified as its seventh holder in the broadcaster's premise. That detail helps explain why Kairi's search leads toward someone with influence in Golden Valley. These are introductory details from the official synopsis, so the outcome of the search remains for the episodes to reveal. Japanese cast and creative team Fuji TV credits Kensho Ono as Kairi and Miyuki Sawashiro as Rudra. Its cast list also names Koki Uchiyama as Shin, Riho Sugiyama as Blanc and Yuichi Nakamura as Ajima. These are Japanese voice credits; availability of a dubbed version and individual language tracks depends on the platform and region. Related reading: The Vermilion Mask Release Date, Time & Where to Watch . The anime forms part of a cross-media project. Its official game website credits Goro Taniguchi as the anime's creative producer and Hidetaka Tenjin as lead mechanical designer. The game and television anime share the DARK MACHINE name and setting, but watching an episode and playing the game are separate activities. How to follow the series now As of October 26, 2026, the premiere is in the past. Crunchyroll lists the show in its fall lineup, and its series page is the place to check the episodes, language options and access available for your account. Release calendars can change, so check the current listing for later episodes rather than relying on the first week's times. Sources checked October 26, 2026: Fuji TV, the official DARK MACHINE project and Crunchyroll. entries.title: Delicious in Dungeon Season 2 Release Date: October 2027
entries.description: Delicious in Dungeon Season 2 arrives in October 2027 on Netflix and other streaming services. See the official release window, teaser visual, story and episode-count status.
entries.content: RETURNING SERIES · NETFLIX GUIDE Delicious in Dungeon Season 2 Release Date: October 2027 Delicious in Dungeon Season 2 is confirmed for October 2027 on Netflix and other streaming services. This guide collects the official release window, new teaser visual, story setup and details that remain unannounced. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official Season 2 teaser visual · ©Ryoko Kui,KADOKAWA/Delicious in Dungeon PARTNERS. Source: official July 5 announcement . Release at a glance Release window October 2027; exact day TBA Where to watch Netflix and other streaming services Episodes Season 2 count not announced Release hour Not announced Checked October 18, 2026 · Netflix’s Anime Expo announcement When does Delicious in Dungeon Season 2 come out? Delicious in Dungeon Season 2 is confirmed for October 2027. The official Japanese anime site announced the broadcast window on July 5, 2026, and Netflix’s July 6 Anime Expo update confirms an October 2027 streaming release. Will Season 2 be on Netflix? Netflix is confirmed, and the official announcement also says the season will stream on other services. Netflix names the new season in its own announcement and Media Center listing . The official English anime site also displays an October 2027 Netflix banner. An exact premiere day, release hour, regional language schedule and weekly or batch rollout are not specified in those announcements. What does the new teaser visual show? The officially released artwork focuses on Falin, the magician Thistle and Laios’s party as their rescue journey moves deeper into the dungeon. Netflix’s published synopsis frames the continuation around the group’s effort to save Falin. The visual offers the first broad story setup for the new season without establishing a complete episode-by-episode synopsis. The teaser visual also identifies chimera Falin and the Mad Mage Thistle alongside Laios, Marcille, Chilchuck, Senshi and Izutsumi. Related reading: Anime Mysterious Codes (October 2026): Reports & Redemption Guide . Is there a Season 2 trailer? The July release announcement introduces teaser artwork. No new Season 2 promotional video is linked in that announcement, so this guide displays the verified visual rather than assigning an earlier season’s trailer to the sequel. Check the official anime website for future video updates. How many episodes will Season 2 have? The sources checked on October 18, 2026 do not announce a Season 2 episode count. The first season’s 24 episodes are already available; that number should not be reused as a confirmed order for the continuation. Who is behind Delicious in Dungeon? The anime adapts Ryoko Kui’s manga. The official English production page credits TRIGGER for animation production. The series combines a dungeon rescue adventure with cooking and the practical challenge of feeding a party during a dangerous expedition. Related reading: Anime News: October 2026 — Streaming Updates & 2027 Announcements . Should I watch Season 1 first? Yes: the announced rescue story continues the existing party’s journey. Watching the first season provides the context for its relationships and the stakes surrounding Falin. You can find the series through its official Netflix title page ; catalog availability and language options depend on your location. Who is returning behind the animation? The official English production page lists Yoshihiro Miyajima as director, Kimiko Ueno as story editor and Naoki Takeda as character designer for Season 2. Yasunori Mitsuda and Shunsuke Tsuchiya are credited for music, with TRIGGER handling animation production. Those credits give fans a concrete view of the announced creative team without implying that every episode will be made by an identical crew. What is the party trying to do? At the start of the series, Laios's younger sister Falin is eaten by a dragon deep in the dungeon. The party heads back down with limited supplies, turning the dungeon's monsters into food along the way. This original setup explains why cooking is closely tied to exploration and survival, rather than simply appearing between battles. Related reading: BLEACH × Graniph: 17-Item Collection Launches in Japan on October 20 . For the continuation, Netflix's official description points to a changed Falin under Thistle's control and the party's effort to reach and save her. The teaser art shows the stakes for returning viewers, but Netflix has not published a complete sequence of events for the new season. Watching Season 1 first provides the context for those changes. Does a teaser visual confirm a trailer? Artwork and promotional video are different releases. The October 2027 announcement supplied a visual, while the cited July update did not supply a new Season 2 trailer. If a later video appears, its official title and upload date can help distinguish it from footage promoting the original season. Official sources Verified references: the July 5 anime announcement , Netflix’s Anime Expo release update and Netflix Media Center . Explore more Netflix anime or other returning-series guides . Related reading: Fall 2026 Anime Release Schedule & Calendar: October–December 2026 . What returning viewers can plan for now Season 1 supplies the character relationships and dungeon rules that make the new visual legible, so it is the sensible place to start if this will be your first time watching. That is a viewing recommendation based on the sequel’s stated rescue setup, not a claim that Season 2 requires a particular recap or special episode. The production has not yet announced its episode count, weekly-versus-batch schedule, exact Japanese broadcast time, or territory-by-territory streaming catalog. For people tracking a date, the durable entry is simply “October 2027.” Streaming services often publish local language and timing details closer to launch; until then, viewers should use their own service’s title page rather than assume subtitles, dub tracks or release hours. AniNextUp will add those details only when a distributor provides them. The official anime site and Netflix Media Center are the references to check when the next schedule update arrives. entries.title: Demon's Crest Release Date: November 6, 2026 and Where to Watch
entries.description: Demon's Crest premieres worldwide on Prime Video November 6, 2026, at 9 p.m. JST, with episodes 1 and 2. Get its story, cast, staff and official PV.
entries.content: NOVEMBER 6 · PRIME VIDEO Demon's Crest Release Date: November 6, 2026 and Where to Watch Demon's Crest premieres worldwide on Prime Video on November 6, 2026. Find the confirmed story, cast, staff, theme songs, official PV and release details still unknown. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official key visual. Source: Demons' Crest official site . Release at a glance Release November 6, 2026 Where to watch Prime Video worldwide exclusive · 9 p.m. JST · episodes 1–2 on day one Applies to Global streaming announcement Still pending Episode count, later rollout and regional language lineup Release details checked October 25, 2026 · Official time and episode-one notice RELEASE November 6, 2026 STREAMING Prime Video · Worldwide STUDIO Production I.G When does Demons' Crest premiere? Demons' Crest is scheduled to begin worldwide on November 6, 2026, exclusively on Prime Video. Amazon Japan and the anime's official site both identify that date and platform. This is a streaming premiere rather than a Japanese television launch followed by separate overseas dates. The announcement describes worldwide exclusivity, so Prime Video is the confirmed service to check in each region. The official Japanese announcement for Soala's ending theme supplies the launch detail: Prime Video is scheduled to begin streaming at 21:00 on November 6, with episodes 1 and 2 available on day one. AniNextUp reports that Japanese announcement time as 9 p.m. Japan Standard Time (JST). The notice does not establish whether every country unlocks the episodes at that same instant or at a local time, so check the Prime Video listing in your region. It also does not give the full season episode count or explain the release schedule after the first two episodes. What is the anime about? The story begins with sixth-grader Yuuma Ashihara joining a test of Actual Magic, a full-dive VRMMO role-playing game. Yuuma forms a party with his twin sister Sawa and classmates Kenji Kondo and Minagi Sano. After the group clears a boss and attempts to log out, the test is supposed to be over—but the official synopsis says Yuuma is forced out into a reality already being invaded by the game. A later official description places him alone in a dim building and asks what he sees there. Related reading: The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop Anime Premieres January 2027 . That setup gives viewers a more specific question than “is this another game anime?” The tension comes from recognizing familiar game systems while the characters can no longer rely on a clean boundary between a virtual world and ordinary life. The first key visual deliberately contrasts the bright Actual Magic town with a darker real-world reflection beneath it. The official first PV also moves from the friends enjoying the game to monsters appearing in the changed real world. These are confirmed promotional details; the cause of the merger and the rules for surviving it remain story mysteries. Reki Kawahara is the author of the source novel and is also known for Sword Art Online and Accel World . The anime site describes Demons' Crest as a new work set in a mixed-reality world. The shared author is useful context, but no official announcement presents this title as a sequel or crossover with either franchise, so viewers should approach it as its own story. Related reading: Anime Releasing in November 2026: Dates & Where to Watch . Who is in the cast? Haruka Shiraishi voices Yuuma, and Konomi Inagaki voices his twin sister Sawa. Yuya Hirose plays Kenji Kondo, whose nickname is Konken, while Satomi Amano plays Minagi Sano. The official cast page also lists Yusuke Kobayashi as Teruki Sugamo, Maaya Uchida as Aria Misono, Rie Murakawa as Kai Kisanuki, Sora Amamiya as Sumika Watamaki, Atsushi Tamaru as Shin Haizaki, and Ayumu Murase as Kakeru Niki. The official character announcements add these classmates as the school group around which the story's survival situation develops. Which studio and staff are making it? Production I.G is handling animation. Kenichiro Komaya directs, with Shinji Ushiro as chief director and Eiji Umehara responsible for series composition. Yukiko Horiguchi, who illustrated the original novels, is credited with character design. The official staff list also names Shuuji Kawakami and Kazuya Kise as chief animation directors, Yuki Hayashi and Naoyuki Chikatani for music, and Jin Aketagawa for sound direction. These credits answer the common question of whether Kawahara is the anime's director: he is the original author, while Komaya is the series director. Related reading: Fool Night Release Date: November 26 on Netflix . What are the opening and ending songs? Ado performs the opening song “Shinka,” written and composed by Vocaloid producer Yuri Canon, with arrangement by Yuri Canon and Naoki Itai. The production announced the ending theme “ReaL” by Soala with the second promotional video on October 2. The official music page says Soala wrote the ending and co-composed it with Yusuke Hashiguchi. The two songs are confirmed credits; no full soundtrack release schedule is listed in those announcements. What do the official trailers confirm? The first promotional video, key visual, opening theme, and worldwide streaming date were announced on July 5, 2026. A second PV and the ending theme were announced on October 2. The official first-PV announcement gives the release day but the accessible source does not provide the video's original upload time or timezone. AniNextUp has not inferred a timestamp from the press-release publication time, and no VideoObject uploadDate is asserted. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL PV Demon's Crest · first promotional video Is there an early screening? Yes. The official site lists a Japanese preview event for November 1, 2026, at 15:00 JST at United Cinemas Aqua City Odaiba, with episodes 1 and 2 scheduled for an early screening. Haruka Shiraishi and Konomi Inagaki are listed to appear. This is a separate, in-person event in Tokyo; it does not move the worldwide Prime Video premiere forward from November 6, and the site says there is no event stream. What has not been confirmed? The public announcements reviewed here confirm the date, 21:00 JST launch time, first two episodes, worldwide Prime Video exclusivity, cast, production team, songs, promotional videos, and a Japan preview screening. They do not provide the complete season episode count, the release cadence after episodes 1 and 2, or the day-one language and subtitle lineup by country. Those details should be checked against the local Prime Video page when it is updated. November 6, 2026 is the confirmed global launch date; 9 p.m. JST is the time announced in the Japanese-language notice. Release sources Amazon Japan: worldwide Prime Video premiere on November 6, 2026; first PV announced July 5 Official anime site: release date and latest announcements · official story · official cast and staff · official theme-song credits official first PV and key visual announcement · official second PV and ending-song announcement · official November 1 preview event details · Soala's official label announcement: 21:00 start and episodes 1–2 on day one Official first PV: Prime Video JP upload . The accessible official announcement identifies July 5, 2026 as the PV release day but does not state the exact upload time or timezone. No exact upload timestamp is asserted. entries.title: Dengeki Daisy Anime Sets January 2027 Premiere, Reveals Trailer and Cast
entries.description: Dengeki Daisy premieres in January 2027 with two consecutive cours. See the official trailer, Studio DEEN staff, cast and streaming details.
entries.content: OFFICIAL NEWS · JANUARY 2027 Dengeki Daisy Anime Sets January 2027 Premiere, Reveals Trailer and Cast The long-awaited adaptation of Kyousuke Motomi's romance-suspense manga has a confirmed broadcast window, a full promotional video and a two-cour schedule. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Published: October 15, 2026 · How we verify releases Official key visual © Kyousuke Motomi / Shogakukan / Dengeki Daisy Production Committee. Official announcement . Release at a glance Japanese premiere January 2027 (exact date TBA) Run Two consecutive cours Studio Studio DEEN Director Souta Ueno Streaming Crunchyroll announced streaming for 2027; regional details may vary When does the Dengeki Daisy anime premiere? The television anime is scheduled to begin broadcasting in Japan in January 2027. The official announcement describes a two-consecutive-cour run, which means the planned broadcast spans two cours in succession. The production has not announced the exact first episode date, a weekly airtime or an episode total. January is the confirmed start window; it should not be presented as a specific day. “Two cours” is a broadcast-format description, not a guaranteed episode count. It tells viewers the planned run continues across two programming blocks, but the official materials do not say whether the anime will use 24 episodes, 26 episodes or another total. The official series website and Aniplex announcement are the sources to check for a later station schedule. Where will Dengeki Daisy stream? Crunchyroll has announced plans to stream the anime in 2027. That announcement does not yet give a launch day or a complete country-by-country list. Japanese television broadcast and international streaming are separate schedules: a Japanese episode time does not automatically establish when it appears in every regional catalog. Viewers outside Japan should check the Crunchyroll listing for their account region once the title page and schedule are available. Subtitle languages, dubbing and same-day availability have not been confirmed in the current announcements. Who voices Teru and Kurosaki? Yoshino Aoyama voices Teru Kurebayashi, and Taku Yashiro plays Tasuku Kurosaki. The announced supporting cast includes Tomokazu Sugita as Souichirou Kurebayashi, Yuka Terasaki as Riko Onizuka, Setsuji Satou as Masuda and Kouhei Amasaki as Akira. These names and roles appear in the official anime materials. The cast announcement identifies the listed characters; it should not be treated as a complete cast list for every person in the manga. Which studio and staff are producing the series? Studio DEEN is producing the television anime. Souta Ueno directs, Sawako Hirabayashi handles series composition, Ayaka Murakami designs the characters, and Masaru Yokoyama composes the music. The production has confirmed these core credits alongside the main promotional video. It has not published a full production schedule or stated how many manga chapters each episode will cover. What is Dengeki Daisy about? Teru Kurebayashi loses her older brother and is left with a phone he gave her. Messages from a mysterious person using the name “Daisy” become a source of comfort. At school, Teru gets pulled into work for Tasuku Kurosaki, a blunt custodian whose actions show more concern than his manner suggests. Their relationship develops alongside questions about Daisy’s identity and the secrets surrounding Teru’s brother. Related reading: Now That We Draw Anime Sets January 2027 Premiere . The premise combines a school romance with suspense and a mystery about trust. That mix helps explain why the story is not only a “who is Daisy?” puzzle: Teru and Kurosaki’s changing relationship is also central. The official synopsis sets up those elements, but it does not reveal how the anime will adapt the manga’s later turns. This guide avoids spoilers and does not assume that the series will cover every chapter. Is the original manga complete, and where can readers find it? Kyousuke Motomi’s manga ran in Shogakukan’s Betsucomi magazine from 2007 to 2013. Shogakukan lists the completed work in 16 volumes. This gives anime viewers a clear distinction between the source story, which has an ending, and the television adaptation, whose coverage has not been announced. A two-cour plan alone does not confirm whether the anime will adapt the full manga, skip material or use a different ending. Readers can check Shogakukan’s official volume 16 listing for the completed Japanese edition. The official anime site also links its story, cast and news updates. Availability of the manga in other languages depends on local publishers and retailers; the Japanese publisher listing does not guarantee an English or Spanish edition in every market. Watch the official main trailer The September 19, 2026 announcement introduced the main promotional video and the January 2027 broadcast window. The official video is useful for seeing the anime’s first extended preview, but the announcement does not attach an exact premiere day to it. YouTube’s original upload metadata lists the trailer as published on September 18, 2026, at 8:40:03 p.m. PDT. That is the video’s upload time, one day earlier than the Japanese announcement date. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Main PV 1 Read the official trailer announcement . What is confirmed so far? Confirmed: a January 2027 start in Japan, a planned two-cour broadcast, Studio DEEN, the announced cast and staff, and a 2027 Crunchyroll streaming plan. Still pending: the exact first-airing date, episode total, station and time, regional streaming calendar, subtitle and dub details, and the manga chapters the anime will cover. Keeping those answers separate makes it easier to spot the difference between an official update and an estimate repeated online. Official sources Dengeki Daisy official anime website · September 19 official key visual and trailer announcement · Crunchyroll's report on the release window and staff . Explore more anime news and upcoming releases in the AniNextUp calendar . Updated: October 23, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error

entries.content: FALL 2026 · NOW AIRING The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2: Release Date, Episodes & Where to Watch The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 began airing in Japan on October 7, 2026. Find the weekly Japanese broadcast times, confirmed staff and cast, official PV, and what is known about streaming and episode count. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Season 2 key visual. Source: official anime website . RELEASE DATE October 7, 2026 STREAMING Availability varies by region STUDIO ENGI Release at a glance Release October 7, 2026 Where to watch d Anime Store and Japanese services; check regional listings elsewhere Region and timing Japan: weekly Wednesday broadcast; overseas rights vary Release details checked October 24, 2026 · official Japanese broadcast and streaming schedule Has The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 premiered? Yes. Season 2 began its Japanese television run on Wednesday, October 7, 2026. The official anime site lists a weekly Wednesday broadcast, and by October 24 it had posted the preview and story summary for episode 3. If you are searching for the release date today, the useful answer is that the season is already airing in Japan, rather than still being an upcoming Fall 2026 title. Catch-up availability depends on the streaming service and territory. What time does each episode air in Japan? The official schedule lists TOKYO MX and other stations from 10:30 p.m. Japan Standard Time every Wednesday. BS Nippon TV's listed slot is 12:30 a.m. Thursday, while AT-X is scheduled for 9:30 p.m. Wednesday. Those are separate Japanese broadcast slots, not one universal streaming time. For viewers comparing clocks, 10:30 p.m. JST on October 7 corresponded to 6:30 a.m. Pacific Daylight Time and 9:30 a.m. Eastern Daylight Time on October 7. Where can viewers stream Season 2? For Japan, the official On Air page says d Anime Store carries the first, fastest streaming slot at 10:00 p.m. JST on Wednesdays, ahead of television. Other services start on Monday, October 12, with weekly releases from 10:00 p.m. JST; the official list includes U-NEXT, ABEMA, Disney+ Japan, Hulu Japan, Prime Video Japan and other domestic platforms. Crunchyroll separately announced the series as part of its Fall 2026 lineup, but streaming rights and episode availability vary by territory. Check the service listing for your country before assuming a schedule. Related reading: Red Riding Hood: A Detective Story Premieres January 2027 on Crunchyroll . What is the story about? The series follows Kimihiko Kimizuka, a boy who becomes the assistant to Siesta, a legendary detective he meets aboard a hijacked plane at 10,000 meters. They travel and investigate cases together for three years before Siesta dies. A year later, Nagisa Natsunagi asks Kimihiko for help, bringing him back into detective work and toward the truth about Siesta. The official introduction stresses that solving the mystery of her death does not finish the story: Kimihiko and his companions still have to understand the detective's mistakes and what inheriting her will demands. Do you need to watch Season 1 first? Season 2 is a direct continuation, so starting with Season 1 gives the character relationships and Siesta's legacy their intended context. The first season establishes why Kimihiko resists becoming involved in new cases and why Siesta's presence remains central even after her death. A recap can explain the setup, but it cannot reproduce the timing of the earlier reveals. Viewers who want to avoid spoilers should watch the original 12-episode season before moving to the sequel; the official Season 2 synopsis already refers to the mystery surrounding Siesta's death as something the group has uncovered. Related reading: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Is Out on Netflix: Episodes & Trailer . What new characters and cast members are confirmed? The official cast list continues with Shū Nagai as Kimihiko, Saki Miyashita as Siesta and Ayana Taketatsu as Nagisa, alongside Kanon Takao as Yui, Saori Shirahama as Charlotte, Mai Fuchigami as Fuubi and others. New additions announced with the third promotional video include Akari Komiyama as Mia Whitlock and Nobuhiko Okamoto as Scarlet. Their introduction widens the group around Kimihiko; the production's announcement identifies them as new cast members but does not frame the update as a replacement of the returning leads. Who makes the anime, and what are the theme songs? ENGI handles animation production. Manabu Kurihara directs, Deko Akao is responsible for series composition and scripts, and Yosuke Ito designs the characters. Music is credited to 40mP and Yuyu. The opening theme is “Kono Shinzō ni Hanataba o,” performed by Koume, and Kagura Nana performs the ending, “Hakuchūmu.” The third PV previews parts of both songs, making it a useful first listen without requiring viewers to treat a promotional cut as a full track release. How many episodes are in Season 2? The official pages checked for this update confirm the broadcast schedule, cast, staff and current episode information, but do not state a total episode count. The announcement that the home-video release is split into three volumes is not an episode-count confirmation, so it should not be used to infer a cour length. A final total can be reported once the production committee or distributor publishes it. At the time of this update, the official site had published episode 3's synopsis, but the overall count remained unspecified. Related reading: Dreamland Anime: Release Date, Episodes & Where to Watch . Where is the official Season 2 trailer? The official anime site embeds the third PV on KADOKAWAanime's verified YouTube channel. Its September 4 announcement says the video previews both theme songs and reiterates the October 7 broadcast start. Watch it on KADOKAWAanime's official YouTube page . The official third PV is viewable from KADOKAWAanime’s verified channel. What changed from the original July plan? Season 2 was first expected in July 2026. The production committee later postponed the broadcast to October, citing production circumstances. The official notice does not give a more detailed cause, so it is better to report the delay as stated instead of speculating about staffing, schedule conflicts or animation quality. The later September announcement then fixed the exact Japanese start date as October 7 and confirmed the weekly time and additional cast. Related reading: Granite Waves Anime: Story, Cast, Episodes & Where to Watch . What should viewers check next? For the current Japanese timetable, use the official On Air page; for character and production credits, use the official Staff & Cast page. Viewers outside Japan should verify their regional service catalog because the Japanese domestic list does not guarantee worldwide rights or matching release hours. Remaining details include the total episode count and any future schedule changes. AniNextUp will update this guide when the production committee or a licensed service confirms them. entries.content: OFFICIAL ANIME NEWS · OCTOBER 12, 2026 Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING: Story, Trailer and Release Status Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING is confirmed as a new anime continuing after the TV finale and adapting the manga’s Volume 27 epilogue. Its release date, format and streaming platform have not been announced. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Published: October 12, 2026 · Editorial policy Official celebratory illustration of Senku by Yuko Iwasa, shared with the October 10 production announcement. © Riichiro Inagaki, Boichi / Shueisha / Dr. STONE Production Committee. Release at a glance Production Confirmed October 10, 2026 Source “TERRAFORMING” sequel episode in manga Volume 27 Format and premiere Not announced Streaming No platform announced Official production announcement Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING is a newly announced anime project that continues the story after the television series finale. The official anime website announced production on October 10, 2026 , and confirmed that the project adapts the “TERRAFORMING” sequel episode included in Volume 27 of Riichiro Inagaki and Boichi’s manga. The announcement does not give a release date, format, staff list, cast list or streaming service. What is Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING? The project is an anime adaptation of a post-finale story from the original manga. The official production notice describes it as a continuation of the TV anime’s story and says the “TERRAFORMING” episode appears in manga Volume 27. That distinction answers the main search question: this is new material set after the story already adapted for television, rather than an announcement that the existing episodes will be remade. The production has chosen the title Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING . The official announcement calls it a new anime and a continuation, but does not identify it as a fifth season, movie, special, OVA or television series. Those labels describe different formats, so using one before the staff confirms it would give viewers a false expectation about length or how it will be released. Related reading: Naruto × Ninkū Anime: Four Episodes, Official Teaser and Release Status . How does it fit after the Dr. STONE finale? The official website notes that the TV anime series reached its final episode on June 25, 2026 , and says TERRAFORMING depicts the story’s continuation. The source material is the sequel episode in Volume 27, which follows the original manga’s main ending. In other words, the announcement points to a continuation beyond the story already adapted for television. Writer Riichiro Inagaki says in the official announcement that the anime had reached the manga’s final chapter, then celebrates the fact that Senku’s scientific adventure still has more story to tell. Illustrator Boichi also thanks the audience and welcomes the new adaptation. Their comments explain why this is a distinct post-finale update: the main manga ending was adapted, while Volume 27 also contains an additional sequel episode. The official notice has not published a full synopsis for the new anime. It confirms the source chapter and that the story continues, but does not explain which events will be expanded, how many chapters the adaptation will cover, or whether the anime will add original scenes. Viewers can safely expect a further chapter in Senku and the Kingdom of Science’s adventure; finer plot predictions should wait for an official story page. Related reading: Akane-banashi Season 2 Release Date: January 2027 and Story . Is this Dr. STONE Season 5? Not according to the project’s confirmed branding. The production uses the distinct title Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING and describes a continuation anime, without calling it Season 5 or specifying how it connects to the earlier season numbering. Fans may use “Season 5” as shorthand while discussing the project, but it is not an official format or premiere label at this stage. This matters for release searches. A new anime project can be a television season, a film, a special or another format, and the announcement has not settled that question. Until a format is named, there is no reliable episode count, theatrical date or weekly schedule to report. What does the announcement trailer show? The official website links a reveal PV featuring newly recorded dialogue from Senku. It is an announcement video for the production decision, rather than a full-length episode preview or a dated premiere trailer. The official page is dated October 10, 2026, but does not publish the video’s exact upload time or timezone. AniNextUp therefore leaves the exact timestamp unverified and does not include a VideoObject uploadDate. The official video remains linked below for readers who want to watch it. Related reading: Cosmoship Yamato √2199 Release Date: Story, Cast and What’s Confirmed . Who created the new Senku illustration? The official announcement also includes a celebratory Senku illustration by Yuko Iwasa , the TV series’ character designer. The artwork celebrates the continuation project; it is not a confirmed key visual for a particular release format. The production has also shown the TERRAFORMING title graphic, but has not described either image as a film poster or broadcast-season key visual. Who is returning, and where can viewers watch it? No cast or staff list for TERRAFORMING has been announced in the production notice. Iwasa’s credit on the celebration illustration does not establish her role on the new anime, and the previous TV staff should not automatically be treated as confirmed for this project. The same caution applies to the voice cast: the trailer uses Senku’s voice, but the official announcement does not publish a complete cast roster. The official site has not named a broadcaster, streaming platform or international distributor for TERRAFORMING. Previous Dr. STONE availability does not confirm rights for this new project. Viewers outside Japan should wait for a platform announcement covering their country rather than assuming that an earlier service will carry it. Related reading: Dandivine Release Date & Where to Watch: Japan Schedule, Cast and Story . Release date and confirmed details As of October 25, 2026, the verified status is simple: the anime is in production, but no premiere date has been announced . The format, episode count, full plot synopsis, returning staff and cast, Japanese broadcast schedule and international streaming plans remain unknown. No season or year should be inferred from the announcement PV. For updates, consult the official October 10 production announcement and the official TERRAFORMING video page . AniNextUp will update this guide when the production publishes a format, schedule or distribution details. or visit the production's video page . Official artwork: Senku returns Character designer Yuko Iwasa created a celebratory illustration of Senku for the announcement. The artwork is published directly on the anime's official website and is reproduced above with attribution. The production also revealed the Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING title graphic. Official Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING title graphic. Release date, episode count and streaming There is no confirmed premiere date for Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING as of the October 10 announcement. The production has not said whether the adaptation will be a television series, a special episode, an OVA or another format. Its episode count and the staff roster for this specific project also remain unannounced. Crunchyroll currently carries the earlier Dr. STONE anime, but that does not establish streaming rights for TERRAFORMING . No streaming platform should be listed as confirmed until the distributor announces it. What did the manga creators say? In comments published by the official anime website, writer Riichiro Inagaki expressed his excitement that the story continues after the television finale, while illustrator Boichi thanked fans and welcomed the new adaptation. Their statements reinforce that the project is officially in production; neither comment supplied a release date. Is this Dr. STONE Season 5? The production has announced the project under the title Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING , not as a numbered fifth season. Calling it “Season 5” would be premature until an official format and branding announcement is made. Official sources Dr. STONE official announcement (October 10, 2026) · Official teaser video page · Crunchyroll News confirmation . entries.content: OCTOBER 11 · 2026 Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Episode Schedule & Where to Watch Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is set to premiere in Japan on October 11, with a special advance screening at New York Comic Con on October 8. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases WHERE TO WATCH Japan: Prime Video & U-NEXT · October 12, 2026 (JST) Release at a glance Release October 11, 2026 in Japan and on Crunchyroll’s episode record Where to watch Japan streaming: Prime Video and U-NEXT, October 12, 00:15 JST Region and timing The episode record establishes a release date; playback still depends on territory and subscription. Release details checked October 18, 2026 · Dragon Ball Super: Beerus official episode listing · Dragon Ball official Beerus announcement Who might want to watch the enhanced edition? Dragon Ball Super: Beerus revisits established material with added and redrawn footage and a reconstructed narrative, according to the official description. That makes it relevant both to newcomers looking for this version of the story and to returning viewers interested in how familiar scenes have been reworked. The enhanced-edition label alone does not establish that every sequence is new. What the enhanced edition means for viewers The Beerus release is presented as an enhanced edition of the earlier Dragon Ball Super material, rather than a wholly unrelated Dragon Ball storyline. That distinction matters when deciding whether to watch it as a first introduction or revisit familiar events. The Japanese television debut and the shortly later Japanese streaming window are also separate release steps, not contradictory schedules. Dragon Ball Super: Beerus premieres in Japan on October 11, 2026, at 11:15 p.m. Japan Standard Time. The official Dragon Ball pre-broadcast guide published October 9 confirms the broadcast time and the first Japanese streaming services. This is the ENHANCED edition of Dragon Ball Super, with newly added and redrawn footage and a reconstructed narrative, according to the official New York Comic Con report . Related reading: BLEACH: THE LAST PV, Episode 50 Date & Where to Watch . Should returning fans expect an entirely new story? The official description calls Dragon Ball Super: Beerus an enhanced edition with additional and redrawn material and a reconstructed narrative. That signals a revised presentation of familiar events, not a confirmation of an unrelated sequel storyline. Returning viewers may want to compare how the Beerus material is presented, while newcomers can use the edition as an entry point to this part of the franchise. The announcements do not provide a scene-by-scene inventory of what has changed. Confirmed dates by distribution Territory or record Date Service Japan television October 11, 23:15 JST Japanese broadcast Japan advance streaming October 12, 00:15 JST Prime Video / U-NEXT Crunchyroll Episode 1 record Released October 11 Crunchyroll; local access applies Episode 2 October 18, 2026 Crunchyroll; schedule reported by GamesRadar ; local timing may vary Spain October 14 Disney+ Release date The Japanese premiere is scheduled for Sunday, October 11 at 11:15 p.m. JST . The first episode was screened in advance at New York Comic Con on October 8. The official report says the screening drew a crowd of approximately 3,000 attendees, with English dub cast members Jason Douglas (Beerus) and Ian Sinclair (Whis) taking part in the panel. This screening was a preview event, not a public streaming launch. What is confirmed? Akira Toriyama is credited for the original work, story and character design. The announced opening theme is “ONOGAMI” by MEGATERA・ZERO, while VK Blanka performs the ending theme. Where to watch Japan: The official pre-broadcast guide lists Prime Video and U-NEXT as the fastest streaming options, starting October 12 at 12:15 a.m. JST , after the October 11 television broadcast. Other Japanese streaming services are scheduled to follow. Outside Japan: Crunchyroll's Fall 2026 lineup lists the series for supported international territories. The October 9 official Dragon Ball report left North American timing for a separate announcement. The primary Crunchyroll Episode 1 record identifies “The God Who Destroys” as released on October 11, 2026 , with Japanese audio and Latin American Spanish, English and Brazilian Portuguese subtitles. We use that episode record for the premiere date. Episode 2 is scheduled for October 18, 2026 on Crunchyroll. GamesRadar lists a 9:00 a.m. Pacific / noon Eastern release, but local catalog timing can vary. The official Crunchyroll episode record continues to identify October 11 as Episode 1’s release date. A catalog release date does not guarantee playback in every territory. Regional platform update: The official Dragon Ball Super: Beerus website now lists Hulu for the United States, Disney+ for Canada and Latin America, and Crunchyroll and Netflix under worldwide streaming services. These listings identify announced distribution partners; they do not by themselves establish identical episode release times across every territory. Disney’s Spanish press office separately lists an October 14 Disney+ premiere for Spain. Viewers should use the platform schedule for their own country rather than treating the Japanese October 11 broadcast time as a global streaming time. Official anime platform list · Disney Spain announcement . Why this update matters The new official update adds an exact Japanese broadcast time, named Japanese streaming platforms and the first on-demand availability window. It also makes the international timing caveat important: a Japanese broadcast date does not guarantee simultaneous streaming in every region. The October 8 New York Comic Con screening confirms that Episode 1 has already received a preview, but does not establish a general release time outside Japan. entries.content: WEEKLY FANTASY ANIME · OCTOBER 2026 Dreamland Anime: Release Date, Episodes & Where to Watch Dreamland premiered on Japanese television October 18, 2026 at 2:00 a.m. JST, billed October 17 at 26:00. France’s ADN streaming launch was October 17; regional release times vary. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official teaser image, hosted locally. Source: Crunchyroll on YouTube . Release at a glance Japan TV October 18, 2026 at 2:00 a.m. JST (listed as October 17 at 26:00) France streaming ADN: October 17, 2026; weekly episodes Format Season 1 · 10 episodes · 22 minutes each Other regions Check local service catalog; partner lists do not confirm every territory Release details checked October 24, 2026 · Official Japanese anime site JAPAN TV October 18 · 2:00 a.m. JST FRANCE STREAMING ADN · October 17 FORMAT 10 × 22-minute episodes The anime has premiered, but “release date” depends on the country and platform. The official Japanese site lists the first television broadcast for Saturday, October 17, 2026 at 26:00. Written as a regular calendar time, that is Sunday, October 18 at 2:00 a.m. Japan Standard Time (JST). TV Asahi lists Episode 1 in its Sunday 2:00–2:30 a.m. slot. France’s Animation Digital Network (ADN) announced its streaming launch for October 17, with a new episode each week. These dates differ because the Japanese TV slot crosses midnight and the French platform has its own release calendar. In Japan, the official anime site lists weekly streaming windows: Saturday late-night 3:00 a.m. for one group of services and Monday midnight for another. The latest episode is also available free for a limited time on ABEMA and TVer. The site links to U-NEXT, Animehodai, d-Anime Store, DMM TV, FOD, Hulu and other services. Check the listing in your app, since each platform can set its own delivery time and catalog conditions. Ellipse Animation lists ADN, Crunchyroll and France Télévisions among project partners, but a partner list is not a country-by-country availability map. For France, ADN has an explicit October 17 launch notice; elsewhere, check your local catalog rather than assume a universal release hour. The story follows Terrence, a teenager whose mother died in a fire. He has feared flames ever since, and nightmares make him relive the loss. In the official synopsis, he eventually realizes he is dreaming and confronts that fear instead of running from it. The moment changes his role in the dream world: Terrence awakens as a Traveler, a Dreamer able to explore Dreamland, a dimension formed from humanity’s dreams and nightmares. The fantasy setting grows from a personal conflict rather than appearing as an unrelated portal adventure. Related reading: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Is Out on Netflix: Episodes & Trailer . The official anime site adds that Terrence wants to return to Dreamland to see his mother again. Its character profile describes him as an awkward, unlucky but kind high-school student who often becomes the group’s mood-maker. That background gives new viewers a useful starting point, but the site does not disclose how the season resolves his goal. It also profiles Eve, Lydia, Nyti and other companions for viewers who want to learn character names before watching. Dreamland is based on the French comic by Reno Lemaire. Ellipse Animation’s series page calls it a French manga and lists 21 volumes released and more than 550,000 copies sold in France. The production page describes the adaptation as a 10-episode first season, with 22 minutes per episode, 2D animation, and a mix of comedy, adventure and fantasy aimed at teens and adults. It does not state how many comic volumes the television season covers, so claims about its adaptation endpoint should wait for an official guide. Ellipse Animation and La Chouette Compagnie produce the series. The producer credits Juan Pablo Machado and Johanna Celse as directors; TV Asahi’s Japanese schedule lists Machado and Joe Celse in its staff block. Jean-Luc Cano and Antoine Maurel handle series composition, Bénédicte Ciaravino designs the characters and Fabien Nataf composes the music. The Japanese version has a localization team as well as the original production staff, reflecting that this French-origin story is being presented to a Japanese television audience. Related reading: The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2: Release Date, Episodes & Where to Watch . The Japanese cast includes Kakeru Hatano as Terrence, Asami Tano as Eve, Kaede Hondo as Lydia, Takuya Eguchi as Savane and Hiroyuki Yoshino as Sabba. TV Asahi’s Episode 1 listing also names Takuya Masumoto, Serika Hiromatsu, Makoto Furukawa, Daisuke Namikawa and Masahiko Tanaka. The official anime site reported additional cast news on October 23, so its cast page may expand after the premiere. Japanese localization and original French voice performances are separate audio tracks; check which version your streaming service provides. The Japanese-version opening is “movin’on” by Faulieu., and the ending is “dream catcher” by Ai Tomioka. The official site lists both performers and identifies the songs as written for Dreamland. The official teaser on Crunchyroll’s verified YouTube channel offers a short introduction to the series, but promotional footage does not confirm which scenes appear in later episodes. Related reading: Granite Waves Anime: Story, Cast, Episodes & Where to Watch . Crunchyroll published its official teaser on July 12, 2026 at 05:15:15 PDT (UTC−07:00), equivalent to 12:15:15 UTC. The original YouTube page declares that timestamp in its upload metadata. The teaser introduces the series; it does not establish a single streaming hour for every region. For a quick check: Japan’s Episode 1 was scheduled for October 18 at 2:00 a.m. JST, listed as October 17 at 26:00; ADN’s French streaming launch was October 17. Season 1 has ten 22-minute episodes. Platform partners and local schedules vary, while a second season and the portion of the comic adapted remain unannounced in the official sources reviewed here. entries.content: RELEASE NEWS · OCTOBER 21, 2026 ELECEED Anime Release Date: April 2027 and English Trailer ELECEED premieres in April 2027. Watch the official English trailer and check the confirmed studio, Crunchyroll plans and details still to come. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official promotional visual. © Jeho Son·ZHENA | WEBTOON © ELECEED Animation Partners. · Official source Release at a glance Release April 2027; exact premiere day unannounced Streaming Crunchyroll announced; regional catalog details to be checked Animation DandeLion Animation Studio Still to come Episode count, weekly streaming time and English dub schedule Release details checked October 24, 2026 · Official announcement When does the ELECEED anime come out? ELECEED is scheduled for April 2027. The production confirmed that month on October 21, 2026. Its English-language announcement describes a worldwide April premiere, while the Japanese notice confirms the broadcast month. Neither gives an exact first-episode date. April is therefore the useful date to put on a watchlist. It does not mean April 1, and it does not establish a weekday or an episode release hour. Those details need a separate schedule announcement. This guide keeps the month separate from information that has yet to be published. Where will ELECEED stream? Crunchyroll is the previously announced streaming partner. Its distribution announcement is the platform source; the newer production notice supplies the April window. A streaming licence and a dated episode listing answer different questions, so viewers still need their local service schedule before planning an episode-one watch. The English trailer is not an English dub release announcement. No dubbed launch date or English voice cast is established by the October 21 production notices. Likewise, “worldwide” in promotional wording should not be treated as a promise of identical subtitle choices, release hours or catalogue availability in every location. Related reading: ONE PIECE: Elbaph Arc English Dub Release Date and Crunchyroll Schedule . What is ELECEED about? Jiwoo is a young man who hides his remarkable reflexes while quietly helping other people and animals. Taking in an injured cat introduces him to Kayden, a formidable fighter trapped in feline form. Their unlikely household opens the door to a hidden society of people with extraordinary abilities. The appeal of that setup is the mismatch between the pair: Jiwoo's instinct is to help, while Kayden brings experience of a dangerous world that Jiwoo barely understands. The cat is central to their meeting and partnership, rather than an unrelated mascot. Newcomers can approach the series through that relationship without learning the wider cast in advance. Why is Jiwoo called Yu Kazahaya on the anime website? The official English trailer announcement calls the lead Jiwoo, matching the English WEBTOON synopsis. The Japanese anime site lists him as Yu Kazahaya . Readers moving between the two versions should expect different naming conventions rather than mistake the Japanese character listing for a different protagonist or a sequel. For cast searches, use the names printed in the anime's own credits. For the English comic, start with the names on WEBTOON. This also helps avoid attaching a voice actor to a fan-translated character name without an official match. Related reading: Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2 English Dub Release Date on HIDIVE . Who is in the Japanese cast, and which studio is making it? The official production website lists Junya Enoki as Yu Kazahaya, Tasuku Hatanaka as Jin Tatsuoka, Setsuji Sato as Dr. Delein, Hayato Dojima as Sota Yanagi and Shizuka Ito as Amane Yanagi. Kayden's voice credit remains a question mark on the current site; this guide does not assign an actor to that role. DandeLion Animation Studio produces the anime, with Hiroshi Nishikiori directing, Yousuke Kuroda handling scripts and series composition, and Minami Sakura designing the characters. These are production credits, not a guarantee of how many comic chapters will be adapted. An episode count and adaptation endpoint remain unannounced. Watch the official English-version trailer The production links the video titled “ELECEED | Official Trailer | Part 1 (English ver.)” from its October 21 notice. The original YouTube page records its upload as October 21, 2026, at 02:00:08 PDT (UTC−07:00) , equivalent to 09:00:08 UTC. That timestamp dates the promotional video, not the anime premiere. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER ON YOUTUBE ELECEED official channel Where can you read the original ELECEED comic? The English edition is on WEBTOON , credited to writer Jeho Son and artist ZHENA. Use the series page's “First episode” link to start at the beginning; its default list shows recent chapters, which can reveal later developments before a newcomer meets the characters. Reading the comic is optional background, not a prerequisite for watching an adaptation whose episode coverage is still unknown. Anyone wanting to avoid story spoilers can stop after the opening introduction and wait for the anime. Readers continuing further should follow the official episode order rather than guess where a future television season might finish. Is ELECEED a manga adaptation or a webtoon adaptation? The source is a Korean webtoon, presented in English on WEBTOON as an action comic. That is the original reading option linked by the anime production, rather than a novel that viewers need to find first. The Japanese site credits the source writer as SJH, while WEBTOON uses Jeho Son; ZHENA is credited for the artwork on both. Those credit differences can make searches look inconsistent, but the official pages identify the same source work. What should viewers check next? The remaining practical questions are the premiere day, broadcast slot, episode count, local streaming hour and language-track schedule. None is settled by a month-only release notice. We will update the guide when dated production or distributor announcements answer them. For shows with nearer confirmed schedules, use our anime calendar and streaming guide . The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure is confirmed for Japanese theaters on December 11. We intentionally keep undated titles out of the calendar until an official day is announced. See the December 2026 guide . This calendar is a living guide. Dates and regional availability may change, and AniNextUp will update entries as official distributors confirm new information. AniNextUp: Release dates and streaming availability can vary by region. This guide will be updated when new official information is confirmed. October: finding the right show and platform The October table is a starting point for shows whose season or release began during the month. For example, The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 began on October 2 and Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 arrived on Netflix on October 20. They use different distribution models: one is a television season, while the other is a standalone Netflix story. The individual guides explain the available viewing information for each. The Crunchyroll fall lineup lists territories separately for its shows. Check the local catalog for available episodes and languages. A subtitled simulcast does not establish a dub release date. November: streaming premieres and Japanese cinemas November combines new streaming titles with films scheduled for theaters in Japan. Those formats answer different questions: a streaming premiere tells viewers when a service plans to add a title, whereas a Japanese cinema opening identifies a theatrical market. International theaters and home-streaming dates can be announced later and may not match the Japanese date. Use the November release guide to compare the individual dates, then follow each title's source or local listing before making plans. When a film has a Japanese opening but no announced date for your country, keep that later date as unconfirmed rather than assuming simultaneous availability. December: exact dates and month-only windows The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters on December 11. Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment have announced international theatrical distribution, with release dates and ticket details to follow; the distributor's announcement distinguishes that plan from the Japanese opening. There is also a December window without an exact day in the sources checked: Disney Japan has announced Twisted-Wonderland The Animation: Episode of Savanaclaw for Disney+ in December. The December guide presents that month-only announcement separately from the film's dated opening. Check your regional Disney+ listing for local availability and any later date. How to read the dates and keep up A season premiere date is not a calendar of every later episode. Weekly releases can cross into November or December even when the series began in October, and a platform may display a different local day from a late-night Japanese broadcast. For ongoing shows, consult the current episode listing instead of adding a new season premiere to the table each week. This hub covers the whole October–December season; the linked monthly guides provide a closer look at each month. As of October 26, some October premieres have already passed while later releases remain upcoming. Dates and rights can change, so the production, broadcaster or streaming service is the best place to verify the latest details before watching or booking a ticket. Sources checked October 26, 2026: Crunchyroll's fall lineup and film announcement, and Disney Japan's Savanaclaw announcement.
