entries.title: Firefly Wedding Anime Release Date, Streaming & Where to Watch
entries.description: Firefly Wedding premiered October 9, 2026 on Crunchyroll. See the release date, episode schedule, where to watch and confirmed anime details.
entries.content: FALL 2026 · RELEASE GUIDE Firefly Wedding Anime Release Date, Streaming & Where to Watch Firefly Wedding premiered October 9, 2026 on Crunchyroll. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases RELEASE DATE October 9, 2026 STREAMING Crunchyroll Why the premise is more than a romance setup Satoko's proposal is made under immediate threat, which means the relationship begins as a survival decision rather than a conventional courtship. That tension is central to the story's appeal: readers can expect the romance to develop alongside danger and uncertainty. For release planning, the Fuji TV and Crunchyroll times should be read as separate official schedules, not converted into one another. Release date Firefly Wedding premiered October 9, 2026. The Japanese broadcast begins at 11:30 p.m. JST on Fuji TV’s Noitamina block, while Crunchyroll has confirmed streaming in its announced territories as the anime airs. Japanese broadcast vs. Crunchyroll release Fuji TV's Noitamina block lists the Japanese television premiere for 11:30 p.m. JST. Crunchyroll separately announced an October 9 simulcast at 9:00 a.m. PT. These are platform-specific schedules, not interchangeable time-zone conversions; viewers should check their local Crunchyroll catalog for availability. Animation is handled by david production. Is the manga complete, and where can you read it? Yes. Shogakukan released volume 13, the final collected volume of Oreco Tachibana’s manga, on October 19, 2026. The publisher describes it as the story’s conclusion and notes that it includes a side story and a short bonus manga. Readers looking for the complete ending can follow the manga through that volume. The anime’s confirmed cast, broadcast and streaming announcements do not say how much of the source story the television adaptation will cover. Its episode count and adaptation endpoint have not been announced, so the manga’s completion should not be mistaken for confirmation that the anime will adapt all of it. For English-language readers, VIZ’s Shojo Beat edition is still being released in collected volumes. VIZ lists volume 8 for October 13, 2026, and volume 9 as a preorder, so the English schedule trails the completed Japanese edition. Check VIZ’s official series page for current print and digital availability, and Shogakukan’s volume 13 listing for the Japanese finale. Dates and formats can differ by market and retailer. Related reading: Live-Action Firefly Wedding TV Drama: 2027 Release Window, Cast and Story . What is Firefly Wedding about? The story follows Satoko, a noblewoman in poor health who becomes the target of an assassin. Trying to survive, she makes an extraordinary marriage proposal to Shinpei, turning a kidnapping into a dangerous relationship built around a false wedding and increasingly complicated feelings. Studio and staff david production is producing the anime. Takahiro Kamei directs, Yuko Kakihara handles series composition and scripts, Yukiko Aikei is credited for character designs, and NOGRID composes the music. Where to watch Crunchyroll has announced streaming in its announced territories as the series airs. Catalog availability can still differ by territory, so viewers should check the local Crunchyroll listing near premiere time. You can also browse the AniNextUp streaming hub for other Fall 2026 releases. Official source View the official announcement → AniNextUp: Release dates and streaming availability can vary by region. This guide will be updated when new official information is confirmed. English dub release and cast Crunchyroll announced the English dub on October 22, with weekly episodes beginning Friday, October 23. Its first-episode cast includes Rowan Gilvie as Satoko, Kieran Flitton as Shinpei, Jason Douglas as Mitsueda, Ben Stegmair as Kotaro, R. Bruce Elliott as Jubei, Jordan Colea as Miwako and Chris Rager as Ozoe. These are English-language performance credits; they should be kept separate from the Japanese voice cast listed in the anime’s earlier production announcements. The same Crunchyroll notice names Samantha Herek as producer and Caitlin Glass as voice director. Those credits identify the English dub team, while the Japanese production remains at david production under director Takahiro Kamei. A localized cast announcement does not change the Japanese broadcast schedule or the original-language simulcast date. Who voices Satoko and Shinpei in Japanese? The anime's original Japanese leads are Lynn as Satoko Kirigaya and Koki Uchiyama as Shinpei Goto, according to Crunchyroll's production report . They are separate from Rowan Gilvie and Kieran Flitton, who voice the characters in the English dub. Both versions follow the same central premise, but their episodes can appear on different schedules. The October 9 Japanese-language launch and October 23 English-dub start are useful points of reference; the local episode page and audio selector show which version is currently available to a viewer. What time is the simulcast in the Caribbean? The published times convert to different local clocks even though both announcements give October 9. Fuji TV’s 11:30 p.m. JST broadcast corresponds to 10:30 a.m. Atlantic Standard Time (UTC−4) that same day. Crunchyroll’s 9:00 a.m. Pacific Time simulcast corresponds to noon AST for viewers in Puerto Rico or the Dominican Republic, if the series is available in their local catalog. Pacific Time is on daylight saving time (PDT, UTC−7) on October 9, so do not reuse that conversion in winter without checking the offset. The English dub has its own October 23 weekly start; use the episode’s language label to choose the version you want. Source: Crunchyroll’s official English dub cast and schedule announcement . Updated: October 26, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error October 22 cast update The anime’s official social announcement, reported by Crunchyroll on October 22, added Kazuyuki Okitsu to the cast as Eishin Nitobe. This is a supporting-cast update to the series already airing in Japan; it does not change the October 9 premiere date, the listed Fuji TV schedule or the existing streaming announcement. The casting report identifies the performer and character, but does not provide enough detail to infer how many episodes Nitobe will appear in or what role he will play in later story developments. For viewers keeping track of adaptation news, it is useful to separate this update from the manga’s separate live-action drama announcement for 2027. The anime and the planned drama are distinct projects, with separate casts and distribution arrangements. Crunchyroll’s anime coverage cannot be used to infer the drama’s cast, release date or streaming home. We will add those details only when the relevant production or broadcaster confirms them. Source: Crunchyroll’s October 22 cast report . Official trailer ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Crunchyroll Official release time and territories: Crunchyroll October 6 announcement .

entries.title: The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop Anime Premieres January 2027
entries.description: The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop anime premieres in January 2027. See the new teaser, key visual, confirmed cast, studio and where it will air.
entries.content: NEW ANIME · OCTOBER 6, 2026 The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop Anime Premieres January 2027 The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop has confirmed a January 2027 Japanese TV launch alongside a new key visual, second teaser PV and a new cast announcement. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases RELEASE AT A GLANCE JANUARY 2027 · TOKYO MX, MBS, BS11 + OTHER NETWORKS project No.9 · EXACT DAY/TIME TBA Release at a glance Release window: January 2027. Confirmed Japanese broadcasters: TOKYO MX, MBS and BS11, among others. Studio: project No.9. Exact premiere date and time: not announced. International streaming: not announced as of October 25, 2026. What is The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop about? The series begins ten years after a hero defeats the Demon Lord and peace returns. In Saisho, a former Level 1 village where adventurers once gathered, Murabito has inherited his late father's item shop, Sudachi-ya. With fewer adventurers setting out, the store is nearly empty. Murabito keeps it open while taking odd jobs, convinced it matters because it was the first shop the legendary hero visited. His routine changes when Mao, a mysterious girl with golden eyes, appears. The official introduction identifies those eyes as a trait of the demon race and says meeting her changes Murabito's ordinary life. The key visual and second teaser introduce her as someone who claims to be the Demon Lord defeated ten years earlier. The premise turns a familiar fantasy ending into a new beginning: what does peace mean to a village whose livelihood depended on adventurers, and what should Murabito do when the past returns? Related reading: Demon's Crest Release Date: November 6, 2026 and Where to Watch . Why the item-shop premise matters Many fantasy stories follow the party that leaves town to fight a monster. This one begins with the person who supplied that party and stayed behind. Fewer battles may be good for the world, yet fewer customers threaten a family business and a village's old role. That is an interpretation of the official setup, not a separate plot claim. It explains how the story can mix shopkeeping and comedy with questions about the old conflict without making Murabito a conventional warrior protagonist. Saisho's nickname, the Level 1 village, places it at the beginning of a game-like adventure route. The shop is more than a backdrop for buying equipment: it represents a community trying to adapt after the hero's journey has supposedly ended. The announcement does not reveal how much of the manga the anime will adapt or how many volumes a season may cover. What did the latest anime announcement confirm? The production committee's October 6, 2026 update confirmed a January 2027 broadcast window, released a new key visual and published teaser PV 2. It also announced Yōhei Azakami as Ash, the hero who defeated the Demon Lord and now lives in Saisho. The visual brings Murabito, Mao and Ash together, but does not resolve Mao's claim or name a premiere episode. Related reading: Haru to Gen Anime Premieres January 4, 2027: Cast and Teaser . The announcement listed 13 collected manga volumes as of October 2026 and said volume 14 was scheduled for October 16. That describes the source material's publication, not the anime's episode count. Cast and production staff Reiji Kawashima voices Murabito, Rumi Ōkubo voices Mao and Yōhei Azakami voices Ash. Confirmed core staff are director Jun Hira, series composer Keiichirō Ōchi, character designer Katsuyuki Satō and music composer Takurō Iga. Project No.9 is producing the animation. The official update does not list episode directors or a complete production schedule. Where can viewers watch it? For Japan, the official announcement names TOKYO MX, MBS and BS11, followed by “and other channels.” It does not list broadcast days, start times, simulcast services or catch-up platforms. No international streaming service or territory list has been announced in the official material checked for this update. A Japanese television announcement does not confirm that a particular overseas platform will carry the series. AniNextUp will update this guide if a distributor publishes territories and a streaming date. Related reading: The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival Anime Premieres July 2027 . Does the second teaser give an exact release date? No. The official wording is January 2027: a month, not a calendar day or time. The teaser introduces the three leads and the new cast member, while the official news post supplies network and staff information. Neither confirms an episode count, theme-song lineup or international release schedule. Is there an official trailer? Yes. The official anime site links teaser PV 2, published on October 6, 2026, and the production committee describes it as a preview focused on Murabito, Mao and Ash. The original video page gives its publication time as October 6 at 01:00:13 PDT (UTC−07:00), the same calendar date as the Japanese announcement. The embedded player below uses that official video. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER YouTube · click to play Where to read the source manga The anime adapts Makoto Morishita's manga, serialized in Kodansha's Monthly Shōnen Magazine. Kodansha's K MANGA service carries the English title and provides an official synopsis: peace after the hero's victory leaves Villager's store empty until a mysterious girl arrives. The publisher listing is a direct place to sample the source and check digital availability. Access, pricing and chapter availability can vary by region; the anime announcement does not promise that either title will be available everywhere. What remains unannounced As of October 25, 2026, the exact premiere day, Japanese broadcast times, episode total, opening and ending songs, international streaming partners, dubbed-language plans and regional release dates remain unconfirmed in the official material reviewed. Until a schedule is published, the accurate answer to “When does it come out?” is January 2027 in Japan. Official sources Read the official anime announcement for the window, key visual, Ash casting and PV; see DeNA's production announcement for the premise, network list and staff. Kodansha's K MANGA listing is the authorized English manga source. Updated: October 25, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error Official series updates: The Fledgling Demon Lord’s Starter Shop official news . Production details: DeNA, October 6, 2026 .

entries.title: Fool Night Release Date: November 26 on Netflix
entries.description: Netflix lists Fool Night for November 26, 2026, in the United States and describes the anime as a global Netflix series.
entries.content: NOVEMBER 26 · 2026 Fool Night Release Date: November 26 on Netflix Netflix lists Fool Night for November 26, 2026, in the United States and describes the anime as a global Netflix series. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official promotional visual. Artwork source: official release announcement . WHERE TO WATCH Netflix · global title Release at a glance Release date November 26, 2026 Availability Netflix; release timing may vary by territory Release format All episodes begin streaming November 26 Studios SUNRISE and SHAFT Checked October 23, 2026 · Official Netflix Media Center listing When does Fool Night release? Netflix Media Center lists November 26, 2026 as the U.S. release date. Netflix describes Fool Night as a global Netflix series, but the sources reviewed do not confirm that every territory launches on that date. What is Fool Night? The series is a dystopian human drama produced by Sunrise and Shaft. Its future world depends on a technology that transforms people into plants as humanity struggles with a shortage of oxygen. Where can you watch it? Netflix is the announced exclusive streaming home. Check your local Netflix title page for language options and release timing. The announcement does not establish a universal hour or an episode count. Related reading: GROTESQQQUE Release Date: November 6, Netflix Preview & Stories . What the announcement means for viewers What the date confirms. The Netflix Media Center lists November 26, 2026 for the United States, and Netflix describes the anime as a global Netflix series. Netflix’s official second teaser says all episodes start streaming November 26; it does not give a complete episode count or specify every local release hour. Check the Netflix title page in your region as launch approaches. Worldwide distribution does not mean identical viewing options. The announcement describes an exclusive global Netflix launch, but it does not provide a country-by-country list of audio, subtitles or local release times for this title. Check the title's Netflix listing in your region rather than assuming the same language catalog everywhere. Will Fool Night release weekly? Netflix's official second teaser says all episodes start streaming on November 26, 2026. That indicates a full release rather than an announced weekly rollout. The teaser does not specify the total number of episodes or a local launch hour. Related reading: Anime Releasing in November 2026: Dates & Where to Watch . Netflix describes the project as a worldwide exclusive, while its Media Center lists the date for the United States. Local availability, audio and subtitles should still be checked on the Netflix title page for the country where you watch. Why Fool Night stands out The premise turns oxygen into a social and moral dilemma: people may undergo a transformation into plants in a world where humanity relies on the oxygen those plants produce. That setup makes the series more than a conventional post-apocalyptic survival story. Its central question is whether a person's chance to escape suffering can be separated from the needs of the wider community. This is AniNextUp's interpretation of the officially described premise, not an additional plot revelation. What is confirmed and what remains unknown? Confirmed: November 26, 2026; Netflix distribution; November 26 U.S. release date; animation by Sunrise and Shaft. Not specified in the cited announcement: a precise worldwide release hour, a complete episode count, or a full region-by-region subtitle and dub schedule. Official announcement Netflix’s Anime NYC 2026 announcement presents Fool Night as a global Netflix series. Its official second teaser says all episodes start streaming November 26. Related reading: Demon's Crest Release Date: November 6, 2026 and Where to Watch . For the rest of the month, see our November anime schedule , which separates streaming premieres from Japanese cinema openings. Why the premise calls the technology “Transfloration” Netflix’s description gives the story a concrete dilemma. In the future shown in the official synopsis, thick clouds leave Earth in constant winter and darkness, much of its vegetation has died, and the remaining oxygen shortage has reshaped society. Transfloration implants seeds in people near death and turns them into plants. Toshiro Kamiya, a young man struggling with poverty and the cost of caring for his mother, considers becoming a Spiriflor. That choice connects an individual’s suffering to a system that depends on transformed people for oxygen. This context makes the series’ question more specific than “would you become a plant?” The official synopsis frames survival, poverty and the social use of Transfloration as linked parts of the setting. Any moral conclusion about what Toshiro should do is interpretation; Netflix has not published a complete plot summary that answers it. Related reading: Expelled from Paradise Sequel Reveals Main Trailer and Beyond the Night Theme Song . Confirmed production details and what is still missing Netflix Media Center identifies Kasumi Yasuda’s manga as the source and lists SUNRISE and SHAFT as the animation production partners. It also credits director Atsushi Yukawa, series composition writer Jin Tanaka, character designer Robert Sato, sound director Yota Tsuruoka and composer Tatsuya Kato. The Media Center lists November 26, 2026 as the U.S. release date, while Netflix’s Anime NYC announcement presents the title as a global Netflix series. That supports the platform and date, but neither source supplies a local launch hour for every country. Netflix’s listed title page is the place to check local audio, subtitle and maturity-rating details as launch approaches. Netflix’s official second teaser says all episodes start streaming November 26; it does not specify the total episode count. Readers can treat November 26 as the announced launch date and look to Netflix for the episode format and territory-specific catalog information. Updated: October 26, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error

entries.content: RETURNING SERIES · RELEASE GUIDE Frieren Season 3 Release Date: October 2027 & Golden Land Arc Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End returns for the Golden Land Arc in October 2027. Here is the confirmed Japanese release window, the official visual and the streaming and trailer details still awaiting confirmation. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official Season 3 teaser visual featuring Macht · ©山田鐘人・アベツカサ／小学館／「葬送のフリーレン」製作委員会. Source: official season announcement . Release at a glance Japan release October 2027; exact day TBA Arc Golden Land Arc Japanese broadcast Nippon TV network International streaming Not confirmed in the cited announcement Checked October 18, 2026 · Official Season 3 announcement When will Frieren Season 3 be released? Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Season 3 is scheduled to begin broadcasting in Japan in October 2027 on the Nippon TV network. The official March 27, 2026 announcement confirms the month and the Golden Land Arc. It does not give an exact day, broadcast hour or episode count. What is the Golden Land Arc? The next season is titled 黄金郷編, commonly rendered in English as the Golden Land Arc. Its announcement spotlights Macht of the Golden Land, described as the last and strongest of the Seven Sages of Destruction. That is the extent of the story detail needed to understand the teaser without discussing later manga events. What is the latest official update? The production began a Season 3 countdown-art campaign on September 26, 2026. Its first illustration, by character designer Keisuke Kojima, features Frieren, Fern and Stark and marks the year remaining until the planned broadcast. The countdown announcement continues to use the October 2027 window. Is there an official Season 3 trailer? The March announcement released the Macht teaser visual shown above. At this guide’s October 18 check, the official video catalog listed earlier-season promotional videos; we could not verify a Season 3 trailer there. This page will add a playable trailer once a season-specific official video is confirmed. Related reading: MASHLE Season 3 Release Date: January 2027, Arc and Teaser . Where will Frieren Season 3 stream? The Japanese announcement names Nippon TV’s network for television. It does not establish an international streaming service or a global simulcast timetable. Crunchyroll’s announcement coverage confirms that it carries the first two seasons; that alone is not a Season 3 distribution confirmation. What should viewers know before the new season? Frieren follows an elven mage’s life after the defeat of the Demon King, exploring what her journey with human companions means across different lifespans. The official introduction places Season 3 after the two completed seasons. Viewers catching up can follow those in release order before this continuation. Official sources and remaining details This guide brings together the March season announcement , September countdown update and official series introduction . Exact premiere day, international platform, new-season cast and staff announcements, episode count and trailer will be added when confirmed. Browse more returning anime . Related reading: ONE PIECE: Elbaph Arc English Dub Release Date and Crunchyroll Schedule . Why the subtitle matters The official name for the continuation is Season 3: Golden Land Arc . That subtitle identifies the story segment the production has chosen to adapt; it is more specific than saying only that Frieren is coming back. The announcement introduces Macht of the Golden Land as a key character and describes him as the last and strongest of the Seven Sages of Destruction. It confirms that Frieren and her companions will confront him, but it does not reveal the full shape of the season or its episode count. This is an adaptation update, not a new series with an independent starting premise. Viewers who have not finished the earlier seasons may want to catch up before October 2027, but the current notice does not publish a viewing order or streaming plan. The official Japanese broadcast window is the confirmed detail; the international catalog remains a separate announcement to watch for. Who created the original Frieren manga? The anime adapts the manga written by Kanehito Yamada and illustrated by Tsukasa Abe. English-language publisher VIZ presents the original premise around Frieren, an elf mage who outlives her former companions after their victory over the Demon King. Related reading: Pokémon Horizons Anime Unseals Treasures of Ruin in Latest Wonder Voyage Arc Trailer . That long perspective is central to the series: memories of an earlier adventure shape the way Frieren travels with a new generation. The officially announced Golden Land Arc continues the existing adaptation rather than resetting the story for a new audience. Can the manga confirm the anime's episode count? No. The manga gives readers the source story, but the production has not announced how many episodes the third season will contain or where each episode will divide the material. Readers who prefer to avoid spoilers can follow the season announcement and teaser visual without searching for later chapter summaries. For a specific television day or international streaming service, wait for an update from the production or an authorized distributor. The current official October 2027 window remains the confirmed starting point. Related reading: Anime Mysterious Codes (October 2026): Reports & Redemption Guide . How precise is the October 2027 date? It is a month, not a day. The anime’s official announcement says the third season will air from October 2027 on the Nippon TV network. It supplies no particular Sunday, weekday or time slot. The teaser visual is official artwork for the Golden Land storyline, but it is not a schedule card and cannot be used to infer the exact premiere. The distinction is practical for calendars and reminders. A page that lists “October 2027” should remain month-level until the broadcaster or production committee posts a date. Likewise, an international service should not be named just because it streamed an earlier season; licenses can differ by season and territory. The official site remains the source to revisit for a day, broadcast slot, cast or staff update. We will update those fields when the production confirms them, rather than turning the current window into a more precise claim. entries.title: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers: Premiere, Cast, Streaming and Official Trailer

entries.content: OFFICIAL NEWS · OCTOBER 10, 2026 Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers: Premiere, Cast, Streaming and Official Trailer The anime began airing in Japan on October 11, 2026. Here is the confirmed weekly schedule, where to check streaming, and what viewers should know about the story, cast and PV. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official key visual. ©大崎アイル・オーバーラップ／信者ゼロ製作委員会 RELEASE DATE October 11, 2026 STREAMING Crunchyroll · Select regions STUDIO HORNETS Release at a glance Japanese premiere Sunday, October 11, 2026 · BS Asahi, 11:30 p.m. JST Japanese simulcast d Anime Store, U-NEXT and Anime Hodai at the same weekly time Other regions Crunchyroll lists the series for select territories; local schedules vary Studio HORNETS Checked October 26, 2026 · Official anime site and schedule · Crunchyroll Fall 2026 lineup Has the anime premiered? Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers began its Japanese television and same-time streaming run on Sunday, October 11, 2026. The confirmed first broadcast is BS Asahi at 11:30 p.m. Japan Standard Time (JST). That is 2:30 p.m. UTC on October 11, but it is not a universal streaming time: platforms in other countries publish their own schedules, and the Japanese time should not be mistaken for a local Crunchyroll listing. The official anime site lists a weekly Sunday 11:30 p.m. JST slot for BS Asahi and the Japanese services d Anime Store, U-NEXT and Anime Hodai. Its schedule also lists TOKYO MX from Monday, October 12 at midnight, AT-X from Tuesday, October 13 at 9 p.m., and additional Japanese services from Saturday, October 17 at 11:30 p.m. Those are Japan schedules. Viewers outside Japan should check the title page in their local service account for current territory, subtitle, dub and episode availability. What is the story about? Makoto Takatsuki is a high-school student and avid role-playing-game player who is transported to another world with his class after an accident. The other students receive powerful abilities; Makoto instead gets weak stats and the lowly designation of apprentice mage. He is not introduced as a secretly unbeatable hero. His game knowledge matters because he studies rules, trains patiently and looks for practical uses for limited skills. Related reading: In a World Full of Zombies Anime: January 2027 Premiere, New Trailer, Cast and Music . That changes when Makoto meets Noah, a minor goddess with no believers. She asks him to become her first follower. The official anime site frames the pair's journey as a difficult fantasy adventure: Makoto must survive in a world where faith has consequences, while Noah has her own hidden past. The unusual title is a plot premise, not a claim that the anime is a game adaptation. It is based on Isle Osaki's light novels; the official site separately credits a manga adaptation by Shiroi Hakuto. What does the first episode set up? The official guide calls episode one “Makoto Takatsuki Becomes a Believer.” Its synopsis explains why Makoto is left behind while classmates with stronger gifts are recruited by different countries, and how the overlooked apprentice mage encounters Noah. Episode two moves him to Macallan, where he registers as an adventurer and takes on quests. The third listing introduces Lucy, an elf mage who becomes his first party companion. These summaries help new viewers understand the starting arc without guessing how much of the books the season adapts. Related reading: Gundam SEED FREEDOM ZERO: Release Date, Viewing Order & Cast . The appeal is the contrast between familiar RPG language and a protagonist who cannot solve everything with a high-level skill. Makoto studies rules, tests limited abilities and relies on allies. Noah's lack of followers also gives the goddess a vulnerable position. Their relationship makes faith and trust part of the adventure's progression. Cast, staff and music Sohei Horikane voices Makoto, Ikumi Hasegawa plays Noah, Yukina Shuto is Lucy and Hitomi Sekine is Aya Sasaki. Supporting cast includes Masaaki Mizunaka as Michio Fujiwara, Lynn as Nina, Kensho Ono as Ryosuke Sakurai, Sayumi Suzushiro as Sophia and Rumi Okubo as Marie. The official site lists Toshinori Fukushima as director, Toko Machida for series composition and scripts, Noriko Ito for character design, AstroNoteS for music and HORNETS for animation production. Related reading: Bass X Machina: Official Full Trailer, Netflix Release Date & Cast . The opening song is “Mirai no Ashiato” by 310; the ending is “Fall in Dream” by Suupeas. The official music page credits sabio and Akki for writing, composing and arranging the opening, and jon -YAKITORY for the ending. The first PV offers an early listen to “Mirai no Ashiato,” a useful way to hear how the production presents its fantasy adventure. Official trailer and what it confirms The first promotional video is on the Showgate channel, linked as the movie source by the anime's official site. The original YouTube page records its upload as September 29, 2026 at 8:00:13 p.m. PDT (UTC−07:00), or September 30 at 3:00:13 a.m. UTC; it runs 1 minute and 1 second. This is separate from the Crunchyroll article date and Japanese broadcast time. The PV identifies the October 11 start in its title and previews the opening theme, but does not establish episode count, a worldwide launch hour or an English dub schedule. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER ON YOUTUBE Showgate official channel Light novel, manga and anime: which should you start with? J-Novel Club's official English listing describes the novels as the source: Makoto has weak stats, an apprentice-mage class and a ten-year life limit, while Noah's blessing gives him a goal. The listing is useful if you want the longer prose version and volume-by-volume continuation. The manga is a separate adaptation, illustrated by Hakuto Shitori in English publication; it offers a comics format. The anime adds voice performances, music and a weekly schedule. Official materials do not say it covers every novel volume, so do not assume the season completes the story. No official guide maps anime episodes to novel volumes, so a post-finale starting point is unconfirmed. Overlap's volume 13 listing says it was released in Japan on April 20, 2026; that confirms print continuation, not the anime's stopping point. What has not been confirmed? The official pages reviewed confirm the Japanese schedule, named cast and staff, theme songs and first episode guide. They do not state a total episode count, final broadcast date, or universal international release time. Nor is an English dub schedule announced. Treat service availability shown in your country as the reliable answer rather than converting Japan's slot into a promise for every region. For updates, use the official anime site for broadcast, story, character and music news; its September 4 schedule notice lists the Japanese times. J-Novel Club provides the official English light-novel listing . For international streaming, check the Fall 2026 Crunchyroll lineup and your local catalog. entries.title: Ghost of Tsushima: Legends Anime Delayed to 2028: New Cast, Staff and Streaming Details
entries.description: Ghost of Tsushima: Legends anime moves from 2027 to 2028. Find confirmed cast, studio, Crunchyroll streaming plans and the official teaser.
entries.content: OFFICIAL NEWS · OCTOBER 12, 2026 Ghost of Tsushima: Legends Anime Delayed to 2028: New Cast, Staff and Streaming Details The anime adaptation of the supernatural multiplayer mode is now planned for 2028 instead of 2027, with new voice cast and production credits confirmed. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official teaser image from Crunchyroll’s verified anime trailer. © Sony Interactive Entertainment / Ghost of Tsushima production partners. Release at a glance Release 2028; exact date pending Where to watch Crunchyroll exclusive; detailed regional schedule pending Applies to Announced release year Still pending Exact premiere date, episode count and country schedules Release details checked October 23, 2026 · Official source When will the Ghost of Tsushima: Legends anime premiere? The Ghost of Tsushima: Legends anime has been moved to 2028 , replacing the previously announced 2027 release window. Crunchyroll confirmed the revised year during its New York Comic Con 2026 announcements, alongside additional cast and staff. A specific premiere day or month has not been announced. Read Crunchyroll’s official update. The new schedule is a delay of the release window, not a cancellation. The companies have not publicly given a definitive reason for the change. Claims about production trouble, a particular episode count or a precise 2028 launch date would therefore go beyond the confirmed information. Which new voice actors have joined? Mayumi Saco and Shinya Fukumatsu have joined the cast in roles that remain undisclosed. Saco voiced Tomoe in the original Ghost of Tsushima game, while Fukumatsu is known for voicing Bomb in One-Punch Man . Their participation does not establish which characters they will portray in the anime; in particular, Saco's casting should not be taken as confirmation that she will reprise Tomoe. Who is making the anime? Takanobu Mizuno , known for the Star Wars: Visions short “The Duel,” directs the series at animation studio Kamikaze Douga . Gen Urobuchi handles series composition and co-writes the script with Renji Oki . Takashi Okazaki is credited with character design. Newly named staff include Keiji Inai on music, Yoshikazu Iwanami on sound direction, Yasumasa Koyama on sound effects and Gyousyou Suzuki on title calligraphy. The series is produced by HAYATE with Aniplex and PlayStation Productions, while Sony Music participates as music and soundtrack partner. These roles are distinct from the developer of the original game, Sucker Punch Productions. Will Ghost of Tsushima: Legends stream on Crunchyroll? Yes. The series remains announced as a Crunchyroll exclusive . The 2028 release window applies to the anime’s planned premiere, but the platform has not yet provided a complete country-by-country schedule or confirmed the exact release day. Fans should wait for a further streaming announcement before making plans around a specific date. Does the move to 2028 mean cancellation? No cancellation has been announced. Crunchyroll changed the planned release window from 2027 to 2028 and also named more production staff and cast. The official update does not identify a precise 2028 premiere date or give a definitive reason for the schedule change. How does the anime connect to the game? The anime draws on Legends , the cooperative multiplayer experience introduced to Sucker Punch Productions’ Ghost of Tsushima in 2020. That mode emphasizes Japanese folklore, supernatural threats and cooperative combat, rather than simply retelling the main game’s historical storyline. The adaptation’s production team has described the project as a new animated interpretation of that setting. Sony Music, Crunchyroll, Aniplex and PlayStation Productions first announced the anime project in January 2025. The original announcement targeted 2027, making the latest 2028 update a change to a previously public release plan. Read Sony Music’s original announcement. Watch the official Ghost of Tsushima: Legends teaser Crunchyroll published the official teaser on July 9, 2026. YouTube’s original upload metadata lists 5:00:22 p.m. PDT (UTC−07:00). That is the video upload time, not the anime’s premiere time. The teaser predates the October release-window update and should not be described as a newly released 2028 trailer. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TEASER ON YOUTUBE Opens the official Crunchyroll video What remains unconfirmed? As of October 23, 2026, the anime has a confirmed 2028 release year, studio, major creative staff, new cast members and streaming partner. An exact premiere date, episode count, full voice-role assignments and detailed international release times have not been published. AniNextUp will update this report when the production partners confirm further details. Sources: Crunchyroll’s October 2026 announcement ; Sony Music’s original 2025 announcement ; official Crunchyroll teaser . Last reviewed October 23, 2026. What should players expect from the adaptation? PlayStation's original Legends announcement describes a cooperative mode shaped by Japanese folklore and mythology. It offers context for the anime's inspiration, but it is a game announcement rather than a detailed episode synopsis. The anime's confirmed year is 2028, and Crunchyroll is the announced streaming partner. Neither detail identifies which game missions or playable characters will appear. The casting of actors in undisclosed roles likewise leaves their characters open until the production names them. What does “Legends” mean in the game? PlayStation described Legends as a co-op mode inspired by Japanese mythology. Its launch formats included two-player Story missions and four-player Survival missions, with supernatural twists on combat from the main game. That context explains why the anime can draw on folklore and a team setting instead of simply retelling Jin Sakai’s solo campaign. It does not reveal the anime’s plot: the production has not named its central characters, confirmed an adaptation of a specific mission or said whether it will use the game’s player classes. PlayStation’s description of the mode is useful background, not a synopsis of the anime. Updated: October 26, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error

entries.title: Granite Waves Anime: Story, Cast, Episodes & Where to Watch
entries.description: What is Granite Waves? Meet Tezeze’s vertical animated series, its story and cast, the Ryuu release, free pilot episodes and where to watch.
entries.content: RELEASE NEWS · NOW STREAMING Granite Waves Anime: Story, Cast, Episodes & Where to Watch Granite Waves is Tezeze’s creator-led vertical animated series, combining science fantasy, supernatural danger and a heist story in episodes designed for mobile screens. The series launched with Ryuu’s August 25, 2026 premiere. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Published: October 17, 2026 · How we verify releases Official character artwork of Ing. Artwork and character source: Granite Waves official website . Release at a glance Release Ryuu’s platform premiere was August 25, 2026 Format Original vertical animated series made for mobile viewing Creator, showrunner and director Tezeze Where to watch Ryuu website and app Free viewing The pilot episodes are available in the app without a subscription; regular streaming requires a subscription Latest episode schedule Ryuu promotes regular new episodes; a fixed weekly day and time are not listed on its current series page Visit the official Ryuu series page · Ryuu App on the Apple App Store What is Granite Waves? Granite Waves is an original animated series created by Tezeze and produced with Ryuu. Ryuu describes its shows as vertical anime originals: the episodes are composed for full-screen phone viewing in a tall 9:16 format. That makes Granite Waves different from a conventional Japanese television-anime season, even though its creator and platform present it to anime fans. The series is designed around short installments rather than standard 20-minute television episodes. Ryuu’s current page promotes regular episode drops, but it does not give a fixed day and time for every new episode. We will update this guide if the platform publishes a more specific schedule. What is the story about? The official synopsis describes a world where reality begins to break down and people disappear. Elya arrives in an isolated place while trying to make a new start; elsewhere, Zima and Ing attempt a dangerous heist in the Forbidden Places. They are presented as survivors and outcasts whose plans often go wrong. The story blends dark science fantasy, supernatural threats and heist elements. Related reading: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Is Out on Netflix: Episodes & Trailer . Ryuu’s character material introduces Elya as a scientist, while its series page names the creator-led team behind the production. The official synopsis does not disclose every connection between the characters, so this guide keeps the premise spoiler-light. Granite Waves cast The official series site identifies several voice actors alongside the characters: Related reading: The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2: Release Date, Episodes & Where to Watch . Sarah Natochenny as Elya Peyton Howard as Blacksmith Scotty Morace as Max Bright Douglas as Ing The official site also features additional characters and cast material. We will add more role credits when the production confirms them clearly. Watch the official Granite Waves pilot The first pilot installment is available through the official Granite Waves channel. It is the series’ pilot episode, rather than a trailer for a Japanese television series. ▶ WATCH THE OFFICIAL PILOT Pilot Part 1 · Granite Waves Where can you watch Granite Waves? Granite Waves streams on Ryuu , the platform backing the series. Ryuu says its app is available on the Apple App Store and Google Play, and its FAQ says viewers can download the app for free and watch the pilot episodes before deciding whether to subscribe. The platform directs viewers to its website to start a subscription and stream the regular episode lineup. Availability, subscription prices and payment options can vary by country and can change. Check Ryuu’s official page and your app store listing for the current offer in your region. AniNextUp does not sell access to the series. Who is behind Granite Waves? Ryuu credits Tezeze as the series' creator, showrunner and director. Its official series page also identifies Aga Pałka as executive producer and producer and Roslind Sanders as script editor, alongside animation, music and sound contributors. The credits identify a creator-led team working across several disciplines; they do not establish that one person makes every part of the series alone. What does vertical animation mean for viewers? The series is designed for a tall screen, so its framing is different from the wide format usually associated with television. Ryuu describes its originals as mobile-first stories; this is useful context for watching the pilot on a phone and understanding how the composition is intended to be seen. Vertical format describes the presentation, not the length of an entire season. A short pilot installment, a platform launch date and an ongoing episode schedule are separate things. The YouTube video linked in this guide is identified as Pilot Part 1; viewers looking for later installments should check Ryuu's current series listing rather than assume that the pilot represents the complete show. What should viewers check before subscribing? The official platform offers subscription options and says the app can be downloaded for free. Before paying, verify the current price, billing period, local availability and what is included on the service's own checkout page. A free pilot is a way to sample the series, but it does not by itself establish that all subsequent episodes are free. Is Granite Waves a Japanese anime? Ryuu markets Granite Waves as a vertical anime original, but it is best described editorially as an independent, creator-led animated series made for mobile viewing. It is not presented by its official sources as a conventional Japanese TV-anime adaptation with a Japanese broadcast schedule. This distinction helps explain why searches for an “anime release date” can lead to information about Ryuu’s platform launch instead of a TV premiere. Granite Waves release date and episode status Ryuu’s official subscription page identifies August 25, 2026 as the platform premiere and says new episodes start after that date. The series is now available through Ryuu. Its current official pages promote regular new episodes, while the free app access is specifically described as covering the pilot episodes. We could not confirm a complete public episode-by-episode schedule or a separate international broadcaster. For the latest availability, check the official Granite Waves site and Ryuu . We will distinguish any future episode date from the original platform launch. Official sources and verification Granite Waves official site — series format, synopsis, creator, character pages and voice-actor credits. Ryuu official series page and FAQ — platform premiere, current streaming access, pilot availability and app information. Ryuu App listing on Apple App Store — official app description and featured series. Granite Waves official Instagram — original pilot announcement and series account. Official Granite Waves pilot part 1 on YouTube . Sources checked October 17, 2026. Ryuu labels August 25 as its platform premiere; current public series materials do not provide a fixed release time for each subsequent episode. entries.title: GROTESQQQUE Release Date: November 6, Netflix Preview & Stories
entries.description: GROTESQQQUE opens in Japan November 6. The 4649GIRL chapter is streaming on Netflix Japan through November 5; see the three stories, cast and viewing details.
entries.content: OCTOBER 19, 2026 · MOVIE RELEASE NEWS GROTESQQQUE Release Date: November 6, Netflix Preview & Stories The full GROTESQQQUE anthology opens in Japan on November 6, 2026. Its 4649GIRL chapter is available early on Netflix Japan through November 5; see all three stories, confirmed credits and what remains unknown internationally. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official promotional artwork · ©Atsushi Nishigori, CloverWorks/Project GTQ. Source: Aniplex key visual announcement . Release at a glance Full film November 6, 2026 · Japanese theaters Netflix Japan preview 4649GIRL chapter only · October 23–November 5 · currently available Format / studio Three-story original anthology film · CloverWorks International release No overseas date or service confirmed Verified October 25, 2026 · Aniplex: Japanese release date · Official Netflix Japan preview notice · Opening-weekend events Watch the official trailer ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Official 60-second theatrical trailer The official listing confirms August 30, 2026 as the publication date; it does not expose the exact upload hour and timezone. VideoObject uploadDate is omitted rather than inferred. When does GROTESQQQUE release? GROTESQQQUE opens in Japanese theaters on Friday, November 6, 2026. Aniplex announced the date alongside the official key visual on July 5, and the production website lists the same opening. This is a feature film, not a new television season: it brings together three original animated stories under one theatrical title. The three chapters share the film’s creative direction and music-led presentation, while each has its own setting, cast focus and episode director. Is GROTESQQQUE already streaming? One part of the film is available early in Japan. The production’s October 19 announcement says 4649GIRL (夜露死駆★少女) is streaming exclusively on Netflix Japan from October 23 through November 5, ahead of the full movie’s cinema opening. That limited window is for the second story only; it is not an early release of all three chapters, and the announcement does not promise availability outside Japan. It also does not state an exact time when the preview begins or leaves the service, so viewers should use the Netflix Japan listing for current access rather than assume a midnight changeover. The advance edition includes a collaboration music video for “Shoot Shoot Shoot,” the film’s opening theme by METALVERSE. What are the three stories in the film? The official site presents GROTESQQQUE as a collection of three different worlds that meet through original animation and music. The title and credits use the segment names ÆLIENS , 4649GIRL and NOCTURNE: NUIT GROTESQUE . They are not three parts of one continuous plot, and the material released so far does not describe a shared chronological order. That structure matters for viewers deciding whether the Japan-only Netflix preview is a complete substitute for the cinema release: it covers just one chapter. Related reading: Inherit the Winds: January 2027 Anime, Cast & Theater Preview . What is ÆLIENS about? ÆLIENS follows Ellie, an alien girl who arrives on Earth as an interplanetary goodwill ambassador. In a period when contact between planets has brought both curiosity and fear, Ellie loves Earth’s culture and ordinary everyday life. She teams up with Kento Kunikura, a civil servant in the space bureau, to look for friends. The official synopsis adds a complication: Ellie’s ability can sometimes go out of control, prompting public suspicion that she may be an invader. Kana Ichinose voices Ellie, while Gen Hoshino plays Kunikura. The setup suggests a comedic contrast between Ellie’s enthusiasm and the mistrust around her, but the official synopsis does not reveal how the alien threat is resolved. Why is the 4649GIRL preview limited? The second chapter takes place in GALs TOKYO, a city where morning never comes. Girls called “gal P” gather there after losing a place in ordinary life, and compete in Queen of Butterfly, or QoB, a battle game whose winner becomes Queen. Stella, a girl who has stopped attending school, enters after hearing an urban legend. The official story description says she encounters an unidentified, overwhelmingly powerful player carrying an SSS-ranked weapon, then learns that the game hides a secret. Sara Minami voices Stella. The cast also includes Ikumi Hasegawa, Saori Hayami, Maaya Uchida, Chika Anzai, Miyu Tomita, Rumi Okubo and Rie Kugimiya. This is the story selected for advance streaming; its Japan-only dates should not be mistaken for the availability of the entire anthology. What is NOCTURNE: NUIT GROTESQUE? The third story imagines a world after humanity’s extinction. Ayame, a pure-blood vampire, travels in a van with three girls who survived after being “infected” by her bite. They find a small daily life beneath a sky full of stars, but the official synopsis frames Ayame’s immortality as a source of loneliness and despair. When something changes in her, the group’s settled routine begins to crack. Nogizaka46 members Nagi Inoue, Aruno Nakanishi, Miku Ichinose and Nao Tomisato voice Ayame, Shion, Momo and Kanna. The film site lists this chapter’s episode direction and character design under Atsushi Nishigori. Related reading: Fool Night Release Date: November 26 on Netflix . Who made the movie? Atsushi Nishigori is credited with the overall direction, screenplay and original character concepts. JOEN and Aniplex planned and produced the project, animation is by CloverWorks, and ANIMEC handles theatrical distribution. The segment teams differ: Nishigori directs ÆLIENS and NOCTURNE ; Takahiro Miura directs 4649GIRL , with character design by tarou2 and action direction by Isao Hayashi. Those separate credits help explain why the anthology moves between an alien comedy, a battle-game story and a post-human vampire drama instead of maintaining one visual or narrative premise. What music and opening events are confirmed? METALVERSE performs the opening theme “Shoot Shoot Shoot.” Aniplex’s October 21 soundtrack announcement lists 50 tracks across three CDs, excluding the opening theme, with 35 participating artists. That release is also scheduled for November 6 in Japan. The production has announced three days of post-screening cast events, November 6–8. The first day includes a live-viewing option for the scheduled 18:45 appearance in Shinjuku; the official notice lists event times in Japan and says performers are subject to change. Aniplex also announced three manga spin-off one-shots on Shonen Jump+: the first begins November 6, and the second is scheduled for November 7; the announcement says publication starts November 6 and proceeds in sequence. These are companion publications, not a pre-existing manga source for the movie. Related reading: Anime Releasing in November 2026: Dates & Where to Watch . Where can viewers outside Japan watch? As of October 25, the confirmed full-film release is Japanese cinemas on November 6. The advance Netflix window applies only to 4649GIRL in Japan. The cited announcements do not confirm an overseas theatrical date, international Netflix access, or a later streaming service for the complete film. Check the official theater list for Japanese screenings and wait for a distributor announcement covering your country before relying on a platform or date. The official 60-second trailer is linked below; the verified Aniplex Channel listing gives its publication date as August 30, 2026, but the public listing reviewed here does not expose an exact upload hour and timezone. AniNextUp therefore reports the date only and does not assert an unverified VideoObject uploadDate. For release updates, use the official film website , Aniplex’s movie news page and the November 2026 anime release guide . Official sources: GROTESQQQUE production website (story, cast and staff) · Aniplex release-date announcement · Netflix Japan preview · Shonen Jump+ tie-in announcement . Updated: October 25, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error

entries.title: Haru to Gen Anime Premieres January 4, 2027: Cast and Teaser
entries.description: Haru to Gen begins on tvk January 4, 2027. See the Japanese broadcast time, confirmed cast, story, official teaser, manga details and streaming status.
entries.content: RELEASE NEWS · OCTOBER 24, 2026 Haru to Gen Anime Premieres January 4, 2027: Cast and Teaser Haru to Gen begins on tvk January 4, 2027. See the Japanese broadcast time, confirmed cast, story, official teaser, manga details and streaming status. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official anime key visual. © Yuka Oshima / KADOKAWA / Haru to Gen Production Committee. · Official source Release at a glance Japanese premiere Monday, January 4, 2027 Broadcaster and time tvk / Television Kanagawa, Mondays at 21:55 JST Director / animation cooperation Kodai Sato / Studio Nanahoshi International streaming Not announced in the sources checked Release details checked October 24, 2026 · Official announcement When does Haru to Gen premiere? Haru to Gen premieres in Japan on Monday, January 4, 2027. AnimationID announced the first broadcast date on October 21, alongside the opening of the anime's official website, a teaser and its main cast. The Japanese title is Haru to Gen: 70-sai, Hajimete no Kosodate , a story about beginning childcare at 70. Unlike an announcement that gives only a season or month, this update provides a specific day and a local television slot. Where can you watch it? The confirmed broadcaster is tvk / Television Kanagawa , with episodes scheduled on Mondays at 21:55 Japan Standard Time . That is a Japanese television schedule. It should not be treated as an international streaming launch time. Related reading: The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop Anime Premieres January 2027 . The official site lists its streaming section as coming soon. No international platform or English dub release has been confirmed in the sources checked for this report. Viewers outside Japan should therefore wait for a distribution announcement before assuming the series will appear in their local catalog. What is the story? Gen is a rigid, work-focused man who has lived alone since his marriage ended. At 70, he takes responsibility for his three-year-old granddaughter Haru following the death of his daughter Sakura. Raising a child forces him to confront a family role he neglected earlier in life. Related reading: The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival Anime Premieres July 2027 . The premise follows the daily adjustments of two people with very different needs: an older man learning how to care for someone and a small child bringing energy into his isolated routine. The official introduction presents their relationship as a warm family story shaped by loss and a new beginning. Confirmed Japanese voice cast Bin Shimada as Gen. Hiromi Igarashi as Haru. Mayuko Kazama as Sakura. AnimationID says additional cast information will follow. The three names above are the confirmed main roles in the October 21 announcement; they are not an English dub cast. Related reading: Red Riding Hood: A Detective Story Premieres January 2027 on Crunchyroll . Who is making Haru to Gen? The adaptation is based on Yuka Oshima's comic and is directed by Kodai Sato. The official credits list music by bermei.inazawa and animation production cooperation by Studio Nanahoshi, within the AnimationID project. This wording preserves the production roles rather than assigning every part of the adaptation to a single studio. Watch the official teaser AnimationID has released a short promotional video introducing Gen and Haru. The official announcement links directly to the video below; it is a teaser for the adaptation, rather than a full episode. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER AnimationID What to check before January The first Japanese broadcast date is established, but international streaming, subtitle languages and dubbing plans still need separate confirmation. The television schedule is also subject to change, as the official site notes. Keep the local Japanese time separate from any future service-specific release time. Official sources and more upcoming anime The date, main cast and teaser come from AnimationID's October 21 announcement . The official anime website provides the story, credits and on-air information. Browse our anime release calendar and latest anime news for other confirmed premieres. Can you read the original manga before the anime? The anime adapts Yuka Oshima’s manga. KADOKAWA’s official listing identifies Volume 1 as a 184-page comic essay released in Japan on March 28, 2024. Its synopsis describes Gen living alone after his divorce before being entrusted with Haru, the young daughter of his estranged child; at 70, he faces parenting for the first time and discovers that daily life with a child is unpredictable. The listing gives readers a route to the source material and explains why the adaptation begins with a family handoff rather than a newborn. It does not confirm how many volumes or chapters the January anime will cover, and this Japanese listing does not establish an English-language edition. See KADOKAWA’s Volume 1 listing . What tone and format should viewers expect? AnimationID’s official website includes comments from the three main voice actors. Bin Shimada, who plays Gen, describes it as a short drama with installments of about three minutes, and says it balances comic childcare mishaps with emotional moments. Hiromi Igarashi describes Haru as energetic and strong-willed; Mayuko Kazama points to the gradual closeness between the two characters. These are performers’ comments, not a full genre label or episode guide, but they offer useful context: the hook is everyday caregiving, with grief and family repair in the background. Treat the approximate runtime as cast commentary; the confirmed program listing still gives the tvk Monday slot and warns that broadcast times can change. It does not supply an international streaming date or a complete episode schedule. Read the official staff and cast comments . Why the age gap matters to the premise The full Japanese subtitle, “70-sai, Hajimete no Kosodate,” points to the central contrast: Gen is beginning childcare at 70, while Haru is three. The official introduction frames this as a family story built around two people adapting to a new routine after Sakura’s death. That description supports a caregiving and second-chance reading, but it does not establish how every family conflict will resolve. The confirmed synopsis is enough to explain the unusual setup without turning it into a promise about later episodes. Updated: October 24, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error

entries.content: FALL 2026 · FANTASY ROMANCE Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion! Release Date & Watch Guide The fantasy romance premiered in Japan on October 5, 2026. Here is the official weekly timetable, how domestic and overseas streaming differ, and where to find Eiko Mutsuhana's original novel in English. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official anime promotional visual. Source: official anime website . ©六つ花えいこ／双葉社・惚れ魔女製作委員会 Release at a glance Japan premiere October 5, 2026; AT-X at 21:30 JST (UTC+09:00) Japan streaming Mondays at 22:00 JST on d Anime Store, U-NEXT and Anime Hodai Animation studio Diomedéa International listing Crunchyroll; regional availability and current local slot not rechecked Domestic times: official Japanese schedule . When did Hello, I am a Witch premiere? Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion! began airing in Japan on October 5, 2026. It is a new television adaptation, so newcomers can start with Episode 1. The premiere date marks the beginning of the weekly run; it is not a promise that the whole season became available together. The official Japanese schedule gives different slots for individual channels. AT-X starts Mondays at 21:30, TOKYO MX at 22:30 and BS Nippon TV at 23:00. These are Japan Standard Time, JST (UTC+09:00) . The same programme can therefore reach different viewers at different times without the listings contradicting one another. Two late-night listings need particular care. RKB lists Monday at 27:00, meaning Tuesday at 03:00 on an ordinary calendar. MBS lists Tuesday at 26:30, meaning Wednesday at 02:30. Anyone converting these slots should move to the following calendar day before converting from JST. Broadcasters warn that their schedules may change. Related reading: Love Live! Hasunosora Release Date: January 10, 2027 & Episodes . Where to watch: Japan and international availability For Japan, the official site lists d Anime Store, U-NEXT and Anime Hodai from October 5, with new episodes scheduled on Mondays at 22:00 JST . Other Japanese services begin rolling out the series from October 10 at 22:00 JST. The page includes subscription and pay-per-view options; it does not mean every listed service operates outside Japan. For a time-zone-neutral reference, 22:00 JST equals 13:00 UTC. Japan does not observe daylight saving time, while other countries may change clocks during the season. This conversion describes the Japanese streaming slot; it does not confirm that an overseas service releases its episode at the same moment. Related reading: Armored Trooper VOTOMS: The Gray Witch Part 1 . Crunchyroll is the international service identified in the existing official seasonal-lineup reference linked below. Regional playback, languages and the current local episode time were not independently rechecked in this review, so this guide does not promise universal availability or repeat an unverified exact simulcast hour. Check the series listing in your own country before subscribing. A Japanese streaming slot is not automatically an overseas release time. What is the story about? Rose lives by a lake and has quietly loved Royal Knight Harij for four years. When he asks her to make a love potion, she assumes he wants it for someone else. She accepts the commission despite her heartbreak, then prolongs the search for ingredients because that gives her more time with him. The official introduction presents their relationship as an awkward romance beginning with apparent rejection. The useful distinction is between Rose's belief and an established romantic outcome. The premise tells us how she understands the request; it does not justify revealing a final couple resolution or inventing Harij's hidden intentions. His visits and her reluctance create the central tension. Viewers looking for a quieter fantasy romance can approach the show through those conversations rather than expecting the potion to function as a battle objective or a conventional adventure quest. Related reading: Witch on the Holy Night Movie: Release Date and Theaters . Who voices Rose and Harij? Mikako Komatsu voices Rose, and Yohei Azakami voices Harij. The official credits name Keizo Kusakawa as director, Wataru Watari for series composition and Masakazu Ishikawa for character design. Diomedéa produces the animation, with music by Hayato Matsumura . The source credits separately identify Eiko Mutsuhana's original work, vient's original character designs and Kamada's manga adaptation, keeping those creative roles distinct. Can I read the original novel in English? Yes. Cross Infinite World publishes the English novel and labels the series completed. Its listing credits author Eiko Mutsuhana , illustrator vient and translator Charis Messier . It offers the first ebook and links to Volume 2 through several digital retailers. That is a direct reading route for viewers who want the source story in English. Related reading: The World's Strongest Witch Release Date, Time & Where to Watch . The novel, manga adaptation and television anime are separate editions of the same property. Reading the novel is optional preparation, not required viewing. The publisher's completed-series label concerns the books: it does not establish that the anime will adapt the entire story or confirm a second anime season. No official episode-to-chapter or episode-to-volume equivalence is supplied here. Opening and ending songs The official music page identifies Centimillimental's “Kanawanai,” as the opening and reini's “Mada Uso ni Naranai” as the ending. A song's digital or CD release is a separate event from an episode premiere. The official video page also lists creditless opening and ending videos; those are music sequences, not additional story episodes. Watch the official main PV ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER YouTube · click to play Reini's agency links this video in its September 14, 2026 announcement. That verifies the official video reference, but the sources accessible for this review did not verify its precise original upload hour and time zone. No exact upload timestamp is asserted. What still needs a separate announcement? The confirmed premiere and domestic timetable do not establish the total episode count, adaptation endpoint, additional seasons or each international dub schedule. Those details require their own announcements. For broader planning, compare other autumn releases in our Fall 2026 anime calendar ; use the regional distributor's current listing for the next episode's local availability. entries.title: Hirayasumi Anime: January 2027 Release, Trailer and New Cast
entries.description: Hirayasumi airs on NHK General in January 2027. Five additional voice cast members have been announced. Read the confirmed staff and watch the official teaser.
entries.content: OFFICIAL NEWS · UPDATED OCTOBER 13, 2026 Hirayasumi Anime: January 2027 Release, Trailer and New Cast Hirayasumi is set for January 2027 on NHK General in Japan. The production announced five additional voice cast members on October 13. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official key visual via the anime production's September 29 announcement ; Hirayasumi anime © Keigo Shinzo / Shogakukan / production committee. Release at a glance Premiere January 2027 (exact day unannounced) Broadcaster NHK General (Japan) Animation Production +h. International streaming Not yet announced Official anime website Release date and broadcaster Hirayasumi is confirmed for January 2027 on NHK General in Japan. The exact day and international streaming platform remain unannounced. What is confirmed about the January 2027 release? The official announcement confirms a January 2027 television broadcast on NHK General in Japan. That is a release month and broadcaster, not a specific episode date or a worldwide streaming agreement. Readers outside Japan should wait for an international distributor announcement before assuming that a local service will carry the series on the same day. What to expect from Hirayasumi Hirayasumi is adapted from Keigo Shinzo's slice-of-life manga, which follows Hiroto and the people around him through everyday encounters and changes in their lives. Its appeal lies in relationships and ordinary routines rather than a tournament or fantasy conflict. The anime's teaser introduces the adaptation, but it does not establish an episode count or confirm how much of the manga will be covered. Official teaser trailer ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TEASER Five new voice cast members announced October 13 The official anime team announced five additional performers: Daisuke Namikawa as Hideki Noguchi, Yoko Hikasa as Yomogi Tachibana, Yume Miyamoto as Akari Yokoyama, Yuichiro Umehara as Ryo Ishikawa, and Yuko Naito as the narrator. See the October 13 official cast announcement . Cast and staff Yuma Uchida voices Hiroto Ikuta, Mayu Takahashi voices Natsumi Kobayashi and Rikako Aikawa voices Hanae Wada. Production +h. animates the series. Kei Suezawa directs and writes the scripts, Naoyuki Asano designs characters, Mika Nishimura is art director and Kaori Sawada composes music. How the preview differs from the premiere The October 7 New York screening was an early preview event, not the start of the Japanese television broadcast or a confirmed worldwide streaming launch. NHK's January 2027 window remains the public broadcast plan, with an exact day and overseas platform still to be announced. What is Hirayasumi about? The story follows carefree Hiroto and his cousin Natsumi as they navigate ordinary life, friendships and family around the house Hiroto inherited from a neighbor. Where to watch NHK General is confirmed in Japan. Streaming platforms and territories outside Japan are not confirmed. FAQ Is the exact January date known? No, only the month is confirmed. Is the trailer official? Yes, the production teaser above is for this adaptation. Is international streaming confirmed? Not yet. Why Hirayasumi is a different kind of anime premiere Rather than following a tournament, fantasy adventure or mystery, Hirayasumi focuses on everyday relationships. Hiroto's relaxed outlook contrasts with the worries of people around him, including his younger cousin Natsumi. Their shared life in a modest house provides the setting for a story about work, friendship, family and the uncertainty of growing up. The adaptation is based on Keigo Shinzo's manga, serialized in Shogakukan's Weekly Big Comic Spirits . Its official introduction places the story in Tokyo neighborhoods including Asagaya and Koenji, with the house Hiroto receives from an older neighbor at the center of the narrative. Sources: VIZ Media anime update and VIZ production announcement (background only; January 2027 broadcast confirmed separately by the official anime site) . October 13 official casting update The October 13 official production announcement identifies five new performers. The release month is unchanged; the announcement does not establish an exact January premiere date or overseas simulcast. Who are Hiroto, Natsumi and Hanae? VIZ Media's cast announcement introduces Hiroto Ikuta as a 29-year-old part-time worker whose easygoing attitude shapes how he approaches daily life. His friendship with Hanae Wada, the older neighbor he calls Granny, leads to the home becoming an important part of his story. Yuma Uchida and Rikako Aikawa voice Hiroto and Hanae in Japanese. Natsumi Kobayashi, voiced by Mayu Takahashi, is Hiroto's younger cousin. VIZ describes her move from Yamagata to Tokyo to attend art school and her private ambition to become a manga artist. Her concerns and Hiroto's relaxed manner offer two different perspectives on the future as they share a home and meet the people around them. What does the key visual reveal? The official visual brings Hiroto and Natsumi together outside the Asagaya house. VIZ identifies the other figures as Hiroto's friend Hideki Noguchi, Natsumi's classmate Akari Yokoyama and real-estate agent Yomogi Tachibana. The image introduces the ensemble and setting; it does not reveal the ending or establish which manga chapters will be included in the first season. The official English anime site also lists Ryo Ishikawa and a narrator among the announced roles. The October cast update supplies their Japanese voices. An eventual English dub and its performers should be checked against a distributor's own announcement when one becomes available. Who is making the anime? Kei Suezawa is credited for direction, series composition and screenplay, while Production +h. handles animation. The official staff page names Naoyuki Asano for character design, Mika Nishimura as art director and Kaori Sawada for music. These credits identify the adaptation's announced creative team; neither the staff list nor the teaser confirms a total episode count. Readers interested in the original can look for Keigo Shinzo's Hirayasumi manga. VIZ says the series began serialization in Weekly Big Comic Spirits in 2021. The manga offers another way to explore its characters while viewers wait for the television adaptation; its publication schedule is separate from the anime's Japanese broadcast window. Sources checked October 26, 2026: the official anime site and VIZ Media's production announcement. An exact Japanese premiere day and international streaming details remain to be announced in those sources. Updated: October 26, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error
