entries.title: Gundam SEED FREEDOM ZERO: Release Date, Viewing Order & Cast
entries.description: Gundam SEED FREEDOM ZERO opens in Japan January 15, 2027, with North America set for February. Check regional dates, viewing order, cast, mecha and ticket details.
entries.content: OFFICIAL MOVIE NEWS · JANUARY 2027 Gundam SEED FREEDOM ZERO: Release Date, Viewing Order & Cast The SEED prequel opens in Japan on January 15, 2027, with a separate North American theatrical window in February. This guide separates the confirmed regional dates from pending ticket, streaming and screening-language details. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official teaser visual via Bandai Namco Filmworks / Gundam . © SUNRISE. Release at a glance Japan cinemas January 15, 2027 North America February 2027; exact day pending Director / production Mitsuo Fukuda / SUNRISE Story position After SEED DESTINY, before SEED FREEDOM Streaming No platform announced in the release sources reviewed Sources: Japanese opening announcement and North American announcement . When does Gundam SEED FREEDOM ZERO release? Mobile Suit Gundam SEED FREEDOM ZERO opens in Japanese theaters on January 15, 2027. The Japanese announcement confirms a theatrical opening, not a television premiere or a streaming launch. Individual cinema showtimes remain a separate matter, so the release date should not be converted into a supposed worldwide online premiere hour. Bandai Namco Filmworks separately announced a February 2027 North American theatrical window . The English-language announcement does not specify an opening day, participating theaters or a ticket-sale date. January 15 therefore applies to Japan; it is not a confirmed North American date. Other countries need their own distribution announcements. Is FREEDOM ZERO a sequel or a prequel? ZERO is a prequel to the 2024 film Mobile Suit Gundam SEED FREEDOM , placed after Mobile Suit Gundam SEED DESTINY . Its title does not mean it starts before the original SEED television story. The official synopsis places events in Cosmic Era 74, following the failure of the Destiny Plan and before the situation seen in FREEDOM. For newcomers, our suggested preparation is SEED, then SEED DESTINY, then the already released SEED FREEDOM. ZERO can subsequently fill in the intervening period. Viewers who specifically prefer story chronology can place ZERO between DESTINY and FREEDOM once it is available. That is an editorial viewing suggestion, not a studio-issued requirement to watch every Gundam series. The immediate context is this group of SEED installments. What is Shinn Asuka's new story about? After the war, Cagalli and her allies are establishing a peace-monitoring organization called COMPS, pronounced Compass. Shinn has not yet settled on his own direction. When the Strike Freedom Gundam reaches the organization's temporary base on Onogoro Island and is stolen that night, he and his companions must recover it before the crisis grows. Those events are the announced setup, not a summary of the film's ending. This gives returning viewers two clear points of interest: Shinn's uncertain position after DESTINY, and the formation of the organization familiar from FREEDOM. The official story connects those developments through a specific theft rather than simply advertising another large battle. The culprit, the resolution and how each relationship changes should be left to the film; the promotional synopsis does not disclose them. Related reading: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers: Premiere, Cast, Streaming and Official Trailer . Which mobile suits are confirmed? The official mecha index includes Strike Freedom, Infinite Justice, Lunamaria's GELGOOG Menace, GYAN Strom and the GOUF Ignited Custom, alongside other machines. These are confirmed listings; they do not establish how much screen time each receives or who wins any encounter. The individual profiles add useful story context. Strike Freedom's transfer is intended to supply development data at the temporary base. The GOUF Ignited Custom is a modification used by the rebel ZAFT Bronwell team, with a gatling weapon built into its distinctive shield. These details help explain the announced machinery without inventing new weapons or battle outcomes. Japanese and English voice cast The Japanese credits confirm Kenichi Suzumura as Shinn, Maaya Sakamoto as Lunamaria, Houko Kuwashima as Agnes Giebenrath and Daisuke Ono as Leonard Valway. Soichiro Hoshi returns as Kira Yamato, Akira Ishida as Athrun Zala and Tomokazu Seki as Yzak Jule. The North American announcement names Matthew Erickson as Shinn Asuka, Matt Hill as Kira Yamato and Sam Vincent as Athrun Zala for the English version. That announcement confirms those roles; it should not be expanded into an invented complete dub cast or a claim that every theater will offer both language versions. Screening-language details still depend on the eventual local listings. Who is making the film? Mitsuo Fukuda directs, with a screenplay credited to Shigeru Morita, Chiaki Morosawa and Fukuda. Hisashi Hirai handles character design and Toshihiko Sahashi composes the music. SUNRISE is credited with planning and production, while Bandai Namco Filmworks produces the film. The Japanese release is distributed by Bandai Namco Filmworks and Shochiku. The official announcement explains that the script originated during SEED FREEDOM's planning, giving the project a development connection to the earlier movie as well as a place in its story. Watch the official Japanese trailer ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Japanese official trailer This is the video embedded in the Japanese October 9 announcement. Its exact original upload hour and time zone could not be independently corroborated in this review, so no precise upload timestamp is asserted. The announcement date and a video's upload time are different facts. Tickets, streaming and remaining unknowns Japan's first advance-ticket offer began on October 16, 2026, with the online offer scheduled through January 14, 2027. Those Japanese vouchers do not announce North American ticket availability. Check the official theater listing for the screening you intend to attend rather than treating merchandise or soundtrack dates as showtimes. No streaming platform or home-video date is confirmed in the release sources reviewed. The exact North American day, cinema list, language-specific sessions and releases in additional territories remain pending. Follow our January 2027 anime guide for the wider schedule , while using the film's official announcements for regional cinema updates. Updated: October 26, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error

entries.title: MURCIÉLAGO Anime: January 2027, Cast & Where to Watch
entries.description: MURCIÉLAGO begins in January 2027. Check HIDIVE’s confirmed territories, cast, staff, official teasers and details still unknown.
entries.content: OFFICIAL ANIME NEWS · OCTOBER 17, 2026 MURCIÉLAGO Anime: January 2027, Cast & Where to Watch MURCIÉLAGO begins in Japan in January 2027. Check the confirmed HIDIVE territories, cast, staff, official teasers and what is still unknown. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official promotional visual. Source and artwork credit: official anime website . Release at a glance Premiere window January 2027; exact date pending Streaming service HIDIVE; U.S., Canada, U.K., Ireland, Australia and New Zealand Animation production SATELIGHT × Staple Entertainment Voice cast Hitomi Ueda as Kuroko Koumori; Minori Suzuki as Hinako Tozakura; Sumire Uesaka as Chiyo Yanaoka Confirmed by the official anime site and HIDIVE / AMC Global Media . When does the MURCIÉLAGO anime premiere? The MURCIÉLAGO TV anime is scheduled to begin broadcasting and streaming in Japan in January 2027. The adaptation was announced in July 2026, then narrowed to January during the Anime NYC announcement in August. The official site still gives a month, not a day, station time or episode count. “January 2027” is the confirmed window, not an exact premiere date. That distinction matters on seasonal calendars: January places the series in winter 2027 but does not say whether episode one arrives in the first week or later. The production has not published a weekly Japanese schedule, so exact station times remain unknown. Where can you watch MURCIÉLAGO? HIDIVE announced an exclusive simulcast in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia and New Zealand as part of its 2027 line-up. That territory list comes from AMC Global Media’s July 6 announcement ; it is not a worldwide availability promise. Viewers elsewhere should check local catalogs closer to launch. Japan is separate: the official anime site confirms January broadcast and streaming, but has not named a Japanese platform or network. For people asking about Crunchyroll, the official international announcement names HIDIVE in those six territories and does not announce Crunchyroll. No English dub date or subtitle language list has been published. What is the story about? The official introduction describes a “fight evil with evil” premise. Kuroko Koumori, a former death-row inmate, is selected under extraordinary legal measures to work as a state-sanctioned executioner. Her partner and watchdog, Hinako Tozakura, has exceptional driving skills and helps pursue violent offenders. Kuroko’s character profile says she was responsible for 715 deaths before her appointment, underscoring how deliberately extreme the story’s justice system is. The teaser announcement says the pair receives repeated requests to eliminate criminals and races through the fictional town of Rururuke. The production has not said which manga cases the first season adapts, named a season-long antagonist or published an episode synopsis. Viewers should not assume a particular arc or volume will be covered. Who is in the MURCIÉLAGO cast? The official site lists three principal characters and Japanese voice actors. Hitomi Ueda plays Kuroko, the dangerous state-appointed executioner. Minori Suzuki voices Hinako, Kuroko’s monitor and partner, whose “brain navigation” ability and driving make her an active part of the cases. Sumire Uesaka plays Chiyo Yanaoka, Kuroko’s girlfriend and the daughter of the Yanaoka crime-family leader. Chiyo’s relationship with Kuroko adds personal friction alongside the investigations. The October 21 official cast announcement released character designs and comments from the three actors. Its teaser PV is the first video to introduce their voices together. This is the announced main cast, not a complete cast list; supporting roles remain unconfirmed. Which studio and staff are producing the anime? The official staff list credits SATELIGHT and Staple Entertainment with animation production. Takashi Naoya is chief director and series composer; Matsuo Asami is director; Ryo Nakamura is deputy director; and Kiyoshi Tateishi handles character design. The CG directors are Hiroyuki Goto and Hiroyuki Ikeda , while music is credited to Masanori Akita and Yuichi Tsuchiya . The site has not said how the production divides 2D and CG work or how many episodes are planned. Watch the official MURCIÉLAGO teasers The embedded official PV below is the August promotional video confirming the January 2027 broadcast and streaming start. Its original YouTube metadata gives the upload time as August 21, 2026 at 12:50:09 a.m. PDT (UTC−07:00) . The official anime site posted a newer cast teaser on October 21. Its official teaser announcement supplies the date but no exact hour or time zone; watch that cast teaser on the official NBCUniversal Anime/Music channel . We keep the videos distinct and do not assign the newer clip an unverified timestamp. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TEASER January 2027 TV anime Official anime site . How does the anime connect to the manga? MURCIÉLAGO adapts Kana Yoshimura’s manga, published in Square Enix’s Young Gangan Comics line. The publisher’s Young Gangan series page describes Kuroko as a government-authorized killer sent after serious criminals and Hinako as her monitor. The anime site lists volume 29 as the newest Japanese volume, released July 24, 2026. AMC said the manga had passed 2.3 million copies in worldwide circulation when it announced the adaptation. This is an adaptation of an established long-running manga, not a short original project made for television. That history does not reveal where season one will stop: the anime site has not confirmed an episode total, final chapter or volume, or whether more seasons are planned. Is MURCIÉLAGO suitable for every viewer? The official cast comments describe quick shifts between comedy and serious material and warn viewers to expect graphic violence and sexual jokes. That is useful context because the teaser’s action alone does not convey every aspect of the tone. The official material does not provide a formal age rating; viewers who need one should wait for a local distributor or ratings body rather than treating this note as a classification. Confirmed so far: the January 2027 window, HIDIVE’s six exclusive simulcast territories, three principal voice actors and the main production staff. The exact premiere day, Japanese broadcaster and platform, episode count, additional cast, rating and season coverage remain unannounced. We will update this guide when the production publishes those details. Updated: October 25, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error

entries.title: My Happy Marriage Special Episodes: Release Date & Netflix Guide
entries.description: My Happy Marriage's three special episodes arrive October 25, 2026 on Netflix. Watch the official teaser and check Japan's schedule and regional timing.
entries.content: OCTOBER 25, 2026 · THREE SPECIAL EPISODES My Happy Marriage Special Episodes: Release Date & Netflix Guide My Happy Marriage’s three special episodes premiere on October 25, 2026, with a Netflix release confirmed. Watch the official teaser and see how the Japanese broadcast schedule differs from international streaming timing. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official special-episode teaser thumbnail. © Akumi Agitogi, Tsukiho Tsukioka / KADOKAWA / My Happy Marriage Production Committee. Source: the anime production’s August 31 announcement . Release at a glance Release date October 25, 2026 Format Three special episodes Studio Kinema Citrus Netflix October 25 release confirmed; exact local hour pending Japan’s streaming start From 20:30 JST; domestic schedule Checked October 24, 2026 · Official Japan schedule · Netflix release announcement When do the My Happy Marriage special episodes release? The three new special episodes arrive on October 25, 2026. Netflix’s romance-anime announcement confirms the date for its release. The production separately publishes Japan’s television and streaming schedule. Japan broadcast and streaming times Release October 25 schedule Scope TOKYO MX 19:00–20:30 JST All three specials in one Japanese TV block Japanese streaming From 20:30 JST, progressively Listed domestic streaming services, including Netflix International Netflix October 25; exact hour unannounced in the cited release Consult your local title listing Source: the official broadcast and streaming page . Its 20:30 JST reference applies to Japanese distribution. It does not establish a single worldwide availability time for every service. Later Japanese television broadcasts BS11 lists the specials for October 26 at 25:00–26:30 in broadcast notation, which is October 27 at 01:00–02:30 JST on a standard calendar. AT-X lists October 31 at 19:30–21:00 JST. These later television showings are separate from the October 25 first broadcast and streaming start. Where can I watch outside Japan? Netflix is the international service confirmed by its own announcement. Japan’s longer platform list also includes Prime Video, Disney+, Hulu, U-NEXT and others, but a Japanese listing is not evidence that each service has the specials in every country. Use your local Netflix catalog to check release timing, subtitles and audio options. Watch the official special-episode teaser This teaser is embedded in the production’s August 31 release announcement . The original video upload metadata previously verified for this teaser is August 30, 2026, at 20:00:10 UTC−07:00, equivalent to August 31 at 03:00:10 UTC. That upload time is separate from the specials’ premiere. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER KADOKAWAanime · Official specials teaser Are these Season 3 or three special episodes? Netflix labels the release “Season 2 — Special Episodes,” and the official Japanese announcement confirms three episodes. The 90-minute television slot groups them into one broadcast event; it does not turn them into a newly announced full season or establish how every streaming service will package them. Story and cast updates The specials continue Miyo and Kiyoka’s relationship as their wedding approaches. The production introduces Kimio Nagaba, Miyo’s former school classmate, voiced by M・A・O. Reina Ueda and Kaito Ishikawa voice Miyo Saimori and Kiyoka Kudo. What should I watch before the specials? Watch the existing anime seasons before starting this continuation. The specials return to Miyo and Kiyoka after the relationship and supernatural conflicts established in the television series; they are not a fresh adaptation that introduces the couple from the beginning. Netflix groups the new release with Season 2, which helps distinguish it from the first season’s earlier bonus episode. If your catalog displays several entries or season selectors, check the episode descriptions rather than choosing by the word “special” alone. How do these differ from the earlier OVA? The official on-air page separately lists an OVA identified as Episode 13. That older episode and the three new October 2026 specials are different releases. This distinction matters when searching for “My Happy Marriage special episode”: an older streaming listing or review may describe Episode 13 rather than this new three-part event. The October 25 announcement is the relevant notice for the new continuation. It confirms three episodes, while leaving international catalog presentation to each streaming service. What does the story focus on? The romance begins with an arranged engagement between Miyo, a young woman mistreated by her family, and Kiyoka, a military officer with a forbidding reputation. Their growing trust sits alongside inherited supernatural abilities and family expectations. For returning viewers, the specials bring the wedding and the couple’s future into focus. Kimio’s arrival adds a connection to Miyo’s school years: the official character description says she welcomes their reunion but carries a troubling shadow beneath that reaction. The announcement does not reveal how her involvement resolves. Returning production team and music Netflix names Takehiro Kubota as director and Kinema Citrus as the animation studio. Reina Ueda returns as Miyo, opposite Kaito Ishikawa as Kiyoka, with M・A・O joining as Kimio Nagaba. The production also announced Kashitaro Ito’s ending theme, “Prelude no Temae ni ~for me&you~.” Its music-service rollout begins October 26 at midnight in Japan. That is the song’s release schedule, not an alternative premiere time for the episodes. How to read the time-zone information Japan uses JST, UTC+9. The October 25 television start at 19:00 JST corresponds to 10:00 UTC; the domestic streaming start at 20:30 JST corresponds to 11:30 UTC. Those conversions describe the Japanese schedule only. They do not promise that your Netflix catalog will update at either converted time. The official domestic notice says distribution begins progressively and cautions that schedules can change. For international viewing, the confirmed Netflix date and your local title page remain the useful references. What is still unconfirmed for international viewers? The cited Netflix announcement confirms a date, but does not list a worldwide launch hour, the language options for every territory, or whether all local catalogs will display the specials identically. The Japanese TV block lasts 90 minutes, including the broadcaster’s scheduling allowance; it should not be reported as a verified 90 minutes of uninterrupted animation. Until episode listings appear, avoid treating that slot as the combined exact runtime. The practical check on release day is the new episode list under the local series page, together with its available subtitle and audio menus. The cited announcements also do not specify a separate English-dub timetable. Naming the Japanese cast confirms those performances, but does not establish which dubbed tracks will be available on October 25 in your country. Check the local audio menu when the episodes appear. Official sources Production announcement: date, three episodes, teaser and new cast Japanese broadcast and streaming schedule Netflix’s October release confirmation Plan the rest of your watchlist with the weekly anime schedule and AniNextUp’s Netflix anime guides . More anime to watch next Find the specials alongside this week’s other confirmed releases , then browse November’s anime premieres for your next viewing plans. Updated: October 24, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error

entries.title: Naruto × Ninkū Anime: Four Episodes, Official Teaser and Release Status
entries.description: Naruto × Ninkū is a four-episode crossover supervised by both creators. Explore its story, staff and official teaser, with release and streaming status.
entries.content: OFFICIAL NEWS · 2026-10-11 Naruto × Ninkū Anime: Four Episodes, Official Teaser and Release Status Team 7 meets Fūsuke in a creator-supervised crossover announced at New York Comic Con. Here is what the official sources confirm—and which release details are still unannounced. By AniNextUp Editorial Team Official visual supplied in TV Tokyo’s press release. © Masashi Kishimoto Scott, Koji Kiriyama / SHUEISHA TV TOKYO PIERROT. Four episodes bring Naruto and Ninkū together Naruto has a new anime project: a four-episode crossover with Ninkū , the ninja adventure created by Koji Kiriyama. VIZ announced the project at New York Comic Con on October 10, 2026, alongside a first teaser. Masashi Kishimoto and Kiriyama are supervising the episodes, with Noriyuki Abe directing and Tetsuya Nishio handling character design and chief animation direction. The announcement establishes a specific, limited project rather than an open-ended new television season. For viewers looking for a release date, however, the launch details are still missing: the official announcements reviewed on October 11 do not give a premiere date or name a streaming service. Source: VIZ’s New York Comic Con announcement. Team 7’s mission takes Naruto into another world The production’s official project page describes a mission assigned to Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura. With Kakashi unable to accompany them, Naruto takes the lead. Their assignment becomes something much stranger when Naruto loses his way into another world and encounters Fūsuke, the central character of Ninkū . Related reading: Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING: Story, Trailer and Release Status . That premise gives the crossover a clear starting point: a familiar Team 7 assignment becomes an encounter between two different approaches to ninja adventure. The announcement does not establish where these episodes belong in Naruto’s continuity, so a watch-order placement would be premature. For readers unfamiliar with the other half of the title, Ninkū began as Kiriyama’s manga in Weekly Shonen Jump in 1993 and received an anime adaptation in 1995. Its fighting style combines ninjutsu and karate. The new project’s official materials also identify it as an influence on Kishimoto’s work, giving the pairing a documented creative connection. Related reading: Naruto: Shadow Rising Release Date: Kishimoto’s New Manga . Is Naruto × Ninkū a new Naruto season? No. The announced project consists of four crossover episodes featuring Naruto characters alongside Fūsuke from Ninkū . That fixed scope is different from an announcement of a full new season of the main Naruto television series. VIZ and the official project page do not specify a premiere date or streaming partner, so viewers should not treat an unofficial calendar listing as confirmed. Who is making the crossover? The project page credits PIERROT FILMS with animation production. Its lead cast includes Junko Takeuchi as Naruto and Rica Matsumoto as Fūsuke, with Noriaki Sugiyama as Sasuke, Chie Nakamura as Sakura and Kazuhiko Inoue as Kakashi. Related reading: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Is Out on Netflix: Episodes & Trailer . Both original creators are involved in supervising all four episodes. That is the confirmed scope of their participation; it should not be expanded into claims that they personally animate the project or write every scene. The official credits distinguish supervision, direction and character design as separate responsibilities. Watch the official Naruto × Ninkū teaser The NARUTO / BORUTO Official Channel published NARUTO×NINKŪ | Teaser | NARUTO on October 10, 2026. This is the teaser linked by VIZ’s announcement and corresponds to the crossover, rather than a preview for an unrelated Naruto season. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TEASER The player loads after a click and does not start automatically. Who oversees the story and production? The official crossover page says the four-episode story is supervised by both original creators, Masashi Kishimoto and Koji Kiriyama. PIERROT FILMS is credited for animation, with Noriyuki Abe directing and Tetsuya Nishio responsible for character design and chief animation direction. Those production credits confirm the people and studio attached to the project. They do not establish a release date, a broadcaster or the order in which the episodes will become available. A later official distribution announcement is needed for those viewing details. Release date and streaming: what remains unannounced As of October 11, 2026, the reviewed official sources have not specified the premiere date, episode release schedule, broadcaster, streaming platform or country-by-country availability for the crossover. There is consequently no confirmed US viewing service to recommend yet, nor evidence for a simultaneous worldwide anime release. TV Tokyo’s Project Rasengan announcement does contain a June 2027 date, but that belongs to the Naruto card game. It is not the release date for these four anime episodes. Its statement about global distribution of a mobile game likewise should not be read as an anime streaming agreement. The crossover and Naruto Shadow Rising are separate projects The official Naruto announcement roundup also introduces Kishimoto’s new Naruto Shadow Rising manga. That announcement sits alongside the crossover under the broader Project Rasengan initiative; it does not turn the crossover into a Shadow Rising anime adaptation. The next announced Project Rasengan information point is Jump Festa 2027, scheduled for December 19–20, 2026. Despite the event’s name, those dates fall in December 2026. The promised follow-up concerns the broader project, so it is not a guarantee that an anime premiere date will be revealed there. Until a distribution announcement appears, treat this as a confirmed four-episode production with a released teaser and an unannounced launch. For other titles with established dates, consult AniNextUp’s anime release calendar ; this crossover should not receive a guessed calendar entry. Official sources: VIZ announcement , anime production page , Naruto announcement roundup and TV Tokyo press release . Last reviewed October 11, 2026. Updated: October 26, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error

entries.title: Naruto: Shadow Rising Release Date: Kishimoto’s New Manga
entries.description: Masashi Kishimoto is drawing a new Naruto manga. Check the official teaser, confirmed Jump Festa update time and what remains unknown about publication.
entries.content: OFFICIAL MANGA NEWS · UPDATED OCTOBER 26, 2026 Naruto: Shadow Rising Release Date: Kishimoto’s New Manga Masashi Kishimoto is drawing a new Naruto manga, but no serialization date or format has been announced. Here is what the official teaser shows, what Jump Festa has scheduled, and which release details remain unconfirmed. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official super teaser thumbnail via the NARUTO Official YouTube channel . © Masashi Kishimoto / Shueisha. Release at a glance Release Publication date not announced Where to read Magazine, app and English edition not announced Project New manga drawn by Masashi Kishimoto Next official update Naruto Jump Super Stage · December 19, 2026, 16:55–17:25 JST (UTC+09:00) Details checked October 26, 2026 · Naruto Official announcement · Jump Festa stage schedule What is Naruto: Shadow Rising? Shadow Rising is the name attached to a newly announced Naruto manga drawn by Masashi Kishimoto. The project was revealed during the Naruto “What’s Next?” panel at New York Comic Con on October 10, 2026, local time. The official Naruto recap, published the following day in Japan, describes it as a new manga and says the teaser that closed the panel showed manga storyboards. That distinction answers the first question readers are asking: this announcement concerns a comic, not a confirmed new television season. Kishimoto created the original Naruto manga, which ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from 1999 to 2014. The official announcement does not yet say whether this will be a one-shot, a short series, a longer serialization, or a special chapter. It also does not name a magazine issue, digital service, publisher release date, or chapter count. Until the rights holders provide those details, descriptions such as “new series” should be treated cautiously. When will Naruto: Shadow Rising be released? No publication date has been announced. The official Naruto recap directs readers to the franchise’s Naruto Jump Super Stage at Jump Festa 2027 for further information. Jump Festa takes place at Makuhari Messe on December 19 and 20, 2026. The event’s official stage listing schedules the Naruto segment for Saturday, December 19, from 16:55 to 17:25 Japan Standard Time (JST, UTC+09:00). That is a confirmed event slot, not a manga release date. The stage could provide news, but its schedule alone does not guarantee which specific details will be revealed. There is no reliable official basis yet for a 2026 or 2027 chapter premiere, a weekly or monthly schedule, or an English-language launch. Readers looking for a date should check the official Naruto news page and Jump Festa’s Naruto stage listing after the event. A retailer listing or an unsourced social post should not be confused with a publisher’s announcement. Related reading: Naruto × Ninkū Anime: Four Episodes, Official Teaser and Release Status . What does the official teaser reveal? The super teaser is brief and uses illustrated panels rather than a full plot synopsis. The official recap describes six previous Hokage faces carved into the mountain above the Hidden Leaf Village, followed by a seventh stone face still under construction. It then shows Naruto holding a Hokage hat, Kakashi smiling, Sasuke standing, Sakura looking fondly at a baby, and a clash between Naruto and Sasuke. The footage shows these characters but does not identify the baby or explain the conflict. The developing monument and the characters’ appearances have prompted timeline theories. They may be useful clues to discuss, but the official site has not confirmed a chronology, a connection to a particular Boruto arc, or whether the images depict sequential events. For now, the accurate answer to “Where does it fit?” is that the official synopsis and timeline remain unannounced. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TEASER NARUTO Official The video was presented as part of the October 10 New York Comic Con panel; the official recap does not state the video’s exact upload time or timezone. AniNextUp therefore does not mark an exact upload timestamp or publish a VideoObject uploadDate for this clip. Is Shadow Rising a new Naruto anime? No anime adaptation of Shadow Rising has been announced. The NYCC recap covers several separate Naruto projects, and it is easy to mix them up because they were promoted during the same panel. The new manga is drawn by Kishimoto. Separately, the franchise announced NARUTO×NINKŪ , a four-episode crossover anime supervised by Kishimoto and NINKŪ creator Koji Kiriyama. The crossover has its own teaser, premise, and production announcement. Neither project should be presented as the other, and the manga teaser is not confirmation that Shadow Rising will be animated. The panel also included additional franchise news, including the NARUTO CARD GAME. Searchers should distinguish the manga from the separately announced NINKŪ anime. Where will the manga be published, and where can English readers read it? The official recap has not named the magazine, app, print volume, or digital platform for the new story. It has not announced translations, regional distributors, preorder details, or an English release. Because the original Naruto manga was serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump, readers may expect a familiar route, but that history is not confirmation of the new project’s publication format. Wait for a specific announcement from the franchise or publisher before relying on a platform or retailer date. When details arrive, readers should check the first chapter date, release frequency, format and regional digital availability. What is confirmed, and what is still unknown? Confirmed by the official Naruto announcement: Kishimoto is drawing a new Naruto manga; the announcement teaser includes the Hokage monument and members of Team 7; and the franchise points to the Naruto Jump Super Stage at Jump Festa 2027 for follow-up information. The official event schedule lists that stage for December 19, 2026, 16:55–17:25 JST. Not confirmed as of October 26, 2026: a manga release date, serialization length, magazine or app, full story, timeline, English edition, or anime adaptation. The exact upload time and timezone of the teaser are also not stated on the official recap. We will update this guide when the official franchise or publisher supplies the missing publication details. Official sources Naruto Official: New manga and New York Comic Con announcement recap · Jump Festa 2027: Naruto Jump Super Stage schedule · Official Naruto manga super teaser · Related guide: Naruto × Ninkū crossover anime . entries.content: NETFLIX · OCTOBER 2026 New Anime on Netflix in October 2026: What to Watch AniNextUp’s guide to notable anime releases on Netflix during October 2026. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases WHERE TO WATCH Netflix Release at a glance Release October 2026; dates and time zones are title-specific Where to watch Netflix; regional catalog availability applies Region and timing Weekly series and special episodes have separate release formats. Release details checked October 12, 2026 · Netflix’s October anime lineup · Ranma ½ official broadcast schedule · Netflix Japan’s Anime NYC 2026 announcement This October guide compares weekly Netflix anime releases with special-episode and one-off launches; check the linked title guides for confirmed territory and episode timing. Netflix has announced The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 for October 1 PT / October 2 JST, Blue Box Season 2 for October 4 with weekly episodes, and My Happy Marriage Season 2 Special Episodes for October 25. October highlights The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 — October 1 PT / October 2 JST, new episodes weekly Ranma 1/2 Season 3 — Japanese broadcast begins October 3 (late-night slot); Netflix follows the Japanese broadcast Blue Box Season 2 — October 4, new episodes weekly Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 — October 20 My Happy Marriage Season 2 Special Episodes — October 25 Which Netflix titles release weekly? The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 and Blue Box Season 2 have weekly episode rollouts in the cited Netflix announcements. Their October premiere dates mark the first release, not the arrival of every episode. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 has an October 20 launch date, but this guide does not infer a batch-release format without a separately confirmed schedule. What to watch first Blue Box Season 2 is one of the month’s major weekly returns, while The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 opens the month with another romance-focused sequel. Later in October, My Happy Marriage added special episodes on October 25. Related reading: Cosmoship Yamato √2199 Release Date: Story, Cast and What’s Confirmed . Weekly releases vs. one-day drops Not every Netflix anime follows the same release model. Blue Box Season 2 and The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 are confirmed for weekly episodes, while specials and other titles can use different schedules. AniNextUp tracks each title separately so a monthly Netflix list does not imply that every show drops its full season at once. Where to check next For titles outside Netflix, use the AniNextUp streaming hub . For date-by-date premieres across services, see the Fall 2026 anime calendar . AniNextUp: Release dates and streaming availability can vary by region. This guide will be updated when new official information is confirmed. October’s release pattern, checked against Netflix By October 23, the first two weekly premieres in Netflix’s romance lineup have already begun. The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 started October 1 in Pacific Time (October 2 in Japan) and is listed with weekly episodes; Blue Box Season 2 began October 4 and also follows a weekly schedule. Those dates refer to the first episode, not a full-season drop. For a viewer planning a weekend watch, the distinction changes whether the series can be binged or needs a week-by-week follow-up. My Happy Marriage Season 2 — Special Episodes was scheduled for October 25. Netflix labels these as special episodes, so they should not be confused with the start of a new numbered season. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 arrived October 20 as a separate Netflix title; its official listing describes a standalone ten-episode story. The anime releases on different dates and formats even though all appear under the month’s anime searches. Which October release is a standalone story? Netflix describes Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 as a standalone, ten-episode story featuring a new group of mercenaries in Night City. It shares the setting of the earlier series, but the Netflix announcement introduces a fresh cast and crew of characters rather than presenting it as another weekly romance. That makes it an option for viewers looking for action and science fiction alongside the month's relationship-focused titles. Netflix identifies the story's episode count; the number alone does not establish the release cadence, so consult the title page for the episodes currently available in your region. What is the difference between a sequel and special episodes? Blue Box Season 2 and The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 continue their respective series with weekly releases. Netflix's October 25 My Happy Marriage listing instead identifies special episodes connected to its second season. Checking that label helps returning viewers find the right entry in their watchlist and avoids treating the specials as an announced third season. Dates in this guide refer to Netflix's announced launches. For present-day playback, check each listing directly because language tracks and catalog availability can vary by country. How to use this guide without mixing schedules Check the linked title guide for the exact service and episode status, then compare the date with the Netflix catalog in your country. Netflix’s newsroom can announce a global plan, while the local title page is the practical check for playback, audio and subtitles. The October 1 / October 2 notation is a time-zone difference around the same release moment, not evidence of two separate premiere events. For fans choosing between the weekly romances, the official descriptions offer a simple distinction: The Ramparts of Ice follows a group of classmates whose relationships shift, while Blue Box combines school romance with badminton and basketball ambitions. My Happy Marriage’s October entry is a set of specials rather than a weekly new season. This guide keeps those formats separate so the month’s list is useful as a schedule, not just a collection of titles. We will mark dates as past and update the page when Netflix changes a listing. entries.content: OCTOBER 6 · 2026 Nia Liston Anime Release Date, 25-Episode Count & Where to Watch Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden premiered October 6, 2026 in Japan. Official Blu-ray listings cover 25 episodes, and HIDIVE lists a same-day simulcast in supported territories. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official teaser artwork released by KONAMI Digital Entertainment. © Umikaze Minamino, HOBBY JAPAN / Nia Liston Project. JAPAN PREMIERE October 6, 2026 — aired EPISODES 25 across two Blu-ray boxes STUDIO KONAMI animation Release at a glance Japanese premiere October 6, 2026; currently airing Episode count 25 listed across official Blu-ray BOX 1 and BOX 2 Japan TV TOKYO MX Tue 21:25; BS NTV Tue 24:30; MBS Tue 27:30 JST Where to watch HIDIVE simulcast in supported territories; Japanese services have separate schedules Schedule and episode details checked October 26, 2026 · Official anime site · HIDIVE October schedule When did Nia Liston premiere? Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden began broadcasting in Japan on October 6, 2026. The official anime site lists it as a two-consecutive-cour television series, and the anime is now airing. Its current Japanese schedule is more useful than an old “coming this fall” listing: the premiere date has passed, and the series continues weekly. The broadcaster schedule uses Japan’s late-night convention. TOKYO MX airs the show Tuesdays at 9:25 p.m. JST. BS Nippon TV lists Tuesdays at 24:30, which is Wednesday at 12:30 a.m. by the calendar clock; MBS lists Tuesdays at 27:30, or Wednesday at 3:30 a.m. JST. Those are the same overnight broadcast slots described using the Tuesday television day. The official On Air page is the source for the channel times. Where can you watch Nia Liston? For viewers outside Japan, HIDIVE’s official October schedule lists Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden as a Tuesday simulcast beginning October 6. HIDIVE availability depends on territory, so the listing confirms a service, not universal access. Check the platform’s current catalogue in your country before subscribing or planning a watch party. In Japan, the official site lists ABEMA and d Anime Store for the earliest post-broadcast stream, Tuesdays at 9:55 p.m. JST. U-NEXT and Anime Hodai follow on Fridays at 9:55 p.m. JST, with other services rolling out from October 12. These local service windows should not be confused with the HIDIVE simulcast or treated as evidence of availability in other countries. How many episodes does season one have? The official Blu-ray listing now provides a concrete episode count. BOX 1, scheduled for March 24, 2027, contains episodes 1–12; BOX 2, scheduled for June 23, contains episodes 13–25. Together with the official two-cour broadcast description, those listings support a 25-episode run . This is more precise than interpreting “two cours” on its own, which describes the broadcast span but does not always specify an episode total. Related reading: BLEACH: THE LAST PV, Episode 50 Date & Where to Watch . The box-set dates are home-video release dates, not additional premiere dates. BOX 1 and BOX 2 cover different episode ranges, so anyone collecting the series should use the official volume details rather than assume that the March set contains the complete anime. The official Blu-ray section lists both dates and episode ranges. What is the story about? Nia is a noble girl whose fragile body once led to an early death. A powerful warrior’s soul is reborn in her, bringing a very different ambition: she wants to meet opponents strong enough to challenge her. The official synopsis frames the appeal around that contrast between an adorable young noblewoman and a battle-hungry former hero. The series is not only a succession of fights, however; Nia also attends school and participates in the kingdom’s “Magic Vision” entertainment business. That second thread gives the premise a distinctive shape. Magic Vision is the fantasy world’s screen entertainment, and Nia’s involvement turns performance and public image into part of her daily life alongside combat. Official character notes connect Nia with Princess Hildetaura and rival talent Reliared in projects promoting the medium. This is context from the production’s published character descriptions, not a claim about future plot outcomes. Who makes the anime? KONAMI animation produces the series. Motoki Nakanishi directs, Gigaemon Ichikawa handles series composition, Yuki Ito and Kana Tosaoka are credited with character design, and Naoki Endo composes the music. Honoka Inoue voices Nia, Fuka Izumi plays Rinokis, Rina Honnizumi plays Hildetaura, and Rina Hidaka voices Reliared. The official staff and cast list has the full credits. Related reading: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Episode Schedule & Where to Watch . The animation is adapted from Umikaze Minamino’s light novel, published under Hobby Japan’s HJ Bunko imprint. The official anime site also lists a manga adaptation by Kouta Koga. The official site currently lists twelve novel volumes and nine manga volumes, giving newcomers a clear way to distinguish the original prose series from its comic adaptation. Where to find the source material The official anime site lists Minamino’s original light novels separately from Kouta Koga’s manga adaptation: twelve novel volumes and nine manga volumes are currently listed. If you want the original version of Nia’s story, the novels are the source; the manga is a separate adaptation. The anime site does not publish a volume-by-volume map for the television episodes, so the Blu-ray episode ranges do not tell readers exactly where to resume in either book format. Official teaser and upload-time note The teaser PV is linked from the official anime website and from KONAMI Digital Entertainment’s January 28, 2026 announcement , which says the teaser visual and video were released that day. The sources available for this review do not establish the separate YouTube upload hour and timezone. We therefore give the verified release date only and omit an exact-time VideoObject timestamp instead of treating the press-release time as the video’s upload time. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TEASER KONAMI animation What remains unconfirmed? The Japanese broadcast and domestic streaming schedules, HIDIVE simulcast listing, two-cour format and 25 episodes across official Blu-ray volumes are confirmed. A dub schedule is not stated in the official pages cited here. For later episodes, use current weekly platform listings; time slots can change and service catalogs vary by region. entries.description: Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend will premiere in 2027. Rina Kawaguchi and Tomoya Ito lead the cast of feel.'s office comedy adaptation.
entries.content: OFFICIAL ANIME NEWS · OCTOBER 12, 2026 Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend Anime: 2027 Release, Main Cast and First Visual The workplace comedy from Weekly Young Jump is heading to television in 2027. Its first key visual and two lead voice actors have been unveiled, bringing the unusual friendship between Noa and Rihito one step closer to the screen. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official Noa Saotome character artwork from the anime website. The separate first key visual was revealed October 11. © Enma Akiyama / Shueisha / Noa-senpai wa Tomodachi Production Committee. Release at a glance Release 2027; month and day pending Where to watch International streaming partner pending Applies to Japanese television announcement Still pending Broadcast season, episode count and streaming platforms Release details checked October 12, 2026 · Official source When will Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend premiere? The television anime Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend ( Noa-senpai wa Tomodachi. ) is scheduled to air in 2027 . The production confirmed the year in an October 11, 2026 update alongside its first key visual and the two main voice actors. No exact month, day, television channel or international streaming service has been announced. A more precise release date would be speculation. Meet the two confirmed lead voice actors The official cast announcement puts the central coworkers in focus: Rina Kawaguchi voices Noa Saotome , an accomplished art director at a video game company who hides a more vulnerable side behind her professional reputation. Tomoya Ito voices Rihito Otsuka , a second-year employee who tries to conserve energy and avoid unnecessary drama. These are the two announced leads as of October 12. Other characters may appear in the series, but no additional voice cast should be treated as confirmed until the production announces it. What does the new key visual show? The first key visual depicts Noa and Rihito sitting together, emphasizing the unlikely friendship at the center of the story. It is different from the earlier teaser visual released when the anime adaptation was announced in July 2026. The image above is official character artwork sourced from the production website; to see the newly announced full key visual, visit the official anime website . Studio and production staff feel. is animating the series. Shinsuke Yanagi is directing, Keiichiro Ochi is responsible for series composition, and Yumiko Yamamoto is designing the characters. The core staff were identified with the original adaptation announcement, and the October cast update provides a clearer sense of the show's lead performances. What is the story about? Noa Saotome seems to have her career under control. As an art director at a game development company, she earns the respect of managers and younger colleagues alike. Rihito Otsuka, meanwhile, is in his second year at the company and approaches daily life with a determinedly low-energy attitude. One day, he accidentally discovers a side of Noa she has carefully concealed at work. That encounter begins an unusual after-hours friendship. Rather than centering on a fantasy world or a high school, Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend explores how two very different adults negotiate workplace expectations, personal boundaries and the meaning of being friends. Related reading: Expelled from Paradise Sequel Reveals Main Trailer and Beyond the Night Theme Song . Where did the original manga come from? The anime adapts Enma Akiyama's manga , which began running in Shueisha's Weekly Young Jump in July 2023. Eleven collected volumes had been released in Japan by July 2026, and Volume 12 was released in Japan on October 19, 2026. The manga's continuing serialization means the anime is adapting an established ongoing story rather than an original television screenplay. Is the first key visual the same as a trailer? No. The October 11 update introduced a still promotional image and the voices of Noa and Rihito, not a confirmed animated trailer. The official announcement establishes a 2027 television broadcast window, but no exact season, episode count or international streaming partner. Readers should treat a fan-made video or an unrelated manga promotion differently from a production-released anime trailer. Is there a trailer? The latest October 11 announcement focuses on the first key visual and the lead voice cast. An official trailer associated with this update has not been independently confirmed , so this article does not embed or label an unrelated video as an official trailer. Readers can check the production's website and social channels for future promotional videos. Where will the anime stream? As of October 12, 2026, no international streaming partner has been confirmed. The anime's broadcast season and episode count are also unannounced. We will update this page when the production or a licensed distributor releases those details. What is the original manga's setting? Enma Akiyama's manga places its leads at a video game company. The official anime introduction describes Noa as a respected art director and Rihito as a junior employee who discovers a side of her she normally hides at work. Their friendship develops after the working day ends. The professional setting gives the series a different backdrop from a school comedy, while the official material leaves later story developments for viewers to discover. The production has named the lead cast and animation staff, but has not supplied a precise 2027 premiere date or confirmed an international platform. Related reading: The Fable Season 2: January 9, 2027 Premiere, Cast and Visual . Frequently asked questions Is Noa Is My Senior an anime? Yes. The manga's television anime adaptation was announced in July 2026, with a 2027 broadcast window confirmed in October. Who voices Noa Saotome? Rina Kawaguchi voices Noa Saotome. Who voices Rihito Otsuka? Tomoya Ito voices Rihito Otsuka. Which studio is animating it? feel. is responsible for animation production. Official sources Noa Is My Senior official anime website · Crunchyroll News: cast, key visual and 2027 broadcast . For other confirmed series, browse the AniNextUp anime calendar and latest news . entries.content: OFFICIAL ANIME NEWS · OCTOBER 17, 2026 Now That We Draw Anime Sets January 2027 Premiere The TV adaptation of Kakunaru Ue wa begins in January 2027. Its official website has revealed the first promotional video, character visuals and two lead cast members; an exact day and streaming platform have not been announced. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official promotional visual. Source and artwork credit: official anime website . Release at a glance Premiere window January 2027; exact day pending Lead cast Ayumu Murase as Yuki Uehara; Sayumi Suzushiro as Niina Miyamoto Animation studio ROLL2 Streaming Not announced Verified against the official anime website . When does Now That We Draw premiere? Now That We Draw is scheduled to begin in January 2027. The official anime website confirms the month, but it does not name an exact premiere day, Japanese TV station, broadcast time or international streaming service. Readers can treat January as the current release window, not as a date for a specific episode. AniNextUp will update the guide if the production committee publishes a timetable. The series is based on the manga Kakunaru Ue wa . The September 2026 promotion added a first PV and character visuals to the earlier adaptation announcement, giving viewers a better sense of the leads and production team. It still does not answer the day-to-day schedule or regional streaming question. What is the story about? Yuki Uehara dreams of becoming a manga artist and loves two-dimensional characters. After an editor criticizes his romantic-comedy manga for lacking realistic romance, he considers giving up. Classmate Niina Miyamoto discovers his work and reveals that she also wants to become a manga artist. The pair start a “secret pretend relationship” to help with their manga, setting up a youth romantic comedy about two aspiring creators. The creative goal matters to the premise: both students are trying to write romance while admitting that they have little personal experience with it. Their arrangement gives them a reason to observe how people behave together, but the official synopsis does not promise that the fake relationship will end in a particular way. That distinction is useful for readers looking for a spoiler-free introduction: the confirmed hook is shared ambition and an unusual research pact, not a stated final couple outcome. Related reading: Dengeki Daisy Anime Sets January 2027 Premiere, Reveals Trailer and Cast . The original manga is written by Kyū Takahata and illustrated by Yūji Kaba ; it is serialized in Hakusensha’s Young Animal . The anime website and the production company’s published series information identify those creators and the magazine. Cast, staff and music Ayumu Murase voices Yuki Uehara, while Sayumi Suzushiro voices Niina Miyamoto. The official site describes Yuki as an inward-looking high-school student who cares deeply about his interests; Niina is an energetic, popular classmate who shares his manga ambition. These profiles explain why the characters’ creative partnership is central to the setup. ROLL2 is producing the animation. Shunsuke Ishikawa directs, Deko Akao handles series composition and scripts, and Hiromi Nakagawa designs the characters. The official staff list also names sub-character design, color design, art, photography, 3D, editing, sound and music credits. shallm performs the opening theme “Kimiiro Hirari,” announced by production company Infinite on October 8, 2026 . No ending song has been named in the sources reviewed. Watch the official first PV ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL PV January 2027 TV anime Official anime website . The official website identifies the video as the first PV, and its announcement dates the reveal to September 24, 2026. The official materials reviewed do not establish the original YouTube upload’s exact hour and time zone. We therefore show the verified video but omit an exact upload timestamp and VideoObject uploadDate rather than treating the article’s announcement date as the video’s publication time. Can readers start with the manga? Yes. The original manga is available in English from Seven Seas Entertainment under the title Now That We Draw , also listed with its Japanese title Kakunaru Ue wa . Its official catalogue describes both leads as high-school manga creators and lists English volumes 1–5 as released, with volume 6 scheduled for December 22, 2026 and volume 7 for May 18, 2027. Those are book-release dates from the English publisher; they are not anime episode dates. Starting with the manga is a practical option for readers who want to meet Yuki and Niina before the broadcast. It does not establish how many chapters the anime will adapt, whether the adaptation will cover a complete story arc, or whether it will make changes. The anime’s episode count and source-material endpoint have not been announced, so chapter-to-episode estimates would be speculation. Where to watch and what remains unknown The Japanese broadcast month is confirmed, but the network and streaming outlet have not been announced on the official anime site. No international license or territory list is published in the official sources reviewed. A platform that carries the manga, or streams other anime by the same studio, is not evidence that it will carry this series. Readers outside Japan should wait for a distributor announcement before planning a subscription or expecting same-day episodes. The confirmed information currently answers who the leads are, what motivates their relationship, which studio is producing the show, and when its broadcast window begins. The exact January day, episode count, Japanese channel, streaming availability by country, ending theme and trailer upload time remain open. See our January 2027 anime guide for other confirmed release windows, and check back here when the official schedule changes. Compare dates, platforms and release regions in our January 2027 anime guide . Updated: October 25, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error

entries.description: Nue's Exorcist airs in Japan in summer 2027 on TV Asahi. See confirmed cast, Studio Hibari staff, official teaser upload time, manga context and unknowns.
entries.content: OFFICIAL NEWS · OCTOBER 12, 2026 Nue's Exorcist Anime Release Date: Summer 2027, Cast & Trailer Nue's Exorcist is confirmed for a summer 2027 TV broadcast on TV Asahi's nationwide network in Japan. Studio Hibari, three Japanese cast members and the official teaser are confirmed; an exact premiere day and international streaming service are not. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official teaser visual. Source: Nue's Exorcist official site . © Kota Kawae / Shueisha / Nue's Exorcist Production Committee. RELEASE AT A GLANCE TV anime · Summer 2027 · exact premiere date TBA Japan: TV Asahi nationwide network · Studio Hibari · international streaming: TBA Is Nue's Exorcist getting an anime? Yes. Nue's Exorcist (Japanese title Nue no Onmyōji ) is receiving a television anime scheduled for summer 2027 on TV Asahi's nationwide Japanese network. The announcement was made on October 12, 2026, when the production also released a teaser visual and the first promotional video. That confirms a season, broadcaster and broad broadcast window, but no exact premiere day, episode count or international streaming service has been announced. Readers searching for a specific date should treat “summer 2027” as the only confirmed schedule for now. Who is making the anime, and who is in the cast? Studio Hibari is producing the animation. Hiroyuki Hashimoto is directing; Hiroshi Seko is handling series composition; Shunpei Mochizuki is designing the characters; Takayuki Yamaguchi is sound director; and MONACA is composing the music. The three initially named Japanese voice actors are Kaito Miura as Gakuro Yajima , Saori Ōnishi as Nue and Sayumi Suzushiro as Kazusa Suo . The teaser introduces the voices of Gakuro and Nue, while the official announcement presents character visuals for a wider group. More casting may be revealed later; at present, only those three roles are confirmed. No English-language cast or dub schedule has been announced. What is the story of Nue's Exorcist? Kota Kawae's manga follows Gakuro Yajima, a high-school student who has been able to see supernatural beings called “phantoms” since he was young. At his new school he discovers a room that other people cannot perceive. It is the home of Nue, a phantom with a fondness for games, who asks him to help deal with dangerous supernatural beings. Shueisha's official book description frames the premise as a modern onmyōji story built around Gakuro and Nue; the anime announcement describes it as a school dark fantasy about a boy's growth and supernatural battles. That setup gives the adaptation two useful entry points: school relationships and a continuing supernatural-action conflict. It is still only a premise, however. The production has not published an episode-by-episode outline or said how much of the manga the first television season will adapt. What does the official teaser reveal? The official teaser is a 45-second promotional video linked from the anime's own news page. Shueisha DeNA Projects describes it as using MONACA's main theme and showing how Gakuro gains power through meeting Nue; it also introduces the first character voices. The footage is useful for hearing the leads and seeing the adaptation's initial presentation, but it is not a full story trailer and does not confirm a streaming platform or premiere date. The original YouTube page's published metadata gives the upload time as October 12, 2026 at 4:30:33 a.m. PDT (UTC−07:00) . This is the video upload time, not the time of a separate news article. The official anime site identifies the same video as its special teaser PV. The video's presence on an official channel makes the timestamp specific to this trailer, rather than an estimate taken from a press report. When in summer 2027 will it premiere? “Summer 2027” is the Japanese broadcast season, not a confirmed June, July or August date. The official announcement says TV Asahi's nationwide network, but does not list a weekday, time slot or first episode date. Until a schedule notice names a day and time, calendar dates circulating without an official citation remain speculation. The TV Asahi announcement also does not name an overseas streaming partner. International viewers should wait for a separate distributor notice before assuming availability. Should new viewers read the manga first? No anime prerequisite has been announced. The adaptation is being introduced as its own television project, and the official pages do not tell viewers to finish a particular manga arc before watching. If you want to sample the source, Shueisha's official Jump+ page for chapter one records its May 17, 2023 publication date and summarizes Gakuro's first meeting with Nue. Shueisha lists the first collected volume as released on October 4, 2023, with 192 pages. Reading the opening material can clarify the series' terminology and the school setting, but the published anime announcement does not say whether the adaptation will reproduce the manga scene for scene. The official pages have not yet announced a manga endpoint for the season, so recommendations such as “read through volume X first” would be guesswork. What details are still unconfirmed? The confirmed picture is fairly specific about the project's starting team: summer 2027 in Japan, TV Asahi nationwide broadcast, Studio Hibari, named director and core staff, three cast roles, official key art and a teaser PV. The unanswered practical questions are the exact premiere date, episode total, full cast, staff additions, international streaming, subtitles, English dub and how many manga chapters the season will cover. For updates, the production's official anime site and its notices are the primary sources. Its October 12 posts separately confirm the adaptation and teaser visual, publish the teaser PV, and link the Jump PRESS archive. Shueisha DeNA Projects' announcement provides the staff, cast and production context, while Shonen Jump+ and Shueisha's book catalogue are useful for checking the manga's publication details. AniNextUp will update this guide when the production confirms a dated premiere or distribution partner. AniNextUp status: TV anime confirmed for summer 2027 on TV Asahi's nationwide network, with Studio Hibari producing. Three Japanese cast members, core staff and an official teaser are confirmed. The exact broadcast date, episode count and international viewing options remain unannounced. Updated: October 25, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error Primary sources: official anime announcement and teaser visual ; official teaser PV notice ; Shueisha DeNA Projects staff and cast announcement ; official Jump PRESS archive notice ; Shueisha's first volume listing .

entries.description: The ONE PIECE Elbaph Arc English dub starts October 20 on Crunchyroll, beginning with episode 1156 and continuing with weekly dubbed episodes.
entries.content: RETURNING SERIES · OCTOBER 17, 2026 ONE PIECE: Elbaph Arc English Dub Release Date and Crunchyroll Schedule The English dub of ONE PIECE’s Elbaph Arc begins streaming on Crunchyroll on October 20, starting with episode 1156. New dubbed episodes are scheduled weekly. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Sources, updates & corrections Official promotional artwork/video for ONE PIECE: Elbaph Arc English Dub Starts October 20 on Crunchyroll. Source: Crunchyroll’s official announcement . Release at a glance English dub begins Tuesday, October 20, 2026 First dubbed episode Episode 1156 Where to watch Crunchyroll; catalog availability can vary by region Release pattern One new dubbed episode each week Details checked 2026-10-17 against the official announcement linked below. Streaming availability may vary by region. When does the ONE PIECE Elbaph Arc English dub start? The English dub of the ONE PIECE Elbaph Arc starts on Tuesday, October 20, 2026 , on Crunchyroll. The rollout begins with episode 1156 and continues weekly, according to Crunchyroll’s announcement with Toei Animation. This is the English-language streaming debut of the Elbaph Arc, not the arc’s first anime release. The Japanese broadcast began in April 2026. Crunchyroll’s announcement sets a weekly cadence for the English dub rather than a multi-episode batch release. What to expect from the weekly dub schedule Viewers following the English version can expect a new dubbed episode each Tuesday after the October 20 launch. Crunchyroll has not described this as a full-season drop, so the October date refers to the start of the dubbed run. Check the service’s listing in your region for the episode’s local availability. Related reading: THE ONE PIECE Release Date: February 2027, Episodes & Where to Watch . The Elbaph storyline follows the Straw Hats into the land of giants after the Egghead Arc. The official trailer previews the arc, while Crunchyroll’s release announcement is the source for the English-dub date and weekly schedule. Watch the official Elbaph Arc trailer ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER ONE PIECE · Elbaph Arc Read Crunchyroll’s release announcement . English dub and other language releases This announcement concerns the English dub of the Elbaph Arc . Crunchyroll separately announced English, Spanish, and Portuguese dubs for the ONE PIECE HEROINES special, which has a different release date. Those language details should not be confused with the Elbaph Arc schedule. Is the English dub available everywhere? Crunchyroll is the announced platform. Streaming catalogs and audio tracks can differ by country, so viewers should check the title page in their market. The date and weekly pattern here describe the announced release, not guaranteed access in every territory. Frequently asked questions What date does the Elbaph Arc English dub premiere? It starts on October 20, 2026. Which episode starts the dubbed release? The first announced episode is episode 1156. Will Crunchyroll release the dub weekly? Yes. Crunchyroll announced one new dubbed episode each week. Is this the first release of the Elbaph Arc? No. This is the English-dub release; the Japanese broadcast of the arc began earlier in 2026. The first dubbed episode and weekly rhythm Crunchyroll’s announcement set the English dub launch for October 20 at 9 a.m. Pacific Time, beginning with episode 1156. It also describes a weekly Tuesday release cadence. That gives English-audio viewers a clear starting point: episode 1156 is the first Elbaph episode in this dub schedule, while the episode number does not mean the English version begins the entire television series from the start. The premiere has now passed. The release date is still useful because it marks the beginning of the Elbaph dub, but readers looking for the newest available episode should consult Crunchyroll’s current episode list. A weekly plan can change around breaks or regional licensing, so a single press announcement is not a substitute for the live catalog. Pacific Time also crosses calendar boundaries in some regions; the platform’s local page is the best confirmation of the day and hour for an individual account. Where should viewers start the dubbed arc? Look for episode 1156, “The Long-sought Elbaph! The Big Reunion Banquet!”, in the Crunchyroll episode listing . The listing identifies both Japanese and English audio, although access and the tracks shown to an individual viewer depend on their local catalog. The episode number carries over from the larger ONE PIECE television series. It is the start of this announced Elbaph dub rollout, not the first episode of the entire anime. Viewers who want the story leading into the arc can use their service's episode list to locate the preceding Egghead installments. Crunchyroll and Toei announced a Tuesday release pattern after the October 20 launch. That is a schedule announcement, rather than a guarantee that every future episode will arrive without a break. Check the current listing for a particular episode and its available language before planning a watch. English audio is a separate release track The Japanese broadcast, subtitled simulcast and English dub are different tracks. This guide covers the English dub specifically; it should not be read as a new Japanese premiere date for the Elbaph story. Episode 1156 is the dub’s announced first episode, and the reported weekly cadence concerns dubbed installments. It says nothing about when the Japanese version first aired or how far each language track is from the other. Crunchyroll’s announcement is the right source for the dub start and schedule. It does not guarantee that the English track is available in every country, or that each market receives it at the same local time. Check the series page in the region where you watch and confirm the audio label before pressing play. That quick check avoids confusing an episode listed with Japanese audio and subtitles for the English-dub release readers came to find.
