entries.description: Suikoden began October 3, 2026. Check Japan’s changing weekly schedule, the official third PV, cast, story and how the anime connects to Suikoden II.
entries.content: OCTOBER 3 · 2026 Suikoden: The Anime — Schedule, Cast, Trailer and Game Guide The Suikoden II adaptation began in Japan on October 3, 2026. Check the weekly schedule after its expanded premiere, the official trailer, cast, story and guidance for viewers new to the games. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official Suikoden anime visual. © Konami Digital Entertainment / Suikoden: The Anime Project. Official production site . Release at a glance Japanese premiere October 3, 2026 · TOKYO MX 20:00 JST; expanded first episode Regular TOKYO MX slot Tuesdays 23:30 JST from October 13 Production KONAMI animation Streaming Japan’s listed services; international availability varies Checked October 24, 2026 · Official schedule When did Suikoden: The Anime premiere? Suikoden: The Anime began its Japanese rollout on October 3, 2026, with a 60-minute expanded first episode on TOKYO MX at 20:00 JST. That is 11:00 UTC. The production announced a progressive rollout across 32 Japanese stations, so October 3 is the first broadcast date rather than the start date of every channel. The extended opening also should not be taken as the standard runtime of the later episodes. What is the regular weekly schedule? After the opening special, TOKYO MX moved to Tuesdays at 23:30 JST from October 13. October 6 was reserved for a special program about the Suikoden franchise. BS Asahi began its own run on October 9, with a Friday 23:30 JST slot. The shift from a Saturday premiere to a Tuesday weekly slot is important if you are looking for the next television episode: the opening event does not define the regular broadcast day. How do the late-night Japanese listings work? Kansai TV lists its first episode on October 6 at 25:34 and later episodes from October 13 at 25:19. In ordinary calendar notation, those mean October 7 at 01:34 JST and Wednesdays at 01:19 JST, respectively. Other local stations have their own starting times. Use the official station-by-station table rather than copying a late-night hour without its date convention; otherwise a reminder can end up on the wrong calendar day. Related reading: Ranma 1/2 Season 3: Netflix Schedule, Cast and Watch Guide . Where can you stream Suikoden? Japan’s official on-air page lists streaming services beginning progressively after 20:00 JST on October 3. They include Prime Video, U-NEXT, ABEMA, Hulu, d Anime Store and others. This is a Japanese distribution list, not a worldwide rights map. The page also warns that schedules may change. For viewing outside Japan, check a locally licensed title listing and its episode availability rather than assuming that a familiar service name guarantees the same release in your country. What is the story about? The anime adapts Suikoden II, the Konami role-playing game. Its central figures are Riliu and his childhood friend Jowy, two members of the Highland Kingdom’s youth brigade in the Dunan region. They share a camp and hopes of returning to ordinary life when the fighting ends. Instead, war draws them into events that test what they believe and what they are willing to do with power. The official introduction frames their friendship and choices as the human center of the conflict. Who are the main characters and actors? Toshiki Kumagai voices Riliu, Shimba Tsuchiya plays Jowy, and Ayumi Hinohara voices Nanami, who grew up alongside them. Katsuyuki Konishi plays the mercenary Viktor, Yuichi Nakamura plays Flik, and Taku Yashiro voices Luca Blight. These are Japanese performance credits from the production’s English cast list. They do not confirm an English dub. New viewers can start by following the three childhood companions before trying to memorize every name in the larger ensemble. Related reading: Anime Mysterious Codes (October 2026): Reports & Redemption Guide . Who is producing the adaptation? KONAMI animation is credited with production and producing, while NBCUniversal Entertainment Japan handles planning. The official English page names YUZO as chief director, Michihiro Tsuchiya for series composition and Ryo Yamauchi for anime character design. Fumi Ishikawa is credited for the game character designs, and Arata Suzuki for the anime character-design basis. Separating those roles helps explain how the adaptation acknowledges the game’s artwork while having its own animation production team. Do you need to play Suikoden II first? Playing the game is optional preparation, not a requirement established by the broadcast announcement. The anime introduces its own version of the characters and conflict; newcomers can follow it from the opening episode. For existing players, the useful question is how the adaptation presents those relationships, not whether the show reproduces every battle, recruitment option or gameplay system. Avoid later game walkthroughs if you want to experience the political turns without knowing the outcome. Related reading: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion! Release Date & Watch Guide . Which songs are used? The opening is Kanashimi Sae Otonobite by amazarashi. Koji Nakamura supplies the music and performs the ending, closed eye sun, featuring Honoka Takahashi. The official site separates the creditless opening and ending videos from the promotional trailers. Choose the third PV if you want an overview of the anime’s advertised story and release; choose the creditless theme videos if you are specifically looking for the opening or ending animation without the on-screen production credits. Watch the official third trailer The third PV is linked from the official anime site and published by NBCUniversal Anime/Music. Its original YouTube metadata records September 17, 2026, at 20:03:59 UTC−07:00, equivalent to September 18 at 03:03:59 UTC and 12:03:59 JST. Its duration is 2 minutes 1 second. That date belongs to the trailer upload, not the October broadcast. The official poster below opens the original video directly if an embedded player is unavailable. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER ON YOUTUBE NBCUniversal Anime/Music · Third PV How does this fit the wider Suikoden series? Konami’s portal identifies the anime specifically as an adaptation of Suikoden II. It separately lists Suikoden I & II HD Remaster and the new game Suikoden STAR LEAP. The portal also links a manga adaptation of the anime. Those are different formats and projects: a game launch trailer is not an anime episode, and STAR LEAP’s updates do not set the television show’s schedule. Start with the anime’s own website when searching for broadcast or casting news. What should viewers check next? The reviewed schedule establishes when the Japanese television and streaming rollout began, but does not guarantee identical worldwide release times or language options. It also does not, by itself, establish which game scenes will make the final adaptation. Check the anime’s current episode listings for viewing order and the relevant local distributor for subtitles or dubbing. A 60-minute opening and a large cast should not be used to calculate the season’s exact episode count. entries.content: NOVEMBER 27 · ANIME MOVIE Takopi's Original Sin: Thank You, See You Tomorrow Release Date Takopi returns to theaters in Japan on November 27, 2026. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official main trailer image for the Japanese theatrical film. Source: TBS Animation official trailer . Release at a glance Release date November 27, 2026 · Japanese theaters Format Theatrical re-edit of all six television episodes with newly produced scenes Animation studio ENISHIYA International release Not announced Details checked October 23, 2026 · Official TBS update How the movie differs from the television anime The theatrical version brings the six-episode story together in one cinema presentation and adds newly created scenes. That makes it a different viewing format, not a continuation set after the television ending. Readers who have already watched the series can decide whether the new material and theatrical presentation justify revisiting a story they know; the Japanese cinema date alone does not establish international availability. When does the Takopi movie release? Takopi's Original Sin: Thank You, See You Tomorrow opens in Japanese theaters on November 27, 2026. The theatrical version revisits the complete television anime while adding material created specifically for the movie presentation. Should existing viewers expect a completely new sequel? No. TBS describes the film as a theatrical re-edit of the six-episode anime with additional newly produced scenes. That makes the November 27 Japanese cinema release a different presentation of the existing story rather than a confirmed sequel set after its ending. The announcement does not detail how much new animation appears or which moments it covers. Read the official TBS film announcement. Related reading: Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san? Anime Release Date: January 7, 2027 . What does the theatrical edit include? The film combines material from all six television episodes with newly created scenes. The announcement does not specify the length of that added footage, so it would be premature to describe the film as an entirely new story or to promise particular scenes. What is Takopi's Original Sin about? Takopi is an alien who arrives on Earth hoping to spread happiness. After meeting Shizuka, he uses mysterious Happy Gadgets in an attempt to restore her smile, only to discover that the problems surrounding her family and school life cannot be solved with simple magical tools. Related reading: Walking Home with You Anime . Where to watch The November 27 release is currently confirmed for Japanese cinemas. An international theatrical or streaming release has not been announced. Watch the official movie video ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Takopi’s Original Sin official movie promotional video Editorial context: The November cinema version should not be confused with a second television season or a continuation of the original ending. It packages the six-episode adaptation into a theatrical presentation and adds footage specifically for that version. Viewers seeking the existing series can distinguish it from the film by its separate release format; international cinema and streaming arrangements remain unannounced. See all confirmed November 2026 releases → Official production announcement: TBS November 27 theatrical edit and additional footage . What the October 23 trailer and song announcement add TBS released the movie’s full trailer and a newly drawn visual on October 23, then confirmed “らびゅー” by Tele as the theme song. The update gives viewers two concrete pieces of the film’s identity beyond its November 27 Japanese theatrical date: a campaign song and a new visual illustrated by character designer Keita Nagahara. It also confirms that the project’s publicity is now moving from the initial date announcement into the final pre-release period. The trailer is useful for seeing how the six-episode television story is being presented for theaters, but it does not establish how many minutes of new animation the edit contains. TBS has described the film as a theatrical compilation with newly produced scenes; the amount and placement of that material remain unspecified. The trailer and theme song also do not confirm an international cinema or streaming plan. Readers outside Japan should treat November 27 as a Japan-only date unless a distributor announces additional territories. Watch TBS’s October 23 official full trailer . Source: TBS official movie update, October 23, 2026 . When do Japanese advance tickets go on sale? TBS's official ticket page lists advance movie-ticket card sales from October 23, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Japan time through the day before the November 27 opening. The listed general price is ¥1,600 including tax. Sales at theater counters vary by cinema, and the page notes that advance sales can end without notice. These are Japanese ticket details, not confirmation of overseas screenings. Check the official theater and ticket listings for availability before making plans. The ticket page also warns of sensitive material and says viewers under 12 need parental guidance. What should viewers check before buying a ticket? The official announcement confirms the Japanese cinema date and describes the film as a re-edit of all six television episodes with newly created scenes. It does not specify the movie’s runtime, the amount of new footage or screenings outside Japan. Those details should remain open until TBS or a distributor publishes them. A trailer can show scenes selected for promotion, but it does not establish how much of the finished theatrical cut is new. For readers comparing updates, the safest distinction is between the confirmed November 27 Japan release and the still-unannounced international plan. entries.content: FALL 2026 · RELEASE GUIDE A Tale of the Secret Saint: Release Date and Streaming A Tale of the Secret Saint premiered October 3, 2026 on Crunchyroll. Release date, studio and streaming details for Fall 2026. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official promotional visual. Artwork source: official release announcement . RELEASE DATE October 3, 2026 STREAMING Crunchyroll STUDIO FelixFilm Release at a glance Release October 3, 2026 Where to watch Crunchyroll in licensed territories Region and timing Platform premiere. Release details checked October 12, 2026 · Crunchyroll’s A Tale of the Secret Saint series page Why keeping the heroine's identity secret matters The central tension is not simply whether the heroine can become stronger. Her memories suggest she already possesses extraordinary potential, while revealing it could change her position in the world around her. That makes secrecy and self-restraint part of the story's appeal, especially for viewers who prefer fantasy built around hidden identity rather than straightforward power progression. When does A Tale of the Secret Saint premiere? A Tale of the Secret Saint premiered October 3, 2026. Crunchyroll carries the series internationally as part of its Fall 2026 lineup. Where to watch The announced Crunchyroll territories include North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS, the Indian Subcontinent, Southeast Asia and Korea. Availability and episode timing can still vary by individual market. What is A Tale of the Secret Saint about? The story follows a swordswoman who believes she has little talent until memories of a previous life reveal that she was once a powerful Saint. That knowledge gives her extraordinary magical potential, but openly revealing it would also expose her to enemies connected to her former life. What separates the heroine's present and past lives? The official premise places the heroine's sword training in her current life and her Saint abilities in memories of a former one. Her problem is not only discovering that power but deciding when it is safe to reveal it. This gives viewers a way to follow the central tension without assuming that her companions will immediately learn the truth or that every confrontation will be resolved through magic. Those outcomes are not established by the synopsis. Who is making the anime? FelixFilm is the animation studio for the adaptation. The series combines fantasy adventure with a reincarnation mystery built around the heroine hiding abilities that could completely change how others see her. What viewers can follow as the story develops The heroine's decision to conceal her Saint identity creates two separate questions: how she will train as a swordswoman in her current life, and when her past-life knowledge becomes too important to hide. The official premise establishes that tension but does not confirm which characters will discover her secret. See the Fall 2026 anime calendar for other confirmed October premieres. Related reading: The True Saint Was Banished Anime: January 2027 & Trailer . The release is underway, so check episode availability locally The series premiered on October 3, 2026, and Crunchyroll’s October 5 update confirms it is streaming there as it airs. That update also points readers to creditless opening and ending videos, a useful official extra for viewers who want the songs and animation without episode credits. Those videos are promotional material; they do not announce an episode total or change the series’ weekly broadcast calendar. Crunchyroll’s page lists audio and subtitle options, including Spanish varieties, but those choices can vary by market and account. A show page may display language tracks differently across regions, so the local episode player is the reliable final check. The article’s release date tells viewers when the season began; it does not guarantee that every episode is already available at the moment they read it. Who created the story and anime? The anime adapts a fantasy series written by Touya with original illustrations by chibi. Seven Seas Entertainment also publishes the English-language manga adaptation, which credits Mahito Aobe alongside the original creators. For the television adaptation, Crunchyroll credits Tomoe Makino as director at FelixFilm, Deko Akao for series composition, Satomi Kurita for character design and Kenichiro Suehiro for the music. These are production credits; a book's release schedule does not establish which chapters are included in a given anime episode. Why is Fia cautious about her power? The publisher's synopsis explains that her memories include the danger and painful end of her former life as a Saint. Fia still wants to pursue knighthood, but her recovered healing and protection magic can reveal an identity she would rather keep hidden. That conflict gives the fantasy adventure its central question without revealing how later relationships or battles are resolved. What the reincarnation premise actually sets up Fia wants to become a knight despite believing she has little talent with a sword. Near death, she remembers a previous life as the Saint who defeated the Demon King. The story then places two lives in tension: her present effort to become a knight and the powerful abilities she associates with that earlier identity. Her decision to keep those abilities secret gives the premise its practical question—when can she help someone without exposing herself? The official synopsis establishes that the past-life memory also brings back enemies. It does not establish that every friend knows the truth, or that each problem is resolved through the Saint’s power. The anime’s director and studio credits, and the current streaming listing, are more useful confirmed details than trying to predict how the secret will be revealed. Readers can follow the weekly release and revisit the official episode page for current language options; AniNextUp will update the schedule if the distributor announces a break or a new availability region. Updated: October 26, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error Official references: Crunchyroll anime production and premiere coverage and regional availability .

entries.content: OFFICIAL NEWS · OCTOBER 4, 2026 TANK CHAIR Anime: Schedule, Cast and Where to Watch TANK CHAIR began in Japan on October 4, 2026. Here are the weekly channel times, streaming schedule, cast and the information international viewers should check. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Updated: October 24, 2026 · How we verify releases Official anime key visual via the TANK CHAIR production committee website . © Manabu Yashiro, Kodansha / TANK CHAIR Production Committee. Release at a glance Japanese premiere October 4, 2026; weekly broadcasts TV schedule TOKYO MX Sundays at 23:00 JST; see the full channel times below Streaming in Japan Prime Video Sundays at 23:30 JST; other services from Wednesdays at 23:30 JST Animation studio Polygon Pictures Availability abroad Kodansha USA lists Crunchyroll for the October 2026 premiere; confirm your country's catalog Schedule checked October 24, 2026 · Official broadcast and streaming schedule When did TANK CHAIR premiere? The television anime began in Japan on Sunday, October 4, 2026. Check your local service for the latest episode. Viewers comparing autumn listings can also use our Fall 2026 anime calendar . The official schedule gives a weekly broadcast pattern, while its late-night notation means some listings fall on the following calendar day. This distinction explains why two channels can both list the same Sunday program but show different dates on a calendar. TOKYO MX lists new episodes Sundays at 11:00 p.m. Japan Standard Time (JST). BS11 lists Sundays at 24:30, which is 12:30 a.m. on Monday by the ordinary clock. CBC lists Mondays at 25:37, or 1:37 a.m. Tuesday, and MBS lists Tuesdays at 27:00, or 3:00 a.m. Wednesday. AT-X adds a Tuesday broadcast at 10:00 p.m. JST. Those are Japanese station times; viewers abroad should not convert them into a local streaming promise. Where can you stream TANK CHAIR? The official anime distribution notice says Prime Video starts advance streaming in Japan at 11:30 p.m. JST on Sundays, following the TOKYO MX broadcast. It also lists a later Wednesday rollout across other Japanese subscription video services, beginning October 7 at 11:30 p.m. JST. The order matters: a service listed for Wednesday is not necessarily carrying the episode at the same time as Prime Video, and the schedule refers to Japanese catalogs. Related reading: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Schedule & Where to Watch . For viewers outside Japan, the answer depends on country and service catalog. Kodansha USA’s September 15, 2026 title feature lists Crunchyroll for the anime’s October 2026 premiere, while the Japanese anime site separately documents Prime Video and other domestic platforms. Neither statement establishes that every service carries every episode in every territory. Check the current episode listing for your country, and use the Japanese broadcast times only as a reference for the original schedule. What is the story about? Nagi Taira is a highly capable assassin who falls into a coma after taking a bullet meant for his younger sister, Shizuka. She discovers a disturbing condition tied to his recovery: he can briefly awaken when he senses murderous intent. Shizuka then takes on dangerous jobs and brings Nagi into encounters with increasingly formidable opponents, hoping that a decisive battle will bring him back fully. The official description frames this as a violent journey of recovery and a story about the siblings’ bond. The “rehabilitation” premise is deliberately extreme and belongs to the manga’s fictional action world; it is not medical guidance or a realistic account of coma care. The series also places the siblings in Guicheng Island, a dangerous city where gangs use genetic doping to gain power. That setting helps explain the unusual enemies and heightened combat stakes without requiring viewers to know the manga first. Related reading: Black Clover Season 2 Schedule & Where to Watch . Who are Nagi, Shizuka and the Kurosaka siblings? Koki Uchiyama voices Nagi, and Minori Fujidera voices Shizuka. Their central relationship gives the action a clear emotional question: whether Shizuka can help her brother recover and what risks she is willing to take. Gakuto Kajiwara plays Naozumi Kurosaka, Nagi’s former classmate and rival, while Saori Hayami plays Touko, Naozumi’s younger sister and battle partner. The wider ensemble includes Yurina Amami as Dr. Radio, Gen Sato as Uzu, Megumi Ogata as Sensei, Nobuyuki Hiyama as Goro Arashiyama, Hochu Otsuka as Ryo Takanashi, and Tetsu Inada as Yoshitsune. These names come from the anime’s official cast listing. Which studio and staff make the anime? Polygon Pictures handles animation. Tadahiro “Tady” Yoshihira and Hiroaki Ando are both credited as directors, with Yoshihira also responsible for series composition and screenplay and Ando sharing screenplay duties. Yuki Moriyama designs the characters, Kazuma Teshigahara handles production design, and Masaru Yokoyama composes the music. The official staff page also lists separate art, color, sound, and CG supervision roles, useful context for a series built around elaborate machinery, a combat wheelchair, and a dense urban setting. For another mecha-centered action project, see our VOTOMS: The Gray Witch Part 1 guide . Related reading: Dandivine Release Date & Where to Watch: Japan Schedule, Cast and Story . The two-director credit is confirmed, but it should not be turned into an unsupported claim about which director handled a particular episode or visual sequence. Polygon Pictures describes the project as an action story centered on bloodlust and bonds. That production framing matches the unusual premise, while the on-screen execution and episode-by-episode division of work remain matters for the finished series and credits. Readers interested in another science-fiction action release can also see our Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING guide . Is TANK CHAIR based on a manga? Yes. Manabu Yashiro created the ongoing manga published by Kodansha. Kodansha’s English-language series page describes its setting, Nagi’s injury, Shizuka’s discovery, and the dangerous opponents she seeks. That gives anime-only viewers a reliable starting point and gives manga readers a way to compare the adaptation’s setup with the source without assuming that the television series will cover a particular number of chapters. The anime announcements confirm the adaptation and its creative team, but they do not state an episode count, a season-ending chapter, or whether every arc will be adapted. Readers deciding whether to start the manga can begin with volume one; viewers who prefer the anime can follow the broadcast and streaming listings above. Related reading: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Episode Schedule & Where to Watch . What music appears in the series and trailer? The August 2026 announcement names SiM’s “DALALA” as the opening theme and Daoko’s “SYNC” as the ending theme. The official site separately announced the digital release timing for the ending song. The main promotional video uses “DALALA” alongside action footage, while the character teaser focuses on voices and the central cast. This makes the main PV the better preview of the show’s pace and music, and the character video the more direct introduction to its performers. What remains unconfirmed? The cited official notices do not state an episode count or adaptation endpoint. International catalog availability also depends on region. Use the Japanese schedule for broadcast context, then check your country’s platform listing for the current episode. Watch the official character teaser ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TEASER TANK CHAIR Official Updated: October 24, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error Official references: broadcast and streaming schedule , staff and cast , character profiles , Polygon Pictures project page , premiere and main PV announcement , character teaser release notice , Kodansha manga synopsis , and Kodansha USA’s October streaming note .

entries.content: OFFICIAL NEWS · OCTOBER 13, 2026 The Boxer Anime: Release Date, Cast, Studios & Teaser The acclaimed Korean boxing webtoon by JH is being adapted into a television anime. A teaser, four lead voice actors and key production staff are confirmed, but no premiere date has been announced. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official teaser thumbnail. Source: LINE Digital Frontier's announcement . Release at a glance Premiere To be announced Format TV anime Animation breccia × STUDIO JEMI Streaming Crunchyroll; territories and launch date pending Official WEBTOON Entertainment announcement Is The Boxer getting an anime? Yes. The Boxer , the Korean webtoon created by JH, has been confirmed as a television anime. The adaptation was announced during the Crunchyroll Showcase at New York Comic Con on October 8, 2026. WEBTOON Entertainment announced the partnership, and LINE Digital Frontier published the Japanese project details the following day, including cast, staff and an official announcement PV. This confirms that the anime is in production; it does not confirm when it will premiere. When will The Boxer anime be released? No premiere month, year, Japanese broadcast slot or episode count has been announced as of October 23, 2026. Crunchyroll has said it plans to stream the series in the future, but that statement is not a launch schedule. It also does not identify every country where the show will be available. Treat a predicted 2027 debut or a claimed weekly schedule as speculation unless the production committee, broadcaster or platform publishes it. For viewers tracking updates, keep three questions separate: when the Japanese broadcast begins, when streaming starts, and which territories receive the stream. A date for one service or country would not automatically answer the other two. AniNextUp will update this guide when an official source supplies those details. Who is in The Boxer anime cast? The first four announced voice actors are Koki Uchiyama as Yu, Kensho Ono as Ryu, Tomokazu Seki as trainer K, and Toshiyuki Toyonaga as J. The Japanese announcement uses the character names Yuki and Ryusanpaku for Yu and Ryu, while English-language coverage commonly uses Yu and Ryu. These are differences in how the names are rendered across editions, not additional characters. The announcement identifies these four roles; it is not a complete cast list for the full webtoon. Which studios and staff are making the anime? Japan’s breccia and South Korea’s STUDIO JEMI are handling animation production. Takehiro Kubota and KANG Wonyeong are the co-directors. Toshiya Ono is credited with series composition and scripts, and Masahiro Suwa is the character designer. BLUE RIGHTS is the creative producer, while HAYATE is named as producer. These are the project’s announced credits; no episode count or production timetable has been released. What is The Boxer about? The story follows Yu, a teenager whose extraordinary reactions and movement catch the attention of trainer K. K is searching for a final prodigy to train when he encounters Yu being attacked. Yu appears emotionally detached, but K recognizes a rare physical talent. The boxing story then places Yu against opponents who have their own ambitions and pressures. That setup gives the series a different question from a conventional underdog story: what happens when ability arrives before motivation or emotional connection? The premise invites readers to watch how Yu, K and the people they meet respond to that imbalance. It does not establish that every opponent is merely an obstacle or reveal how the anime will adapt later developments. This summary stays with the officially introduced setup and avoids spoilers. Where can you read the original webtoon? JH’s The Boxer began serialization on NAVER WEBTOON in 2019. LINE Manga carried its Japanese edition from 2020 through 2022. LINE Digital Frontier reported more than 1.06 billion worldwide views as of September 2026; that is a publisher-reported platform figure, not an independently audited sales total or a count of anime viewers. Readers can find the Japanese edition on the official LINE Manga page . Language options and access depend on the service and region, so check the platform’s listing for your location. Watch the official announcement teaser The video is the project’s official announcement PV, rather than a release-date trailer: no premiere date accompanies it. LINE Digital Frontier linked the teaser from its October 9 announcement. The official YouTube upload metadata lists the upload time as October 8, 2026, at 3:00:27 p.m. PDT. That upload time is distinct from both the announcement date and the date of this article. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TEASER ON YOUTUBE Opens the official HAYATE Inc. video What is confirmed, and what remains unknown? Confirmed details include the television adaptation, the four named voice actors, the listed production staff, and Crunchyroll’s future streaming plan. Still unknown are the premiere date, broadcast network, episode total, episode length, complete international territory list and timing for another trailer. A platform commitment tells viewers where the anime is expected to stream in some markets; it does not answer when it will appear in each catalog. This distinction helps separate confirmed news from fan predictions. Quick answers Has a 2027 premiere been confirmed? No. The official announcements do not give a year or month. Is the video a full trailer? It is the official announcement teaser PV. No release date is attached to it. Will The Boxer stream on Crunchyroll? Crunchyroll has announced future streaming plans. The start date and market-by-market availability are pending. Official sources WEBTOON Entertainment — The Boxer and the adaptation partnership LINE Digital Frontier — cast, staff, story and teaser announcement Crunchyroll — anime announcement and streaming plans Official The Boxer announcement PV on YouTube Updated: October 23, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error

entries.content: OFFICIAL NEWS · OCTOBER 13, 2026 The Fable Season 2: January 9, 2027 Premiere, Cast and Visual The Fable Season 2 starts on Nippon TV in Japan on January 9, 2027 at 24:55 JST (January 10 at 00:55). A new main visual and six additional cast members are confirmed; international streaming remains unannounced. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Published: October 13, 2026 · Editorial policy Official Season 2 teaser artwork via VAP / The Fable anime production . © Katsuhisa Minami / Kodansha / The Fable production committee. Release at a glance Premiere January 9, 2027 at 24:55 JST (January 10, 00:55) Broadcaster Nippon TV network (Japan) Studio Tezuka Productions Global streaming Not announced for Season 2 Official release information October 14 update: Yamaoka arc cast and main visual The official production has revealed the main visual for The Fable Season 2 's Yamaoka arc and confirmed six additional Japanese voice actors. Koichi Yamadera voices Yamaoka, with Takanori Hoshino as Azami, Hiroyuki Yoshino as Yukari, Satoshi Mikami as Koji Mizuno, Taiten Kusunoki as Jiro and Seiyu Fujiwara as Suzumushi. The official anime homepage now confirms January 9, 2027 at 24:55 JST on Nippon TV. Japanese television listings use the January 9 broadcast day for the slot, which falls on January 10 at 00:55 JST by calendar date. An international streaming service remains unannounced. See the official updated cast list → When does The Fable Season 2 premiere? The second season of The Fable is scheduled on Japan's Nippon TV network for Saturday, January 9, 2027 at 24:55 JST (technically Sunday, January 10 at 00:55). This is the official Japanese television schedule, not a confirmed international simulcast time. The new season adapts the Yamaoka arc from Katsuhisa Minami's manga. Why does the January 9 listing become January 10 on the clock? Nippon TV's Japanese schedule uses January 9 at 24:55 JST , a late-night television convention. On a standard calendar clock that is January 10 at 00:55 JST . These labels describe the same Japanese broadcast slot, not two separate premieres. No international streaming hour follows automatically from the Japanese television schedule. Related reading: Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend Anime: 2027 Release, Main Cast and First Visual . Confirmed returning voice cast The official anime website currently confirms returning cast including Kazuyuki Okitsu as Akira Sato, Miyuki Sawashiro as Yoko Sato and Kana Hanazawa as Misaki Shimizu. Further cast additions should be checked against the production's latest announcements. Production and official teaser Ryosuke Takahashi directs the adaptation at Tezuka Productions. The September 15, 2026 official announcement unveiled a teaser video for the next chapter of the story. The official production website hosts the promotional materials and the April 2026 teaser visual. Readers can view the authentic artwork and teaser on the official website. Watch The Fable Season 2 official teaser The production's September teaser introduces the darker Yamaoka arc and the returning characters. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER VAP Official What is The Fable about? Akira Sato is an exceptionally skilled assassin ordered to live a normal life without killing for a year. His effort to stay out of violence is challenged by new conspiracies. The anime adapts Katsuhisa Minami’s manga, published by Kodansha. Where to watch Nippon TV is confirmed for the Japanese broadcast. An international streaming release for Season 2 has not been confirmed in this announcement. Do not assume that a Season 1 streaming service will also carry the new season. What remains unconfirmed? The episode count, international distribution and English dub schedule have not been confirmed in the cited announcements. Official sources and updates Check the official The Fable anime website for the latest production announcements and official promotional artwork. The official news archive covers the earlier teaser announcement; the official anime homepage now displays the January 9, 2027, 24:55 JST broadcast schedule. AniNextUp will update this article when more distribution details are confirmed. What does the Yamaoka arc announcement show? The production's October 14 visual announcement places Akira at the center, with Yamaoka and the assassins Azami and Yukari behind him. Yoko and Misaki also appear in the artwork. The official description presents the image as a sign of danger approaching the ordinary life Akira is trying to protect. The visual establishes the characters and tone of the next chapter, but it is not an episode-by-episode synopsis. Viewers who want to avoid spoilers can use the artwork and teaser as introductions and leave the outcome of Yamaoka's plans to the anime. The announcement confirms the arc and Japanese schedule without giving a complete release calendar for international viewers. Who are the newly announced Japanese voices? Koichi Yamadera plays Yamaoka, while Takanori Hoshino voices Azami and Hiroyuki Yoshino voices Yukari. The additional cast also includes Satoshi Mikami as Koji Mizuno, Taiten Kusunoki as Jiro and Seiyu Fujiwara as Suzumushi. The production's official character page lists the Japanese performers alongside the characters. These roles expand the cast around the returning leads rather than replacing Akira and Yoko. The announced credits describe Japanese performances; they do not confirm an English dub or its actors. If a distributor announces other language versions, the voice cast and timing should be checked for that specific edition. Can you watch the first season while waiting? The first anime season aired in 2024. Its availability may differ by country, so viewers can check their local Disney+ or Hulu catalog for the first season and its audio and subtitle choices. That earlier availability is useful for catching up, but it is not a licensing announcement for Season 2. As of this article's source check, the cited Japanese announcements do not name an international platform for the continuation. For readers who prefer the source material, Kodansha USA's series page lists Katsuhisa Minami's manga in English. The manga and anime are separate formats, and the production has not announced a chapter-by-chapter adaptation schedule for every episode of Season 2. How to follow the Japanese schedule The production lists the series on Nippon TV's Saturday schedule at 24:55, starting January 9. That notation places the first slot at 12:55 a.m. on Sunday, January 10 in Japan. Broadcast schedules may change, and the official listing does not set a worldwide streaming time. Follow the production or a local distributor for later platform, subtitle and episode details. Sources checked October 26, 2026: the official anime website and character pages, plus Kodansha USA. entries.content: 2027 · TV ANIME The Moon on a Rainy Night Anime: 2027 Release, Trailer & Cast The Moon on a Rainy Night is officially set for 2027, and its first full promotional video has revealed the two lead voice actors and more of the production team. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases RELEASE WINDOW 2027 · Exact date TBA The Moon on a Rainy Night (Amayo no Tsuki) will premiere as a TV anime in 2027. The October 7 update introduces the first PV, the voices of the leads and additional production details. What changed? Iori Saeki will voice Saki Kindaichi, while Sora Amamiya will voice Kanon Oikawa. Tomoe Makino directs at CompTown, Shogo Yasukawa handles series composition and scripts, Ayumi Nishihata is responsible for character design, and jizue composes the music. What the official synopsis reveals about Saki and Kanon According to the official anime introduction , Saki Kindaichi meets Kanon Oikawa on her way to a piano lesson shortly before entering high school. They reunite as classmates. Kanon is hard of hearing and has kept her distance from others, while Saki questions the assumptions made about her by people at school. Their gradually developing connection gives the story a character-focused premise rather than a mystery about a release-date reveal. This description does not predict how their relationship will develop in later episodes. Related reading: Fool Night Release Date: November 26 on Netflix . What is still unannounced for 2027? The production confirms a 2027 television release window, its lead cast and staff, and a first promotional video. A specific premiere month, episode count and international streaming distributor are not established by those announcements. Readers should avoid treating a speculative date or service as confirmed until the production or distributor publishes it. Why the 2027 window matters The anime adaptation had already been announced, but the new 2027 broadcast window gives viewers a concrete year to track. An exact month and premiere date have not been announced, so any more specific release claim remains unconfirmed. Official trailer ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL PV Official anime promotional video What is The Moon on a Rainy Night about? Based on Kuzushiro's manga, the story follows Saki Kindaichi and Kanon Oikawa, two high-school classmates whose relationship gradually develops after Saki meets Kanon on her way to a piano lesson shortly before high school begins. Kanon is hard of hearing, and the story places particular emphasis on communication, understanding and the distance between people. Where to watch A specific streaming service has not been announced for the 2027 TV broadcast. Kodansha previously said the anime is planned for streaming in various countries worldwide, but platform and territory details remain pending. What is still missing from the release plan? The first promotional video confirms the leads and production team, while 2027 remains the only announced broadcast window. Neither an exact month nor a specific international streaming service has been named. The mention of worldwide streaming plans does not establish which platforms will carry the series. FAQ When does The Moon on a Rainy Night anime come out? It is confirmed for 2027, but there is no exact date yet. Who voices Saki and Kanon? Iori Saeki voices Saki Kindaichi and Sora Amamiya voices Kanon Oikawa. Which studio is making the anime? Animation production is by CompTown. How the manga's central relationship shapes the anime Saki's interest in Kanon begins with a brief encounter before the two become classmates. Kanon's hearing impairment affects how she communicates with others, while Saki gradually realizes that reaching out requires patience and attention rather than assumptions. The adaptation's announced premise emphasizes the small moments through which their friendship and feelings develop. Where can readers find the original manga? Kodansha USA publishes Kuzushiro's manga in English and provides a preview through its anime announcement and series pages . The publisher's description starts with Saki dropping her sheet music during an encounter on the way to a piano lesson, then meeting Kanon again in their classroom. The manga offers readers an opportunity to explore their story before the adaptation arrives. The publisher's English book releases and the anime's future streaming arrangements are separate products; a manga listing does not confirm an anime platform or the number of chapters each episode will adapt. How should viewers interpret the announcement? The official promotional video introduces the leads and the adaptation's atmosphere, while the production site identifies the people making the series. Those are useful previews of the project, but neither establishes a complete episode list. As of the information reviewed here, the most precise broadcast window remains 2027. Kodansha has said the adaptation is planned for streaming in various countries. Until a distributor names specific services and regions, viewers should check later official announcements for local availability and accessibility options. What the first promotional video actually confirms The October 7 promotional update establishes a 2027 television broadcast window and identifies the two principal performers: Iori Saeki as Saki and Sora Amamiya as Kanon. It also names Tomoe Makino as director, Shogo Yasukawa for series composition, Ayumi Nishihata for character designs and CompTown for animation production. These details are confirmed by the official production website . The video is not an episode schedule. No exact premiere day, international streaming platform or territory-by-territory launch timetable has been confirmed. Readers should treat those items as pending rather than extrapolating from the promotional video's publication date. AniNextUp: We distinguish confirmed release information from details that remain unannounced. This page will be updated when the production committee confirms a date or streaming platform. Additional primary sources: October 7 first-PV announcement and Kodansha: adaptation and planned international streaming . Video source: official YouTube upload (It's Anime powered by REMOW) .

entries.title: THE ONE PIECE Release Date: February 2027, Episodes & Where to Watch
entries.description: THE ONE PIECE arrives globally on Netflix in February 2027: seven episodes, about 300 minutes, East Blue’s opening 50 chapters and WIT Studio credits.
entries.content: NETFLIX ANIME · FEBRUARY 2027 THE ONE PIECE Release Date: February 2027, Episodes & Where to Watch THE ONE PIECE premieres globally on Netflix in February 2027. Its first season adapts the opening East Blue story in seven episodes released together, with about 300 minutes of animation planned. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official teaser image from Netflix Anime. Watch the teaser on YouTube . Release at a glance Premiere February 2027 Exact date Not announced Episodes Seven, released all at once Total runtime Around 300 minutes Where to watch Netflix Animation production WIT Studio Release details checked October 26, 2026 · Netflix Tudum When does THE ONE PIECE come out on Netflix? THE ONE PIECE is scheduled to premiere globally on Netflix in February 2027. Netflix has confirmed the month but has not announced a calendar day or release hour. If you are planning a watch date, treat February as the confirmed window and check the title’s local Netflix page closer to launch; do not convert the month into an assumed February 1 premiere. The platform plan is clearer than the timing. Netflix says all seven episodes will be released together, so viewers can watch the announced first season in one visit rather than wait for a weekly episode. The official announcement does not give a regional time table, however. A Netflix release in one country should not be turned into an exact local time for every territory without a later platform listing. How many episodes are in the first season? Season 1 is planned for seven episodes and about 300 minutes in total . Dividing that approximate runtime by seven works out to roughly 43 minutes per episode, but that is only an average calculation. Netflix has not published the individual runtimes, so it does not confirm that every installment will be the same length or say how opening and ending credits affect each episode’s listed duration. Related reading: ONE PIECE: Elbaph Arc English Dub Release Date and Crunchyroll Schedule . The seven-episode count and all-at-once drop answer two different questions: how much of the new adaptation is planned, and how its launch is structured. Neither announcement confirms how many seasons the project will have. Netflix has also not described a later season schedule or said when it would decide whether to continue the adaptation. Which part of the manga will THE ONE PIECE adapt? The new series starts from the beginning of Eiichiro Oda’s manga and adapts the East Blue Saga. Netflix says its first season will cover the opening 50 chapters and lead up to Luffy’s encounter with Sanji at the floating restaurant Baratie. That gives readers a useful boundary for this season: it follows the early formation of Luffy’s pirate crew, rather than jumping directly into a later Grand Line storyline. The East Blue material introduces the premise that shapes the larger adventure. Monkey D. Luffy sets out to become King of the Pirates and find the One Piece treasure, gathering companions as he crosses paths with other pirates and the people who stand in their way. Netflix describes the adaptation as a fresh yet familiar retelling of that beginning. It has not released an episode-by-episode chapter map, so the 50-chapter scope should not be used to guess exactly where a particular scene will appear. Related reading: Medalist Movie Release Date: February 19, 2027, Story and Cast . Is this a remake or a continuation of the original anime? Netflix identifies THE ONE PIECE as a new adaptation that begins again with Chapter 1. It is separate from the long-running television anime, which began in 1999 and has continued for more than two decades. The announcement does not say that the existing series is ending, being replaced, or required viewing before the new version; the new project simply offers another starting point for the same manga story. That distinction also helps separate this title from Netflix’s live-action ONE PIECE series. THE ONE PIECE is animated by WIT Studio and re-adapts Oda’s manga. It is not the next season of the live-action show, and the live-action release calendar does not establish the animated series’ episode dates. Who is producing the new anime? WIT Studio leads animation production, with Shueisha, Fuji Television Network and Toei Animation named as collaborators. Netflix’s published creative credits list Masashi Koizuka as director, Hideaki Abe as assistant director, and Taku Kishimoto for series composition. Kyoji Asano and Takatoshi Honda are credited for character design and chief animation direction. The listed team also includes creature designer and image-board artist Yasuhiro Kajino, prop designer Eri Taguchi, action animators Ken Imaizumi and Shûhei Fukuda, art director Tomonori Kuroda, and animation producer Ryoma Kawamura. Related reading: Pokémon Horizons Season 4: February 27 Netflix Date, Story and Trailer . Mayumi Tanaka is confirmed to return as the Japanese voice of Luffy in the new adaptation, according to the ONE PIECE franchise’s official announcement. A full Japanese cast list and the English-language dub cast have not been announced in the Netflix materials reviewed for this update. Viewers should therefore treat Tanaka’s role as a confirmed individual casting detail, not evidence that every original anime performer is returning. When was the official teaser released? The official ONE PIECE.com announcement scheduled the teaser’s worldwide release for June 24, 2026, at 22:00 JST (UTC+09:00) . Netflix’s verified YouTube channel lists the same June 24 publication date. The time above is the announced release time for the teaser, not the premiere time for the anime series. VideoObject metadata uses that official schedule, rather than an inferred time zone or the article’s publication date. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TEASER Netflix What is still unknown about the release? The current confirmed plan is specific: February 2027, Netflix, seven episodes released together, about 300 minutes overall, and an East Blue adaptation ending at the Baratie meeting described by Netflix. The exact premiere day and hour, individual episode lengths, language options by region, and any future-season order remain unannounced in the official sources reviewed here. For now, readers can use Netflix’s title page for availability in their country and follow official updates for a day-specific launch time. The original television anime is a separate adaptation, while Netflix’s live-action series is a different format. Keeping those projects distinct avoids mixing their episode counts, casts or release calendars. entries.title: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Release Schedule & Where to Watch
entries.description: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans began on Japan's late-night schedule for October 2, 2026, with new episodes weekly and Disney+ SVOD distribution worldwide outside mainland China.
entries.content: OCTOBER 2 · 2026 Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Release Schedule & Where to Watch Tokyo Revengers is back with the War of the Three Titans arc, airing weekly from October 2. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases WHERE TO WATCH Disney+ / Hulu (U.S.) Release at a glance Release October 2, 2026 on Hulu in the U.S. Where to watch Hulu in the U.S.; Disney+ in announced international territories Region and timing Japan’s October 2 late-night slot occurs October 3 at 01:23 JST; Disney+ Japan follows at 02:00 JST. Release details checked October 12, 2026 · Disney+’s October 2026 programming announcement · Tokyo Revengers official broadcast schedule Why this arc rewards watching the earlier story The War of the Three Titans follows the Tenjiku conflict and continues Takemichi's relationship with Mikey and the competing factions. Knowing how those relationships changed in earlier arcs provides context that a list of newly introduced characters cannot replace. This is a continuation rather than an alternate starting point for the series. Understanding the late-night broadcast date Japanese broadcasters sometimes use an extended late-night clock so a program after midnight remains attached to the previous evening's schedule. This is why a Friday-night anime listing can fall on Saturday by ordinary calendar time. Streaming services publish separate release windows, so use the time shown in your local catalog. When did War of the Three Titans begin? Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans began on Japan's late-night schedule for October 2, 2026. The official Japanese schedule labels the MBS/TBS slot as Friday late night at 25:23 JST (1:23 a.m. on Saturday in standard calendar notation). CBC, BS-TBS, AT-X and regional stations have their own broadcast schedules. Does Friday 25:23 mean Friday afternoon? No. The Japanese broadcast listing uses an extended late-night clock: Friday 25:23 JST means Saturday at 1:23 a.m. JST on a normal calendar. The separately listed Friday 26:00 streaming time corresponds to Saturday at 2:00 a.m. JST. Viewers should use their own platform's local listing rather than treating these Japanese schedule labels as universal release times. Related reading: Romelia War Chronicle: Release Date, Story & Where to Watch . Where to watch The official anime site announces Disney+ worldwide subscription streaming (excluding mainland China), while Disney's October 2026 U.S. schedule lists the arc on Hulu . Streaming availability depends on your country. The Japanese listing uses Friday late-night 26:00, meaning Saturday at 2:00 a.m. JST in ordinary calendar notation, shortly after the earliest Japanese broadcast. What is the War of the Three Titans arc? The new arc continues Takemichi Hanagaki's time-leap story after the Tenjiku conflict and brings the struggle surrounding Mikey into a new phase. Promotional material introduces major players including Takeomi Akashi, Wakasa Imaushi, Keizo Arashi and South Terano. Opening and ending themes JO1 performs the opening theme “IGNITE,” while go!go!vanillas performs the ending theme “Trickster.” Both songs were announced by the anime's official site ahead of the October broadcast. What to know before watching War of the Three Titans is a continuation of Tokyo Revengers, not a standalone reboot. It follows the events of the Tenjiku conflict and moves Takemichi's story into the next major struggle surrounding Mikey and the new factions competing for power. New viewers will get much more from this arc after watching the earlier Tokyo Revengers seasons and arcs. Related reading: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Schedule & Where to Watch . Tokyo Revengers FAQ Is War of the Three Titans a new season? It is the next major anime arc in the continuing Tokyo Revengers story. Do I need to watch Tenjiku first? Yes. This arc continues the existing story and assumes familiarity with Takemichi, Mikey and the events leading out of the Tenjiku conflict. Is it on Disney+? Disney+ is listed for international distribution by the anime's official site, while Disney's U.S. October 2026 schedule lists Hulu. New episodes are scheduled weekly; check your regional service for release times. How often are new episodes released? The Japanese schedule is weekly on Friday nights, with the after-midnight airing falling on Saturday in Japan. Displayed release days and times can shift by territory and by individual schedule changes. Related reading: Black Clover Season 2 Schedule & Where to Watch . Latest update: October 5, 2026 · Streaming and broadcast information checked against the official Tokyo Revengers site. Have individual episode times changed? Yes. The production has published schedule exceptions, so the regular weekly slot should be treated as a baseline rather than a promise that every episode appears at the same minute. Its episode 53 notice moved the MBS and TBS airing from Friday October 16 at 25:23 to 25:33 JST. Disney+ was moved from 26:00 to 26:10 on that same extended Friday schedule. In ordinary calendar notation, those revised times are Saturday October 17 at 1:33 a.m. and 2:10 a.m. in Japan. The notice also lists changes for several regional stations. It applies to that episode and should not be projected automatically onto later installments. How are episodes numbered? An official advance-screening announcement identifies the first three installments of the arc as overall episodes 51, 52 and 53. That numbering can help viewers match a service's episode list to an arc-specific guide, even if a platform displays season labels differently. Check the episode title and local catalog when those labels do not match. Related reading: Dandivine Release Date & Where to Watch: Japan Schedule, Cast and Story . The official Japanese schedule lists a worldwide Disney+ subscription release excluding mainland China and also lists separate pay-per-view services in Japan. Those arrangements describe different access models; consult the relevant service in your country for current availability and pricing. Weekly release schedule The arc is scheduled weekly on Japan’s Friday-night programming schedule. Broadcast times can differ across Japan, and Disney+ and Hulu availability and release times can differ by country and time zone. See the Fall 2026 anime calendar and streaming guide for more releases. entries.title: The Vermilion Mask Release Date, Time & Where to Watch
entries.description: The Vermilion Mask began in October 2026. Check the Japanese broadcast slot, Crunchyroll plans, official PV, cast, music and manga context.
entries.content: OCTOBER 10, 2026 · RELEASE GUIDE The Vermilion Mask Release Date, Time & Where to Watch The Vermilion Mask began its Japanese broadcast on October 10, 2026, with Crunchyroll announced internationally. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official anime promotional artwork. © Nabana Naba, Dr. Poro, SHONENGAHOSHA / The Vermilion Mask Production Committee. Official source . RELEASE October 10, 2026 JAPAN TV Saturdays · 17:30 JST STUDIO 100studio Release at a glance Release October 10, 2026 Where to watch Crunchyroll in licensed territories Region and timing Yomiuri TV/Nippon TV network: Saturdays at 17:30 JST; regional exceptions. Release details checked October 24, 2026 · Vermilion Mask production announcement · Crunchyroll’s Fall 2026 anime lineup When did The Vermilion Mask premiere? The Vermilion Mask began its Japanese broadcast on October 10, 2026. The production announcement from HIKE sets the regular Yomiuri TV/Nippon TV network slot at Saturdays, 5:30 p.m. JST, with some regional exceptions. This is the domestic television appointment, not a universal streaming upload time. That Japanese slot corresponds to 08:30 UTC. Use the station's current listing if a particular weekend changes, rather than treating the opening date as a guarantee for every subsequent episode. Viewers outside Japan should check their own distributor before converting the television hour into a watch-party reminder. Where can you watch it? Crunchyroll is an announced international streaming home. Yomiuri Telecasting Corporation's English production release explicitly identifies an October Crunchyroll launch. A local episode page remains the practical check for whether the show is available to your account, and which audio and subtitle options it carries. Related reading: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Cour 2 Release Date & Time . The Japanese distribution notice also names domestic services, including TVer, ytv MyDo!, ABEMA and subscription platforms. These are separate market-specific options. A listing for a Japanese service does not establish that the same title is included in an identically named service abroad, or that every platform releases an episode simultaneously. This guide does not assign an English dub date. The confirmed production announcement and the Japanese cast list are not evidence of a dubbed release schedule. Check the language label beside the episode you intend to play instead of assuming all versions share the same availability. What is the story, without later-episode spoilers? Peru d'Arrest is an apprentice to mask maker Gaston Roux. A powerful mask takes control of Peru, and the resulting tragedy kills his companions and his master. Peru's response is to seek out and destroy the masks Gaston left across the world, hoping to prevent another catastrophe. Related reading: DARK MACHINE THE ANIMATION Release Date & Time . That premise gives the journey a different purpose from collecting powerful equipment. Peru is confronting the consequences of objects he once associated with his teacher. Our interpretation is that responsibility and regret provide the emotional stakes of the battles; this is a reading of the official setup, not a review claiming that we have watched every episode. What do the masks actually do? The official introduction establishes that wearing a mask can confer power, with disastrous consequences as well as advantages. The Mask of the Warrior God is central to the opening tragedy. The title therefore refers to objects that drive the conflict, rather than decorative costumes alone. Related reading: PSYREN Anime Release Date, Time & Where to Watch . For a first-time viewer, that is enough background to follow Peru's goal. The introduction does not give a complete catalogue of masks, their rules or the eventual outcome of the hunt. Treat a power shown briefly in promotional footage as a preview, not a full explanation of how every confrontation works. Which voice actors and studio are involved? The official English credits name Taihi Kimura as Peru, Yuuki Yamamoto as Sonarue Maywood and Kazuki Ura as Mok Sharib. Kazuhiko Inoue voices Gaston Roux, while Akio Otsuka voices the Mask of the Warrior God. These are the Japanese performances; they should not be presented as an English dub cast. Tetsuaki Watanabe directs, Gai Hazako is assistant director and Daisuke Ohigashi handles series composition. Hisashi Higashijima designs the characters and serves as chief animation director; Alisa Okehazama composes the music. The animation company is credited as One Double-O studio on the English site and 100studio in the Japanese announcement. Related reading: The World's Strongest Witch Release Date, Time & Where to Watch . What are the opening and ending songs? The announced opening is MAN WITH A MISSION's “Firestarter”; the ending is yutori's “Koe.” Yomiuri's release identifies both tracks in the second main promotional video. This helps distinguish the songs from the instrumental score credited to Okehazama when searching for music from the series. Watch the official second main PV The verified upload is on Yomiuri TV's official animation channel. Its original YouTube metadata records September 10, 2026, at 12:00:12 PDT (UTC−07:00) , equivalent to 19:00:12 UTC. That dates the trailer, not the anime premiere. The official production release links this same video. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL PV ON YOUTUBE Yomiuri TV official animation channel “Second main PV” means a second major promotional video, not episode two of the series. It is a preview for people deciding whether to watch. Begin with episode one on the distributor rather than treating the trailer number as an episode-order guide. Is there a manga, and where should newcomers begin? The anime's official site identifies the source as the manga by Nabana Naba and Dr.Poro, serialized in Shonen Gahosha's Young King OURs. Readers wanting the original should look for those creator credits and the Japanese title, 朱色の仮面, rather than an unrelated novel with a similar English name. The announcements cited here do not provide an episode-to-chapter reading map or establish how much manga the season adapts. Starting at the beginning is the clearest reading option; matching a chapter number to an episode number could skip material. For viewing plans, compare the weekly anime schedule and release calendar , then confirm the current episode on your local service. entries.title: Armored Trooper VOTOMS: The Gray Witch Part 1
entries.description: VOTOMS: The Gray Witch Part 1 opens in Japan on November 20, 2026. Check its story, cast, official trailer upload time and what remains unconfirmed.
entries.content: NOVEMBER 20 · ANIME MOVIE Armored Trooper VOTOMS: The Gray Witch Part 1 Armored Trooper VOTOMS: The Gray Witch Part 1 opens November 20, 2026 in Japan. Mamoru Oshii directs the new Sunrise theatrical anime. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official key visual for Armored Trooper VOTOMS: The Gray Witch . Source: official VOTOMS site . Release at a glance Release November 20, 2026; first of two films Where to watch Japanese theaters Applies to Japanese theatrical opening Still pending International release and streaming availability Release details checked October 24, 2026 · Official source RELEASE November 20, 2026 FORMAT Japanese Theaters STUDIO Sunrise When does VOTOMS: The Gray Witch Part 1 release? Armored Trooper VOTOMS: The Gray Witch Part 1 opens in Japanese theaters on November 20, 2026. The date applies to the first film in a two-part theatrical project. The official announcement does not give a date for Part 2, so the November opening should not be read as the release date for the complete story. What is the story about? The official synopsis places the action near the end of the Hundred Year War and identifies Gilgamesh and Balarant as the opposing powers. The investigation centers on Ash Vamps, an Armored Trooper pilot whose repeated survival of missions that kill her unit has earned her the name “the Witch.” Maki Stauffenberg is assigned to investigate Ash and becomes involved in a dangerous operation involving an AT drop. That setup gives readers a clear question to follow: what happened on Ash’s missions, and what will Maki discover? The announcement presents the Witch name as a reputation attached to Ash by other soldiers. It does not confirm magic or explain how she survives. The cause remains a plot mystery, so claims that reveal it before the film opens would go beyond the published synopsis. Related reading: Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 4 Anime Officially Announced . Can newcomers watch Part 1 without seeing the older series? The film announcement gives a setting, central mystery and two principal characters, which is enough to understand the basic premise. However, the official material reviewed here does not label the movie a standalone entry, recap, reboot or direct sequel, and it does not publish a recommended viewing order. Viewers unfamiliar with VOTOMS should therefore treat the war and character details above as confirmed orientation, not as a promise that no prior knowledge matters. Check the official project page for any viewing guidance added before release. Who are Ash and Maki, and who voices them? Ash Vamps is the pilot under investigation; Maki Stauffenberg is the officer assigned to examine her case. Miyuki Sawashiro voices Ash, while Mabuki Ando voices Maki. The announced supporting cast includes Yūichi Nakamura, Satoshi Tsuruoka, Tomokazu Sugita, Kenta Miyake, Chafūrin, Hōchū Ōtsuka and Daisuke Ono. The official cast notice identifies these performers, but the available announcement does not describe every character’s relationship to the two leads. Who is making the new VOTOMS film? Mamoru Oshii directs. The project’s official credits list original creator and general supervisor Ryosuke Takahashi, original mechanical designer Kunio Okawara, mechanical designers Shinobu Tsuneki and Yoshihiro Sono, and composer Kenji Kawai. Sunrise is producing the animation, Production I.G is providing production cooperation, and Bandai Namco Filmworks is distributing the film. Those credits help distinguish the confirmed creative team from assumptions based only on the VOTOMS name. Related reading: One-Punch Man Season 3 Part 2: January 2027 Release, New Trailer and JAM Project Opening . Is November 20 the release date for both parts? No. November 20, 2026 is the confirmed Japanese theatrical opening for Part 1. The project is announced as two theatrical parts, but no Part 2 date appears in the official material checked for this update. The announcements also do not state an episode count or a home-video schedule. Until the distributor posts those details, viewers should treat them as unannounced rather than infer a gap between the films. What changed in the latest official trailer news? On October 23, the official VOTOMS site published a new main visual, a final trailer and a separate theme-song preview. It also announced “名も無き詩人のように” (“Like a Nameless Poet”) by Mika Nakashima, with music by Toshihiko Takamizawa of THE ALFEE. These are promotional updates ahead of the theatrical opening; they do not change the release date or reveal a Part 2 schedule. The official Sunrise YouTube channel’s feed records the final trailer (video ID 7NH-89IIBZ4 ) as published at October 23, 2026, 15:55:39 JST (06:55:39 UTC). The companion theme-song preview (video ID dTUpnswZ3VU ) was published at 15:55:31 JST (06:55:31 UTC) on the same date. The seconds and timezone come from the channel’s original feed timestamps, not from the date displayed on a video page. Watch the official final trailer or the official theme-song preview . Related reading: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion! Release Date & Watch Guide . Where can viewers watch it? The confirmed venue information is Japanese theaters. As of October 24, the official material reviewed here does not name an international theatrical distributor or a streaming service. That means there is no verified overseas date or platform to report yet. The film’s Japanese opening is useful for tracking the production, but it should not be presented as a global release date. What should fans watch for next? The most useful next confirmation would be an official Part 2 date, followed by any territory-specific cinema or streaming announcement. The official project page and the film’s news feed are the primary places to check; AniNextUp will update this guide when those details are published. For now, the firm reference points are Part 1’s November 20 Japanese opening, the announced two-part format, the named cast and staff, and the October 23 trailer and song releases. Everything else—including an international launch, streaming home and Part 2 timing—remains unconfirmed. Artwork source: official release announcement . BROADCAST Nippon TV FORMAT TV Anime Release at a glance Japanese release April 2027; exact day TBA Japanese broadcaster Nippon TV Format TV anime Streaming Not announced Release window checked October 23, 2026 against the linked official announcement. Why the April 2027 window is useful but incomplete A confirmed broadcast month gives readers a meaningful planning window without identifying an exact day or streaming service. The story's focus on Shun's interrupted soccer ambitions and his after-school connection with Naoki also suggests a quieter school-life romance rather than a conventional sports comeback. Cast, staff and platform claims should wait for further official announcements. When does Walking Home with You premiere? The adaptation now has both a confirmed television format and release month. The announcement also introduced the first anime teaser visual, turning the earlier adaptation announcement into a concrete Spring 2027 release target. What is Walking Home with You about? Mai Matsuda's school romantic comedy follows Shun Sato, a new high-school student who gave up his soccer dream after an injury, and his unusual upperclassman Naoki Sato. Their relationship develops through the so-called Hyper Going-Home Club and the everyday detours they share after school. Why this is not simply a sports comeback story Shun's abandoned soccer dream is part of the setup, but the announced story centers on the everyday connection he develops with Naoki through their after-school routine. That makes the injury an important piece of character background rather than proof that the anime will focus on competitive soccer. The official teaser announcement does not establish whether Shun returns to the sport, so a comeback arc should not be treated as confirmed. Cast, staff and studio Those details remain unconfirmed in the current production announcement for the April 2027 broadcast. AniNextUp will update this guide when the production committee announces the Japanese cast, principal staff or animation studio. Related reading: Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san? Anime Release Date: January 7, 2027 . Where to watch Nippon TV is confirmed for the Japanese broadcast. No international streaming service has been officially announced yet, so any global platform listing remains pending. Is there an official trailer? No anime PV or trailer specific to the TV series was announced with this update. The official material currently centers on the teaser visual; this page will be updated when an official promotional video becomes available. What the new visual confirms—and what it does not The October 7 update gives the adaptation a useful milestone: the television anime is scheduled for April 2027, with Nippon TV named for the Japanese broadcast. The teaser visual and the creator’s commemorative illustration confirm that the project has moved beyond the original adaptation announcement into active promotion. They are not a full trailer, and the materials reviewed for this guide do not identify a specific April day, broadcast time, voice cast, animation studio or overseas platform. Keeping those details separate helps readers avoid a common scheduling mistake. “April 2027” is a confirmed month, not a premiere date that can be converted into a day on a calendar. A Japanese network listing also does not tell international viewers where or when the series will stream. AniNextUp will add those details only after the anime’s official channels or a distributor announce them. Where did Walking Home with You begin? Mai Matsuda writes and illustrates the original manga. The anime announcement identifies Futabasha's Manga Action and Web Action as its publication venues and describes the adaptation as a youth romantic comedy about Shun and his senior Naoki. Related reading: Takopi's Original Sin: Thank You, See You Tomorrow Release Date . Naoki is nicknamed Chokki-chan, a reference to her habit of saying she wants to go straight home. Through the Hyper Going-Home Club, the pair spend time together after school instead of following a conventional club's practice schedule. Shun's injury is part of his background, while their shared detours give the story its day-to-day focus. Does the teaser visual contain a release day? No. The production's October announcement supplies an April 2027 television window and a first visual, but not a specific calendar day or a distributor outside Japan. A future cast or trailer announcement may add detail; until then, the month is the appropriate level of precision for a viewing calendar. The manga setup behind the title The Japanese title is Hōkago Kitaku Biyori , and the story starts with a simple after-school choice: whether to go straight home or spend time with someone who wants company. The manga follows Naoki, an upperclassman known for her “straight-home” habit, and Shun, a younger student drawn into her routine. That small-scale premise gives the series a different kind of romantic-comedy engine from a competition story or a high-stakes school mystery. The hook is the daily negotiation of time, companionship and personal boundaries. The anime’s April window is therefore useful for readers deciding whether to follow an adaptation of the manga, but the official announcement does not yet tell us how many chapters or volumes the television season will cover. It is too early to promise a particular arc, ending point or episode count. For now, the reliable checklist is short: April 2027 in Japan, Nippon TV, a teaser visual, and further cast, staff and streaming information still pending.
