entries.title: Witch on the Holy Night Movie: Release Date and Theaters
entries.description: Witch on the Holy Night opens in Japanese theaters November 20, 2026. The ufotable film receives an international theatrical release beginning January 2027.
entries.content: NOVEMBER 20 · UFOTABLE Witch on the Holy Night Movie: Release Date and Theaters Witch on the Holy Night opens in Japanese theaters November 20, 2026. The ufotable film receives an international theatrical release beginning January 2027. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official final-trailer visual. Source: ufotable . Release at a glance Japan theaters November 20, 2026 International theaters January 28, 2027: Latin American markets; January 29: United States and Canada Studio ufotable Streaming No release date announced in the reviewed official sources Official project source RELEASE November 20, 2026 FORMAT Japanese Theaters STUDIO ufotable Release date and where to watch The headline question has a confirmed answer for Japan: Witch on the Holy Night opens in Japanese theaters on November 20, 2026. The film is an animated adaptation of the TYPE-MOON work, produced by ufotable, with distribution credited to Toho and Aniplex on the official project site. That date is a cinema opening, not a streaming launch. International theatrical dates are a separate rollout, and neither announcement should be treated as proof that the movie will appear on a particular subscription service. For viewers outside Japan, the announced international schedule identifies January 28, 2027 for Latin American markets and January 29 for the United States and Canada . Those dates do not establish one worldwide day: local distributors can schedule screenings differently, and some territories may receive the film later. Check a local cinema listing once tickets are available. As of this update, no home-video or streaming date has been announced by the project site. The practical answer to “Where can I watch it?” is therefore theatrical release in the listed markets, with streaming availability still unknown. What is the movie about? The movie adapts a story built around three very different young people. Aoko Aozaki is a high-school student learning to become a Magician; Alice Kuonji is the witch with whom she lives and trains; Soujuurou Shizuki is a boy who comes from the mountains to the city and enters their orbit. The official introduction describes their meeting as the start of Aoko’s story. It is useful context for new viewers because it identifies the central trio without requiring knowledge of another TYPE-MOON anime. Related reading: Fool Night Release Date: November 26 on Netflix . The setup is not simply a school fantasy. Aoko has responsibilities in ordinary school life as well as a demanding apprenticeship, while Alice’s practice of magic forms part of their shared household. Soujuurou’s arrival disrupts the routine the two have established. The official synopsis presents that encounter as a turning point; it does not disclose the film’s full plot or promise how much of the original story the movie will cover. Anyone looking for a scene-by-scene adaptation breakdown should wait for a more detailed official synopsis or the completed film. Is it connected to Fate? The title is connected to TYPE-MOON, the creative company behind the original work, but this movie is not advertised as a sequel season to Fate or another numbered anime. The official project credits Kinoko Nasu and TYPE-MOON for the original work, and Hirokazu Koyama for original character design, with Takashi Takeuchi credited for original character concepts. That context helps explain why the film may interest fans of TYPE-MOON while also setting a clear expectation: the official material introduces Aoko, Alice and Soujuurou as the focus of this story, rather than presenting the movie as a continuation of a separate series. Studio, staff and theme song ufotable handles animation production and screenplay production. Masaru Takeuchi is the director, Moe Tsuzuki is character designer, and Hikaru Kondo is chief director. The official staff list also names Masato Nagamori as chief animation director, Yuuichi Terao for photography and finishing direction, and Hideyuki Fukasawa for music. These credits are more useful than guessing at a production schedule: they establish who is attached, but they do not confirm the film’s running time, number of parts, or the amount of material adapted. Related reading: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion! Release Date & Watch Guide . The final trailer also confirms supercell’s theme song, “Yoru to Ao.” That makes the PV a good starting point for viewers who want a concise look at the film’s tone and music, but a trailer is promotional material, not a substitute for a complete plot description. The official video is published by Aniplex’s channel and is linked below. The original YouTube page declares an upload time of September 30, 2026 at 03:05:47 PDT (UTC−07:00), equivalent to 19:05:47 JST. That timestamp belongs to the video itself; ufotable’s separate news-post time is not substituted. What has not been announced? The Japanese opening is confirmed for November 20, 2026, but individual theaters may list different showtimes. January 2027 international dates apply to the named territories above; they do not confirm a release date for every country. No streaming platform, digital rental date, Blu-ray date, runtime, or episode count has been announced on the official project site. If a later distributor announcement adds those details, they should be reported with the applicable region and source instead of extrapolated from the theatrical schedule. Related reading: Expelled from Paradise Sequel Reveals Main Trailer and Beyond the Night Theme Song . For planning, use the date that matches your location, then verify the theater’s own listing and language options. A Japanese premiere does not mean same-day access abroad, and an international theatrical date does not mean the film will stream that week. If you are deciding whether to watch as a newcomer, the official story outline provides the necessary starting point: Aoko’s apprenticeship, Alice as her housemate and fellow practitioner, and Soujuurou’s arrival. Additional franchise background may enrich the experience, but the project’s official introduction does not state that prior viewing is required. Quick release guide Japan: November 20, 2026, in theaters. Latin America: January 28, 2027, according to the announced international schedule. United States and Canada: January 29, 2027. Other territory dates and streaming plans remain unconfirmed. The film is produced by ufotable, adapts a TYPE-MOON work, and features the confirmed supercell song “Yoru to Ao.” For updates, see the January 2027 anime release guide and check local cinema listings as distribution details arrive. entries.content: OCTOBER 7, 2026 · RELEASE GUIDE The World's Strongest Witch Release Date, Time & Where to Watch The World's Strongest Witch began its October 7, 2026 release. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official promotional artwork from Crunchyroll's official trailer . Artwork belongs to the credited production rights holders. RELEASE October 7, 2026 JAPAN Wednesdays · 22:00 JST STUDIO Bridge / AISLE Release at a glance Release October 7, 2026 Where to watch Crunchyroll in licensed territories; ABEMA and d Anime Store in Japan Region and timing TOKYO MX, ABEMA and d Anime Store: Wednesdays at 22:00 JST. Release details checked October 24, 2026 · The World’s Strongest Witch official broadcast schedule · Crunchyroll’s Fall 2026 anime lineup When did The World's Strongest Witch begin? The Japanese premiere was October 7, 2026. YTE's official programme listing gives TOKYO MX's regular slot as Wednesdays at 22:00 JST. The series has therefore already reached its launch window; October 7 is the opening date, rather than a new date for every episode. For Japanese streaming, YTE lists ABEMA and d Anime Store from the same evening at 22:00 JST. These are domestic distribution options. They should not be confused with an international service's upload schedule or taken as evidence that a Japanese subscription works in another country. How do the late-night Japanese broadcast times work? The listings use television-day notation: Wednesday 24:00 on BS11 means midnight at the start of Thursday, while Wednesday 26:05 on TV Aichi means Thursday at 02:05. Similarly, MBS's Saturday 26:38 slot falls early Sunday by the calendar. This explains why two programme guides can show different weekdays for the same listed broadcast. Keep the station name attached to the time when setting a reminder. A later broadcast on another channel is not necessarily a delayed international episode, and the AT-X repeat slots are reruns rather than additional new episodes. Japan uses JST, UTC+09:00; your own calendar date can differ when converting an overnight slot. Related reading: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion! Release Date & Watch Guide . Japan does not change clocks for daylight saving time. If your country does, the local equivalent of a fixed JST broadcast can shift during the season. Recheck your calendar conversion after a clock change rather than assuming a premiere-week reminder stays correct. Where can international viewers watch? Crunchyroll's official trailer announcement identifies October 7 as its launch date. The platform's Fall 2026 lineup is the linked reference for international scheduling. Availability still depends on the local catalogue; the Japanese television timetable cannot establish access in every territory. Before joining a watch party, check the episode listing in your region and the available audio track. A subtitled release, a dubbed version and a Japanese broadcast are different releases. This guide does not assign a dub date or promise a language option that the cited announcements do not establish. Related reading: Armored Trooper VOTOMS: The Gray Witch Part 1 . What is Lorna's Internet skill? Lorna Hermit is expelled after receiving a skill others consider worthless. Its actual function gives her access to a strategy site for her own fantasy world. The important distinction is that she can look up useful knowledge: the premise is not simply that she has a stronger attack than everyone else. That creates an accessible hook for viewers familiar with game guides. Information can expose a shortcut that brute force misses. Our reading of the setup is that Lorna's freedom and ingenuity matter alongside her power; it is an interpretation of the premise, not a claim about scenes we have reviewed or the outcome of later adventures. Is the source a novel or a manga? The original is a light novel by Mochimaru Sakaki, illustrated by riritto, published under Square Enix's SQEX Novel label. A manga adaptation also exists. The publisher's series page separates the novel volumes from its manga news, which helps readers avoid mixing their numbering. Related reading: Witch on the Holy Night Movie: Release Date and Theaters . Square Enix marks novel volume six as the final volume, released October 7, 2026. That book date coincides with the anime's launch, but the two events do not establish how much material the television adaptation covers. A completed novel series does not automatically mean a complete anime adaptation. If you want to read ahead, choose a format first and start with its first volume. Moving from an anime episode straight to a similarly numbered book or manga chapter risks skipping material. The sources cited here do not supply an episode-to-chapter conversion, so this guide does not invent one. Who voices Lorna, and who makes the anime? The production information reproduced by HoneyWorks credits Azusa Tachibana as Lorna, Fairouz Ai as Erimina, Honoka Inoue as Elna, Kana Hanazawa as Aries, Maria Naganawa as Lulu and Yuto Uemura as Reinhart. These are Japanese voice credits, not an English dub cast. Related reading: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Cour 2 Release Date & Time . Joji Furuta directs, Shoji Yonemura handles series composition and Yuki Morimoto designs the characters. Bridge and AISLE produce the animation. The opening theme is HoneyWorks feat. HaKoniwalily's “Eikyoryoku ∞ Idol,” with an October 7 digital release. A theme-song release is useful for listeners searching for the opening, but it does not establish an album or complete soundtrack schedule. Watch the official trailer The Crunchyroll upload dates to September 15, 2026, at 08:59:51 PDT (UTC−07:00) , equivalent to 15:59:51 UTC. This is the promotional video's upload time, not an episode broadcast time. The poster below opens the original official video. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER ON YOUTUBE Crunchyroll official channel What should you check before the next episode? Use the local episode page for availability, the named broadcaster for Japanese schedule changes and the publisher for book information. Keep those sources separate when searching for a release date: a book, song and television episode can share a date without sharing a release mechanism. Our weekly schedule and anime calendar provide broader planning links. entries.title: Yumeneko Connect Anime Announced: Cast, Studio and Teaser
entries.description: Yumeneko Connect is getting a TV anime. See the official teaser, confirmed cast, staff, studio and release-date status.
entries.content: NEW ANIME · RELEASE DATE TBA Yumeneko Connect Anime Announced: Cast, Studio and Teaser Yumeneko Connect , Ko Sawada's science-fiction school comedy from Weekly Shonen Magazine, is officially getting a television anime. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Published: October 14, 2026 · How we verify releases Official anime key visual · © Ko Sawada, Kodansha / Yumeneko Connect Production Committee. Source: official anime website . Release at a glance Release date Not announced Format TV anime Animation studio STUDIO MASSKET Lead cast Yusuke Kobayashi as Yuhi Takamiya; Yu Sasahara (篠原侑) as Nano Streaming No platform announced Official anime website · Official teaser PV What was officially announced? The official Shochiku anime site confirms that Yumeneko Connect is in production as a television anime. The first announcement introduces the premise, lead cast, main staff, animation studio and teaser video. It does not announce a premiere window, broadcaster or streaming service, so those details remain TBA. Does the announcement trailer confirm a 2027 release? No. Shochiku's first television anime announcement confirms the adaptation, lead cast, staff and teaser, but does not provide a broadcast year or season. A teaser's publication date is not the anime's premiere date. Until the official production lists a window, the release date and international streaming arrangements should remain to be announced . Who is in the cast? Yusuke Kobayashi voices lonely high-school student Yuhi Takamiya . Yu Sasahara (篠原侑) voices Nano , an alien who arrives after hearing Yuhi's wish to make friends and offers him unusual products that send his school life into chaos. Staff and animation studio Sota Yokote (横手颯太) directs the adaptation at STUDIO MASSKET . Yoshihiro Watanabe (渡邊義弘) handles character design, Gigaemon Ichikawa (市川十億衛門) oversees series composition and scripts, and Hayato Matsumura (松村颯士) composes the music. Lantis handles music production. Shochiku lists SHOCHIKU ANIME as the production organizer. Watch the official teaser ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TEASER TV anime announcement PV · Shochiku anime What is Yumeneko Connect about? The story follows Yuhi, who misses his first week of high school and struggles to make friends. His wish for companionship attracts Nano, an alien salesgirl whose bizarre products create a fast-moving series of science-fiction comedy mishaps. The manga by Ko Sawada runs in Kodansha's Weekly Shonen Magazine . When will Yumeneko Connect premiere? No release date or broadcast season has been announced. Any specific year, season or streaming destination would be speculation until the production committee publishes a follow-up notice. What the teaser shows, and what it leaves open Shochiku’s October 14 announcement presents Yumeneko Connect as a television anime and opens the official website. The teaser introduces Yuhi and Nano and gives a first look at the series’ bright, exaggerated science-fiction comedy. A separate official note features the manga author’s commemorative illustration and comments from cast and staff. These materials confirm that the adaptation is moving into production promotion; they do not confirm a broadcast season, network or streaming service. The original manga by Ko Sawada runs in Kodansha’s Weekly Shonen Magazine. Its setup follows Yuhi Takamiya, a high-school student who wants friends, and Nano, an alien who arrives after hearing his wish. Her unusual products disrupt his school life. The anime’s official description emphasizes a lively, sometimes provocative comedy built around those products and the heroines. That is a clearer guide to the source’s tone than treating the title as a conventional alien-invasion story. Who are the characters introduced so far? Shochiku's character profiles describe Yuhi as a lonely student who pretends to read in order to hide his isolation. Nano is an alien from the planet Pokotsun who hears his wish for friends and comes to Earth to sell him unusual products. Their contrasting situations provide the starting point for the comedy: Yuhi wants connection, while Nano's attempts to help repeatedly complicate his daily life. The official character page also introduces a mysterious parasitic life-form called Nyoru Puppu Panpippi. The initial cast announcement names performers for Yuhi and Nano; it does not identify a voice actor for every character shown on the site. Further casting should be checked against later production announcements. Where can readers find the original manga? Ko Sawada's manga is serialized in Kodansha's Weekly Shonen Magazine. Shochiku's official site also points readers to the collected Japanese volumes, including volume 10, released on October 16, 2026. The official Magazine Pocket page is a starting point for readers who want to explore the source in Japanese. The production's introduction describes an energetic science-fiction comedy with suggestive humor. That gives prospective viewers a sense of its intended tone, although a teaser cannot establish how every manga scene will be adapted or what a future broadcaster's version will include. Why no premiere date is listed yet An announcement of a television adaptation is a real production milestone, but it is not a schedule. The October 14 material names the lead cast and staff and releases a teaser, yet contains no day, month, broadcaster or platform for the series. The teaser’s upload date is also not an air date. AniNextUp will keep the date marked “not announced” until Shochiku or the production committee publishes a release window. For now, readers can use the official manga page to explore the source and the anime page for cast, staff and promotional updates. International availability is a separate rights question and cannot be derived from the Japanese production announcement. We will add territory-specific information only when a distributor names a service and the countries it covers. Official sources and verification Official Yumeneko Connect anime website · Shochiku anime announcement · Official cast and staff comments · Official Magazine Pocket manga page . The anime site was retrieved on October 14, 2026 and confirms the adaptation, cast, staff and studio; it does not display a publication time.
